title: Casual Jetty Operator - Grays
description:
Could you be the person we’re looking for to join our team in Grays as our new Casual Jetty Operator? We want to hear from you!

The Jetty Operator is responsible for supporting safe, compliant and efficient jetty operations for Marine & Terminal Services clients.

The role provides a key operational link between vessels, terminals and the MATS team, ensuring vessel attendance, cargo transfer activities, documentation, communication, security duties and QHSSE requirements are completed to the required standard.

The role is essential in maintaining service quality, avoiding vessel delays and supporting customer satisfaction.

What would your day at GAC look like?

  • Ensuring vessels are safely berthed, correctly moored, and aligned with shore loading arms and terminal connections.

  • Carrying out pre-berth checks and managing the connection and disconnection of marine loading arms and hoses, including supporting lifting operations using cranes. This involves working both shoreside and onboard vessels.

  • Operating valves and monitoring vessel discharge operations ensuring all hourly and safety checks are being completed.

  • Completing and distributing operational documentation, including pre-berth and post-sailing checklists, jetty operator logs, handover reports, hourly checks, and security records.

  • Acting as a key link between internal and external stakeholders, ensuring information is communicated professionally and efficiently.

  • Carrying out all required security checks within agreed timescales and ensuring security documentation is completed accurately and submitted to the appropriate parties.

  • Participating in internal and external training programmes, keeping competencies up to date and ensuring training records are maintained accurately.

  • Promoting a positive safety culture by reporting hazards, near misses, incidents and safety concerns promptly.

  • Travelling to a variety of locations as required to deliver terminal and marine services

What are we looking for?

  • Minimum of 2 years’ industry experience

  • Jetty or terminal experience desired but not necessary as full training will be provided

  • Strong communication skills

  • Good understanding and appreciation of a proactive safety culture

  • Full, clean driving license with access to your own transport

  • Comfortable working outdoors in a marine environment and undertaking practical operational duties

  • Willingness to travel between sites (travel costs are covered)

The position requires flexibility to work days, nights and weekends.

What’s in it for you?

This is your chance to become part of the global GAC team which has been providing professional shipping, logistics and marine services since 1956. Everything we do is guided by the GAC Spirit, built on mutual loyalty between management and staff, and a belief in the value of our people as individuals - not just for the jobs they do.

With more than 7,500 colleagues in 300 strategically located offices in more than 50 countries around the world, we focus on quality, safety and sustainability with a human touch. Emphasising a long-term approach, innovation and ethics, our flexible and integrated portfolios are designed to work within and support our customers’ operations.

As our Casual Jetty Operator in Grays, you will have the opportunity to work as part of a team who apply the highest standard of customer services to everything we do and aim to be industry leaders within all the sectors we serve.

GAC UK gives you the opportunity to work for an employer who is committed to offering all our staff an enjoyable and rewarding career, with significant training and development prospects.

In 2021, we launched our ten-year sustainability programme – MARS30. We are committed to “growing long term customer relationships across multiple products, whilst significantly reducing our environmental impact, improving the well-being of our people, and influencing our stakeholders to do the same.” We will accomplish our by mission by completing objectives aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

At GAC UK, who you are is just as important as what you do. The GAC Spirit reflects our culture across the company, emphasising loyalty and understanding between management and staff. We recognise that people’s lives extend far beyond their jobs. By promoting a healthy combination of work and play we achieve a happier workforce, delivering service excellence. We have a team of Mental Health First Aiders across the UK and a Wellbeing Working Group who meet monthly and regularly launch new internal wellbeing initiatives.

We’re passionate about diversity and inclusion, and we received Maritime UK Diversity in Maritime Charter Status in 2021, reflecting our commitment to taking real steps to improve diversity in our organisation.

In January 2026, Campaign Against Living Miserably (CALM) became our official Charity of the Year. Throughout the year, we will be raising funds to support CALM’s life‑saving suicide prevention helpline.

We’re looking forward to hearing from you.

description:

RH Aero Systems is setting the standard for aviation support equipment and services. Job Summary:

The Senior Facilities & Office Coordinator is responsible for the smooth and professional day-to-day operation of the RH Aero Systems Dubai office. The role coordinates office administration, facilities, workplace services, procurement, suppliers, visitor management, access requirements, petty cash and general management support. Office Administration & Employee Support

  • Coordinate the day-to-day administrative operation of the Dubai office, ensuring a professional, efficient and well-organised workplace environment.

  • Coordinate office services, subscriptions, memberships and other workplace-related requirements.

Facilities and Workplace coordination

description:

Wednesday-Sunday | 9:00 a.m.-6:00 p.m.


Collaboration. Authenticity. Connection. Balance.


At Cohere, we believe community is the most valuable amenity.


We do more than manage communities-we help create places where people connect, belong, and thrive. By partnering with some of the nation's most innovative master-planned communities, we create places residents are proud to call home and where meaningful relationships flourish.


We're looking for a Resident Experience Coordinator to join our team at Four Seasons at Carolina Oaks, a developing 55+ community in the heart of the Lowcountry with resort-style amenities and a growing resident experience. In this forward-facing role, you'll help set the tone for the resident experience through welcoming front desk service, clear communications, event support, and dependable administrative and operational coordination. You'll be joining the community during an exciting transition as Cohere begins a new chapter of management and resident service.


This is an opportunity to help shape a hospitality-forward resident experience that reflects the warmth and authenticity of the Lowcountry, ensuring residents feel welcomed, connected, and part of the community from the moment they arrive.


If you're someone who enjoys helping people, keeps details organized, and brings positive energy to both everyday interactions and community events, we'd love to meet you.


Why People Choose Cohere


The best communities are built by people who feel supported, valued, and empowered to do their best work. That's why we invest in benefits, time away, and professional growth that help our team members thrive both personally and professionally.

title: Finance Lead | Property & Asset Management
description:
Wij hebben een passie voor mensen en vastgoed. Specifiek bedrijfsmatig vastgoed. MVGM Property & Asset Management (PAM) is gespecialiseerd in het beheren van kantoren, retail vastgoed, logistieke panden en hotels. De financiële dienstverlening is het fundament onder alles wat wij voor onze opdrachtgevers doen. Als Finance Lead ben jij de architect van dat fundament en de aanvoerder van de mensen die het bouwen.

Jouw rol als Finance Lead
Als Finance Lead ben je eindverantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit, continuïteit en verdere professionalisering van de financiële dienstverlening binnen PAM. Je geeft leiding aan Property Administrators, Crediteurenadministrateurs en Servicekostenmedewerkers. Daarnaast werk je actief mee in de operatie en ben je als lid van het MT een strategische sparringpartner voor accountmanagers en het PAM-management. Je rapporteert hiërarchisch aan de Directeur.
Dit is geen functie voor iemand die op afstand stuurt. Jij staat dicht bij het team, neemt mensen mee in verandering en brengt structuur waar dat nodig is. Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoort het volgende:

  • Eindverantwoordelijkheid voor de kwaliteit en continuïteit van de financiële dienstverlening binnen PAM;
  • Aansturen, coachen en ontwikkelen van financiële teams;
  • Sturen op KPI's zoals tijdige en accurate reporting en tijdige servicekostenafrekeningen;
  • Borgen van betrouwbare, transparante rapportages en financiële administraties;
  • Initiëren en realiseren van procesverbeteringen en digitaliseringsprojecten;
  • Bewaken van governance, interne controles en risicomanagement;
  • Optreden als financieel sparringpartner voor accountmanagers en opdrachtgevers.

Wij vragen
Je bent een meewerkend voorman/-vrouw die zowel strategisch kan denken als de handen uit de mouwen steekt. Je brengt rust, overzicht en richting — en weet mensen daarin mee te nemen. Daarnaast zien we graag het volgende in je terug:
  • HBO+/WO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfseconomie of accountancy;
  • Ruime ervaring met financiële administraties en rapportages;
  • Ervaring met leidinggeven en het begeleiden van teams in ontwikkeling;
  • Bij voorkeur ervaring binnen vastgoed- of property management;
  • Affiniteit met digitalisering en datagedreven werken;
  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om te schakelen tussen operatie en management.

Wij bieden
Je komt te werken bij de grootste vastgoeddienstverlener van Nederland, in een organisatie die volop in beweging is. Bij PAM krijg je de ruimte om écht verschil te maken: voor je team, voor onze opdrachtgevers en voor jezelf. Verder bieden wij het volgende:
  • 26 vakantiedagen op basis van 40 uur;
  • Pensioenregeling;
  • Een cultuur die gekenmerkt wordt door eigenheid, ambitie en collegialiteit
  • Een rol met veel vrijheid en ruimte om zelf het initiatief te nemen;
  • Een werkplek in een aantrekkelijk kantoor in hartje Rotterdam met uitstekende OV-bereikbaarheid.


Meer informatie?
Voor vragen kun je contact opnemen met Eddie Almeida op 06 1769 7807.

title: Senior System Priority Engineer

title: Milieu Counselor - Night Shift, Clover Place
description:
Days Off: Sunday, Monday

Shift: Night (11:30pm - 8am)

Shift Differential: $1.00 per hour

Insurance Benefits: Dental, Life, Long-term Disability, Medical (no premiums/payroll deductions for employee coverage)

Other Benefits: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), ORCA card subsidy, Paid Time Off (34 days per year), Retirement Plan

Union Representation: This position is a part of a union and is represented by SEIU Healthcare 1199NW.

About DESC:

Recognized nationally as an innovator and leader in developing solutions to homelessness, DESC is a social services organization, supportive housing operator, and licensed behavioral health treatment provider focused on meeting the needs of people experiencing long-term homelessness and living with complex behavioral health and other medical conditions. Approximately 3,000 people are actively receiving services from DESC at any given point in time. Our vision is a community where all people are shown compassion, treated with dignity, and everyone has a safe, stable, and affordable place to call home.


DESC operates five shelter/emergency housing programs,19 permanent supportive housing facilities with over 1,750 units, several hundred additional scattered site apartments, and a range of behavioral health services including outpatient mental health and substance use disorder treatment, residential crisis stabilization, street outreach, mobile crisis response, and treatment for opioid use disorder.


PROGRAM DESCRIPTION:

Clover Place will be a new DESC housing site that will include 95 units of affordable housing in Seattle's Woodland neighborhood. This vital project will provide stable, supportive housing and 24/7 on-site services for single adults living with disabilities and experiencing chronic homelessness. The community will also feature welcoming indoor and outdoor common spaces.


JOB DEFINITION:

The Milieu Counselor is a key member of the on-site team, responsible for cultivating a safe, therapeutic, and welcoming environment for residents, internal/external stakeholders, and emergency responders. This role is centered on proactive resident engagement, building a sense of community, and providing direct support in shared and private living spaces. The Milieu Counselor promotes resident well-being by fostering a supportive community and helping individuals develop the skills necessary for long-term housing stability.


MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Participate in shift briefs and read logs before the start of each shift daily
  • Provide front desk coverage when needed
  • Distribute client medication and serve food on shift
  • Assertively engage residents in the general milieu and common areas
  • Create a healthy and welcoming environment for residents which includes maintaining the general cleanliness of grounds and common areas. This includes conducting regular perimeter walk-throughs, enforcing good neighbor policy by ensuring individuals are not loitering outside of the building and on the property premises.
  • Maintain safety and security by monitoring all general access areas and enforcing project rules
  • As part of an interdisciplinary team, assist residents in maintaining their housing and a healthy living environment, through proactive engagement and hands on in unit support as needed
  • Assist building/care team staff with engaging residents through creative, resourceful strategies that build trust and confidence for tenants who are resistant to engaging with project/program staff.
  • Assist building/care team staff in the initiation, facilitation and promotion of on-site activities, therapeutic support groups, outings and community meetings.
  • Documenting in housing service notes and UECL in Chasers
  • Participate in consumer feedback activities and meetings to ensure the client voice is integrated into program operations.
  • Proactively intervene in crises using de-escalation skills, respond to emergencies, and initiate action as required, including contact and collaborating with emergency response systems
  • Write significant events involving residents and building operations activities in a daily log; read log daily
  • Assist with unit turnovers, new resident leasing and orientation; rent collection and facilities inspections
  • Respond to resident complaints in a manner consistent with DESC values
  • Work cooperatively with staff at the project and with visiting providers and/or emergency responders when on site.
  • Escort emergency responders and/or outside vendors/providers through the building when on site. This includes but is not limited to capturing and logging pertinent data pertaining to fire alarms or any work related to visits from Emergency Responders during or at the end of each shift.
  • Initiate maintenance repairs by submitting work orders when noticed
  • Assist with new tenant moves ins
  • Participate in staff meetings and trainings
  • Responding to in unit emergencies, water shut off, remediation, and cleanup after significant events
  • Assist with maintaining a hygienic living environment including but limited to participating with in unit prep for pest inspections, and trash room clean up while on shift
  • Assist with grounds & common area upkeep. Ensuring cleanliness and safety of hallways, laundry rooms, lobbies, and outdoor areas
  • Assist with other property management functions as assigned by the site Project Manager or designated leadership team member

title: Driver
description:
Advance your career with us and be part of a mission-driven team delivering critical telecommunications and recovery solutions.
At InfraServices, we’re more than a services provider — we’re innovators, problem-solvers, and collaborators. Our culture is built on a foundation of safety first, guided by a customer-focused philosophy, and defined by excellence and integrity.
Here, every voice is heard, fresh ideas are celebrated, and exceptional talent is valued. We’re committed to building an employee experience rooted in trust, respect, continuous learning, and growth opportunities. Job Summary: The Driver supports operations by transporting equipment, materials, and supplies between warehouses, job sites, and vendor locations. This role ensures the timely, safe, and accurate delivery of materials to support field crews and project schedules, while maintaining compliance with all Department of Transportation (DOT) and Company safety standards.

• Organize and place materials on racks, shelves, or in bins according to predetermined sequences such as size, type, style, color, or product code
• Verify and document all material transfers to ensure alignment with project records and maintain delivery confirmations for completed shipments
• Support warehouse inventory control by conducting physical counts and reporting discrepancies
• Maintain a clean work environment in the warehouse and Company vehicle
• Adhere to Company and industry safety practices, including proper vehicle operation, load securement, and material-handling procedures
• Other duties as assigned

Qualifications: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty mentioned satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required.
Education: High school diploma, general education degree (G.E.D.), or related trade school education

Experience:
• One to two years of experience in warehouse operations and commercial driving
• Forklift certification preferred
• Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) preferred
• Experience in the telecommunications, construction, or utility services industries preferred

title: Director of Community Engagement
description:
Director of Community Engagement


The Grove Frisco | Frisco, TX

$80,000–$90,000 + Comprehensive Benefits + 16 Paid Holidays

Hiring range based on experience, skills, and qualifications.


Collaboration. Authenticity. Connection. Balance.


At Cohere, we believe community is the most valuable amenity. We do more than manage communities—we help create places where people connect, belong, and thrive. By partnering with some of the nation’s most innovative master-planned communities, we create places residents are proud to call home and where meaningful relationships flourish.


We’re looking for a Director of Community Engagement to join our team at The Grove Frisco, an award-winning, 735+ acre master-planned community designed around connection, recreation, wellness, and belonging. With thoughtfully designed homes, abundant green space, parks, trails, resort-style amenities, and a robust calendar of resident events and activities, The Grove Frisco is a place where community life is intentionally cultivated.


In this role, you’ll lead the community’s engagement and communications strategy, helping bring The Grove Frisco’s vision to life through meaningful resident experiences, strong relationships, thoughtful planning, and a highly connected Community Life team.

You’ll also serve as a trusted partner to residents, community leaders, developer partners, and the Board while creating opportunities that strengthen connection throughout the community.


This is an opportunity to shape how residents experience one of North Texas’s most dynamic master-planned communities while leading a team and building programs, partnerships, and systems designed for long-term community impact.


If you’re a relational leader who can pair big-picture vision with strong organization, thoughtful execution, and genuine enthusiasm for bringing people together, we’d love to meet you.


Why People Choose Cohere


The best communities are built by people who feel supported, valued, and empowered to do their best work. That’s why we invest in benefits, time away, and professional growth that help our team members thrive both personally and professionally.

Highlights include:

  • Medical coverage available on your first day
  • Employer-paid dental coverage
  • Vision coverage
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Employer-paid Life Insurance, AD&D, and Long-Term Disability coverage
  • Pet insurance options
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health, financial, legal, and family support resources
  • Travel assistance and identity theft protection
  • Complimentary will preparation services
  • Generous paid time off
  • 16 paid holidays each year, including a Birthday Day and Volunteer Day, in addition to PTO
  • Professional development and growth opportunities

What You’ll Do


Lead Community Engagement & Communications

  • Develop and execute engagement and communications strategies that strengthen connection across The Grove Frisco.
  • Create meaningful opportunities for residents, neighbors, partners, and stakeholders to connect through programs, events, volunteerism, clubs, committees, and other community-building initiatives.
  • Use resident feedback, surveys, and community data to help shape programming and engagement efforts.
  • Build relationships with resident leaders and volunteers and create opportunities for them to play an active role in community life.

Lead the Team & Drive Execution

  • Lead and develop the onsite Community Life team responsible for engagement programs and communications.
  • Establish clear priorities, systems, and plans that support consistent, high-quality execution.
  • Develop strategic plans and annual programs of work aligned with community goals.
  • Bring strong organization, follow-through, and attention to detail while managing multiple priorities and initiatives.

Build Strong Relationships & Partnerships

  • Serve as a trusted partner to the Executive Director, developer partners, Board of Directors, residents, and other key stakeholders.
  • Maintain open communication with the Board and provide professional guidance, updates, and reporting on matters affecting the community.
  • Cultivate relationships with local government, school districts, civic and social groups, nonprofit organizations, arts and cultural organizations, and other community partners.
  • Collaborate across Cohere and with the broader Texas engagement team to share resources, ideas, and best practices.

Manage Budgets, Programs & Resources

  • Develop and manage annual budgets that support approved community goals and programming priorities.
  • Monitor expenses and financial performance and identify thoughtful ways to maximize resources.
  • Identify and manage vendors supporting community programs and events, including pricing, contracts, insurance, and required documentation.
  • Coordinate permits, licensing, and other requirements to help ensure community activities comply with applicable regulations.

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years of experience in community-based organizations, nonprofit management, community operations, governance, community-building programs, or a related environment.
  • Direct experience working with and reporting to a Board of Directors.
  • 7+ years of experience supervising and leading professional staff.

  • Experience developing strategic management or leadership plans.
  • Financial acumen and experience preparing and monitoring budgets.
  • Experience working with volunteers, clubs, committees, neighborhood groups, or similar community stakeholders.

  • Community association management or HOA governance experience is highly desirable.
  • Real estate, community development, municipal government, public agency, marketing, communications, or public relations experience is beneficial.

Additional Requirements

  • This is an onsite position based at The Grove Frisco in Frisco, Texas.
  • Primary schedule is Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m., with flexibility to support some evenings, weekends, and holidays as community needs require.
  • Must have reliable transportation, a current driver’s license, and an acceptable driving record.
  • Must be able to frequently lift and/or move up to 30 pounds and be on your feet for extended periods.

title: Private Equity Intelligence - Lenders Associate
description:
Who are we?

Gain is on a mission to provide global visibility into private markets. Our industry-leading platform combines advanced AI technology with local-for-local research, delivering the highest quality intelligence on the companies and investors that matter most.

We serve 100% of MBB/Big Four advisories, clients representing over $1 trillion of private capital and more than 70% of the top-20 global M&A houses. Trusted by names like Blackstone, McKinsey and Goldman Sachs, we lead the market in client satisfaction with an NPS of 80+.

With offices in New York, Amsterdam, London, Frankfurt, Warsaw and Bangalore, we are one of Europe's fastest-growing companies, recognized in the Deloitte Technology Fast 500 EMEA 2024 and the FT1000: Europe's Fastest Growing Companies.


About the Lenders Team:

  • Private credit and fixed income sit at the center of how capital moves through private markets and today there's no single source of truth connecting lenders, credit and the companies they finance. Gain is building that layer.

  • The Lenders Team, part of Gain's Private Equity Intelligence (PEI) group, gives Gain users a structured view into the global credit and debt markets, including:
    - Comprehensive lender profiles, covering credit and debt details with breakdowns by sector, region and type
    - Credit data linked to companies, deals and investors
    - A growing roadmap of coverage across BDCs, broadly syndicated loans, corporate bonds, CLOs and credit ratings

  • This is still a young, foundational vertical. The data model, taxonomy and vendor integrations are being defined now, in close partnership with Product and Engineering, which means this role has real say in how the product gets built, not just how it gets maintained.

What will you do?

  • Own the Lenders data domain end-to-end across BDC, BSL, corporate bonds, CLO and MML, the core building blocks of private credit and fixed income.

  • Act as the subject matter expert on credit and fixed income data (capital structure, pricing mechanics, instrument and holder taxonomy) for the rest of the org.

  • Shape and prioritize the Lenders product roadmap, balancing new coverage against the depth and quality of what's already live.

  • Work with vendors to understand their data, translate it into Gain's data model, and take end-to-end ownership of linking it to Gain's company, deal and investor assets.

  • Resolve open data modeling questions end-to-end rather than just flagging them.

  • Lead process optimization for the team, using AI and automation to keep data workflows and trackers running cleanly as data volume scales.

  • Set priorities, sequence workstreams and keep delivery on pace against business priorities across the vertical.

  • Hire, coach and manage Analysts and Senior Analysts as the team grows and set the processes and quality bar they work to.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Product and Engineering, and represent the Lenders vertical in broader leadership conversations.

Who are you?

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in private credit, lending or fixed income data, gained in a research, data management or investment operations role.

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with lender, credit or debt data such as BDCs, broadly syndicated loans, CLOs or corporate bonds.

  • Strong project management skills: comfortable setting priorities, managing dependencies across vendors and engineering, and driving structured work in an ambiguous, still-being-built environment.

  • Strong people management skills: proven experience managing or building a team, beyond informal mentoring.

  • Comfortable working in structured data environments (internal data systems, spreadsheets and vendor feeds) with high attention to detail.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable conveying structured decisions and feedback to both your team and leadership.

  • Proactive, self-driven and thrives in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment.

What do we offer?

  • Ownership of a foundational, high-visibility vertical, with direct exposure to how leadership thinks about Gain's private credit and fixed income offering.

  • A ground-floor seat in defining how credit and lending data gets modeled and scaled at Gain, not just executing against an existing playbook.

  • A clear path from owning the data to building and running the team behind it.

  • Regular collaboration with Product, Engineering and senior leadership on a vertical that's still being actively shaped.

  • Competitive compensation with a performance and OKR-linked annual bonus.

  • A flexible, hybrid working model based out of our Bangalore office.

Does this sound like a perfect match?

We are proud of our wonderful product and believe it has lots of potential. We are growing fast and having fun while building our platform and company. Does this sound like a team you would like to become a part of? Reach out to us, we are excited to get to know you and show you what we do!

About DESC:

Recognized nationally as an innovator and leader in developing solutions to homelessness, DESC is a social services organization, supportive housing operator, and licensed behavioral health treatment provider focused on meeting the needs of people experiencing long-term homelessness and living with complex behavioral health and other medical conditions. Approximately 3,000 people are actively receiving services from DESC at any given point in time. Our vision is a community where all people are shown compassion, treated with dignity, and everyone has a safe, stable, and affordable place to call home.


DESC operates five shelter/emergency housing programs,19 permanent supportive housing facilities with over 1,750 units, several hundred additional scattered site apartments, and a range of behavioral health services including outpatient mental health and substance use disorder treatment, residential crisis stabilization, street outreach, mobile crisis response, and treatment for opioid use disorder.


JOB DEFINITION:

Crisis Solutions Center is a residential treatment facility that provides stabilization services to clients experiencing acute or ongoing behavioral health crises. Peer Specialists will work within a multi-disciplinary team and to create and implement detailed, client-centered care and safety plans; facilitate group and individual peer counseling; and ensure services are fully integrated with mental health, substance use, and primary care teams. They are an essential part of building rapport and developing positive relationships by relating to clients through their own lived experience. Peer Specialists will help develop and maintain a comprehensive list of community partners; participate in staff meetings and training; and maintain a safe and therapeutic environment.


MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assist participants with voicing their interests and goals through a variety of approaches including Goal Plans, Crisis Plans, WRAP and other methods that express the individual’s preferences for their recovery goals.
  • Participate in planning, organizing and co-facilitating of recovery skills and educational group treatment services
  • Advocate for client access to community resources and services; consult and collaborate with community providers to ensure continuity of care.
  • Use lived/personal experience with mental health and/or substance use to build connections with program participants; utilize a trauma informed approach to assist participants in their recovery.
  • Serve food, do laundry and change linens, help clean common areas, and occasionally clean up bodily fluids and biohazardous waste using appropriate PPE.
  • Provide phone consultation for referents to the CSC, monitor office security cameras, answer phone calls, and other administrative duties.
  • Maintain current and complete clinical and administrative records, including but not limited to goal planners, progress notes, safety and risk assessments, shift summary notes, and care-coordination between internal and/or external partners.
  • Demonstrate DESC core values and professionalism in all client and staff interactions; follow agency clinical policies and procedures; participate in quality assurance reviews when assigned
  • Participate in verbal de-escalation in emergent situations and be willing and able to assist other staff as needed to maintain a safe and secure environment.
  • Provide transportation for clients (such as appointments outside of CSC) when needed.
  • Attend a 2-week onboarding process upon hire, as well as other full-day trainings on an ongoing basis.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines across SaaS (web/backend) and mobile (iOS/Android) codebases, covering build, test, packaging, and deployment stages.
  • Own release automation for mobile — versioning, code signing, provisioning profiles, phased rollouts, and App Store/Play Store submissions — and for SaaS — automated deploys, environment promotion, and rollback procedures.
  • Define and maintain branching strategies (trunk-based, GitFlow, release trains, etc.) appropriate to each platform's release cadence and risk profile.
  • Manage artifact repositories and dependency management (e.g., Artifactory, Nexus, npm/Maven/CocoaPods registries) — versioning, retention, promotion, and access control.
  • Own changelog and release notes generation and distribution — automating changelog creation from commit history/PRs and coordinating release communications with product and support teams.
  • Coordinate release trains and hotfix processes across multiple teams, balancing SaaS's continuous deployment cadence against mobile's app-store review and rollout constraints.
  • Build and maintain build infrastructure (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CircleCI, Fastlane, Codemagic, Bitrise) and keep it fast, reliable, and well-monitored.
  • Implement and enforce environment and configuration management practices (secrets, feature flags, environment parity) across pipelines.
  • Monitor build and release health — build times, failure rates, deployment frequency, rollback rates — and drive improvements to release velocity and reliability.
  • Partner with mobile and SaaS engineering teams to troubleshoot build failures, flaky tests, and pipeline bottlenecks.
  • Establish and document build/release standards, runbooks, and change-management processes.
  • Mentor engineers on CI/CD practices, release hygiene, and build tooling as needed.

What You'll Bring

  • 4-7+ years of experience in build/release engineering, DevOps, or a related role, with direct experience supporting both mobile and SaaS/web release pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CircleCI, GitLab CI, Fastlane, Codemagic, or Bitrise.
  • Experience with mobile release mechanics — code signing, provisioning profiles/certificates, App Store Connect and Google Play Console submission processes, and phased/staged rollouts.
  • Experience with SaaS deployment models — blue/green or canary deployments, environment promotion (dev/staging/prod), containerized deployments (Docker/Kubernetes), and rollback strategies.
  • Strong working knowledge of branching strategies (trunk-based development, GitFlow, release branching) and how to choose/adapt them to team and platform needs.
  • Experience with artifact and package management tools (Artifactory, Nexus, npm registry, Maven, CocoaPods, or similar), including versioning and dependency governance.
  • Experience building automated changelog/release notes generation (e.g., from conventional commits, PR metadata, or tools like semantic-release, release-please).
  • Solid scripting/programming ability (Python, Bash, Groovy, Ruby, or similar) for build automation and tooling.
  • Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and Git-based workflows at scale, including monorepo/multi-repo considerations.
  • Understanding of infrastructure-as-code and configuration management (Terraform, Ansible, or similar) as applied to build/release infrastructure.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and comfort owning incidents related to failed builds, broken releases, or blocked deployments.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to coordinate release timing and expectations across engineering, product, and support stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with feature flag/experimentation platforms (LaunchDarkly, Optimizely, or similar) as part of release management.
  • Experience with cross-platform mobile frameworks (Flutter, React Native) and how they affect build/release pipelines.
  • Familiarity with observability and release health tooling (Datadog, Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry) to correlate releases with incidents.
  • Experience operating in a compliance-conscious environment (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA) with audit-friendly release processes.
  • Prior experience mentoring engineers or leading build/release standards across a growing team.

title: Product Manager, First Mile AI
description:
Senior/Staff/Principal Product Manager, First Mile AI

Department: Product Management

Location: San Francisco (hybrid), Toronto (hybrid)

Compensation: $177,650 – $273,370 • Offers Equity • Multiple Ranges

Employment Type: FullTime

EvenUp is on a mission to close the justice gap using technology and AI. We empower personal injury lawyers and victims to get the justice they deserve. Our products enable law firms to secure faster settlements, higher payouts, and better outcomes for victims injured through no fault of their own in vehicle collisions, accidents, natural disasters, and more.

We are one of the fastest-growing vertical SaaS companies in history, and we are just getting started. EvenUp is backed by top VCs, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Bain Capital Ventures, SignalFire, and Lightspeed. We are looking to expand our team with talented, driven, and collaborative individuals who seek to have a lasting impact. Learn more at www.evenuplaw.com.

We’re looking for a Senior/Staff/Principal Product Manager to build the future of how law firms acquire new clients, shaping our emerging leads product from the ground up. You'll own the first mile of the personal injury journey, looking after the experience for people during the worst day of their lives.

You will define and lead the buildout of the product experience that ensures people who are injured are connected with the best lawyers, to ultimately get the justice that they deserve.

You’ll be on the Case Lifecycle product team, reporting to the Head of Case Lifecycle, JJ Miclat. Our group conceives, builds, architects, launches, and grows EvenUp’s suite of applications for law firms that tackles the personal injury case experience end-to-end from leads (the new plaintiff intake experience), to matters (cases), all the way to proceedings (litigation), and settlement/disbursement. You’ll be focused on leading and crafting 0-1 experiences around our very nascent (albeit burgeoning) leads product that helps law firms intake, qualify, and acquire new plaintiffs, with quality and at scale. This product serves as the initial catalyst between the dynamic partnership between plaintiffs and law firms. The ideal candidate knows how to take complex user problems and transform them into elegant, AI-powered workflows that people actually use.


This is a role for someone who has shipped B2B SaaS products end-to-end, operates as a systems thinker, is obsessed with customer workflows, and successfully launched LLM/LMM based products that are well loved by the market. You'll own the product experience for the very top-of-funnel for the personal injury law firms that we work with, working closely with engineering, design, data science, product marketing, and product operations to ensure that those that are injured are connected with the best lawyers, to ultimately get the justice that they deserve.


This is a hybrid role based out of our San Francisco or Toronto offices, with an expectation of at least 3 days per week in office.

What you'll do:

  • Own the full product lifecycle for the leads/intake experience for law firms, from discovery and definition through launch and iteration.

  • Conceptualize, build, ship, and optimize products around lead qualification, outbound marketing for firms, agents for inbound lead qualification and intake, and bi-directional referral workflows.

  • Deeply understand how legal teams work, identifying friction points and translating them into product decisions that drive meaningful workflow improvements.

  • Partner with engineering and ML teams to build LLM-powered conversational AI and automated scribes that are reliable, accurate, and genuinely useful to case managers, paralegals, and lawyers.

  • Define and track success metrics, using both qualitative research and quantitative analysis to continuously improve the product.

  • Collaborate with design, customer success, and go-to-market teams to ensure smooth launches and tight feedback loops post-release.

What we look for:

  • 4 to 7+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, with a track record of shipping products for both enterprise and SMB customers that have garnered meaningful adoption.

  • Hands-on experience building and shipping AI-powered products, with direct working knowledge of agents and LLMs/LMMs. This is a requirement, not a bonus.

  • You love solving intricately complex problems and applying system thinking to craft scalable solutions.

  • Strong user research instincts -- you know how to uncover what users actually need, not just what they ask for.

  • Proven ability to take a product from concept through launch in a cross-functional environment.

  • Clear communicator who can translate between technical complexity and user experience.

  • Comfortable moving fast in a high-growth environment where priorities shift and ambiguity is part of the job.

  • Conviction that agentic technology, when bounded by tight guardrails, can be architected to be the ultimate arbiter around how justice is served when it comes to legal matters.

  • High agency, tenacity, and deep empathy towards your customers. Takes work seriously, but doesn’t take themselves too seriously.

Benefits & Perks:

As part of our total rewards package, we offer attractive benefits and perks to our employees, including:

  • Choice of medical, dental, and vision insurance plans for you and your family.

  • Additional insurance coverage options for life, accident, or critical illness.

  • Flexible paid time off, sick leave, short-term and long-term disability.

  • 10 US observed holidays, and Canadian statutory holidays by province.

  • A home office stipend.

  • 401(k) for US-based employees and RRSP for Canada-based employees.

  • Paid parental leave.

  • A local in-person meet-up program.

  • Hubs in San Francisco and Toronto.

(Please note the above benefits & perks are for full-time employees)

Notice to Candidates:

To ensure fairness and proper consideration, we do not accept resumes or expressions of interest via email or social media messages. If you’re interested in a role, please submit your application directly through our careers page.

Please note that EvenUp may use AI notetakers and other recording devices in the recruiting process. If you interview with us, with your consent, we may record your conversations and summarize them into notes for internal use. Recording is optional, and declining will not affect your candidacy.

EvenUp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to diversity and inclusion in our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Senior Characterization & Verification Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Littelfuse (NASDAQ: LFUS) is a diversified industrial technology manufacturing company shaping solutions for the safe and efficient transfer of electrical energy. Headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, USA, we serve customers across industrial, transportation, and electronics markets worldwide. With approximately 16,000 employees we design and manufacture innovative technologies that support electrification, energy efficiency, and advanced automation. Our global reach is matched by a culture that empowers innovation and long-term growth. Guided by our principles We Care, We Succeed With Our Customers, and We Own the Outcome, we work collaboratively, think boldly, and deliver solutions that move industries forward.

As a Senior Characterization & Verification Engineer (m/f/d), you will join our Power Semiconductor team and play a key role in the characterization and verification of advanced power semiconductor devices, including SiC Schottky Diodes, SiC MOSFETs, Si MOSFETs, and IGBTs. In this position, you will drive the automation and standardization of measurement systems across global sites while contributing to innovation and technical excellence.

About the Position

  • Lead and execute characterization and verification of power semiconductor devices to ensure comprehensive functional coverage.

  • Collaborate with design leaders and product definers to develop test specifications and verification plans.

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize automated test setups and measurement systems to improve efficiency and repeatability.

  • Analyze measurement results and prepare technical reports for datasheets and internal design documentation.

  • Conduct design verification reviews in alignment with international standards.

  • Drive global alignment of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across characterization laboratories.

  • Identify and implement best practices in measurement methodologies, automation, and data analysis.

  • Troubleshoot test failures, define corrective actions, and support implementation activities.

About You

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Semiconductor Technology, or a related discipline.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in semiconductor device characterization or a related field.

  • Proven expertise in electrical power semiconductor characterization, including Si, SiC and GaN technologies.

  • Strong experience with electrical measurement equipment such as oscilloscopes, parameter analyzers, and PXI systems.

  • Experience with statistical data analysis and measurement system evaluation.

  • Advanced understanding of measurement circuit design, high-speed switching behavior, and thermal characterization methods.

  • Knowledge of IEC 60747 and JEDEC standards, including thermal measurement methodologies such as Rth/Zth analysis.

  • Experience with automated test development using Python, MATLAB, LabVIEW, C, C++, or C#.

  • Experience with PCB design and test fixture development.

  • Deep understanding of high di/dt and dv/dt events and their implications in test environments.

  • Experience working in a global laboratory environment with cross-site collaboration.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to effectively communicate technical findings.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and drive process improvements.

  • Passion for mentoring and developing talent within a collaborative and inclusive environment.

  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a hands-on approach to problem solving.

For this position, we offer a gross annual salary of approximately €80,000 to €100,000. The final compensation package will be determined based on your experience, qualifications, and technical expertise.

Guided by our culture principles, our teams work together to deliver value for customers and make a positive impact in the communities where we operate. This strategic, fractional role combines enterprise Salesforce architecture with advanced LLM engineering to lead high-level technical discovery, design agentic workflows, and oversee production deployments for enterprise clients across Europe.

Rather than a standard full-time commitment, this role provides high-leverage advisory engagements and project-based execution, with the potential to evolve into a full-time principal position as engagements scale. This is a hands-on technical lead role, not a Salesforce admin position.

A. Agentforce Architecture & System Design

  • Solution Architecture: Translate complex enterprise business processes into end-to-end agentic workflows (Intent $\rightarrow$ Agent $\rightarrow$ Context $\rightarrow$ Reasoning $\rightarrow$ Actions $\rightarrow$ Systems $\rightarrow$ Outcome).

D. Testing, Security & Strategic Advisory

  • Testing & Quality Assurance: Drive automated testing and multi-turn conversation tracing using the Agentforce Testing Center.
  • Security & Guardrails: Design least-privilege agent permissions, FLS/sharing rules, prompt injection protections, and human-in-the-loop escalation paths.
  • Client & Team Leadership: Lead technical discovery with European enterprise stakeholders and guide cross-functional engineering teams.

Requirements

  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce engineering and architecture experience.
  • Agentforce Track Record: At least 2 meaningful production or advanced pre-production Agentforce implementations.
  • Location: Based in Europe with strong alignment with European enterprise hours.
  • Core Tech Stack: Deep proficiency in Salesforce Agentforce (Studio/DX), Apex, Flow, Data Cloud, REST APIs, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.

title: Senior Data Security Engineer
description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

**For this opportunity, the business is flexible to hire at Senior Consultant, Lead Consultant, and Expert level depending on qualifications & interview evaluation.**

The Senior Data Protection Security Engineer will lead the evolution of enterprise data protection from a traditional tool administration model to an engineering-driven security capability. This role is responsible for building scalable, automated, and measurable data protection solutions across cloud, SaaS, endpoint, email, and collaboration environments using Policy-as-Code, Security-as-Code, DevOps, and DevSecOps practices.

The successful candidate will bring a proven track record of modernizing Data Protection, DLP, CASB, or Information Protection programs by reducing manual processes, increasing automation, and implementing repeatable governance and deployment models. This individual will serve as a key contributor in advancing the organization's data protection strategy while driving operational excellence, security effectiveness, and business enablement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Engineer enterprise DLP controls across endpoint, email, SaaS, cloud storage, collaboration platforms, network, and web channels.

  • Modernize DLP policy deployment by moving from manual console-based changes to version-controlled, automated, and repeatable policy-as-code workflows.

  • Build CI/CD pipelines for data protection policy lifecycle management, including peer review, automated validation, testing, approval, deployment, and rollback.

  • Develop reusable policy templates, detection logic, exception patterns, configuration baselines, and deployment standards across multiple DLP and CASB platforms.

  • Automate operational tasks such as policy promotion, configuration drift detection, control validation, reporting, alert enrichment, and recurring health checks.

  • Integrate DLP, CASB, data classification, cloud security, identity, SIEM, SOAR, and workflow platforms to improve visibility, response, and enforcement.

  • Tune detection logic using data-driven analysis to reduce false positives, improve signal quality, and increase confidence in policy enforcement.

  • Design guardrails for sensitive data usage across Microsoft 365, cloud platforms, source code repositories, collaboration tools, SaaS applications, and enterprise endpoints.

  • Partner with engineering, cloud, infrastructure, network, compliance, privacy, legal, and business teams to design practical data protection solutions.

  • Investigate data protection events, identify root cause, recommend control improvements, and convert lessons learned into automated prevention patterns.

  • Define and maintain metrics, KPIs, dashboards, and control evidence that demonstrate risk reduction, policy effectiveness, deployment quality, and operational maturity.

  • Support platform upgrades, capability expansions, vendor integrations, and new data protection control patterns using disciplined engineering practices.


Key Qualifications

  • 4+ years delivering enterprise Data Protection, Information Protection, Cloud Security, or Security Engineering capabilities within complex organizations.

  • Proven experience in Policy-as-Code, Security-as-Code, and DevSecOps methodologies, with a demonstrated ability to automate security control deployment and governance at enterprise scale.

  • Track record of replacing manual operational processes with engineering-driven solutions through automation, APIs, Infrastructure-as-Code, and platform engineering practices.

  • Advanced knowledge of Data Loss Prevention (DLP), data classification, information protection, and data governance principles.

  • Hands-on expertise with Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Information Protection, Defender for Cloud Apps, and the Microsoft 365 security ecosystem.

  • Comprehensive understanding of cloud, SaaS, CASB, and enterprise data protection architectures.

  • Proficiency in scripting and automation technologies including PowerShell, Python, REST APIs, Terraform, Bicep, YAML, JSON, or comparable tools.

  • Demonstrated success in modernizing Data Protection, DLP, CASB, or Information Protection programs through automation, standardization, and engineering-driven operating models.

  • Proven ability to implement and scale DevOps, DevSecOps, or Platform Engineering practices within security organizations.

  • Track record of leading large-scale security initiatives that improve control effectiveness, operational efficiency, and measurable risk reduction.

  • Background supporting enterprise-scale cloud, SaaS, or Microsoft 365 environments.

  • Knowledge of regulatory, privacy, and compliance requirements and their implementation through scalable technical controls.

description:
What’s This Position About?

We are hiring a WordPress Content Publishing Specialist with junior-level front-end development skills. This person will publish and format at least 100 pieces of content monthly, each containing at least four images.

This is more technical than a basic content-upload position. Candidates must confidently navigate different WordPress environments, including custom ACF layouts, Elementor, Gutenberg and custom templates. Working knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript is required.


Who Will This Role Work With?

The specialist will work with our SEO managers, account managers, writers, editors and web-development support. They must communicate progress, identify missing information and promptly report technical problems.

Charm Security is building the first agentic AI workforce for scams and human-centric fraud. Our AI agents work alongside fraud teams at Tier 1 banks in North America: investigating cases, guiding frontline teams through high-risk interactions as they happen, and gathering intelligence beyond the organization's perimeter.

We do it by understanding manipulation, intent, and human behavior, through our proprietary HVE™ (Human Vulnerabilities and Exploits) framework, which combines fraud expertise with behavioral psychology. That's how we take institutions from detection to action.

We're looking for an Applied AI Researcher to build the agents and models behind that platform. This role suits a data scientist or AI researcher who wants their research to ship: someone energized by deploying AI at scale, working under real-time and adversarial constraints, and seeing the impact on people who would otherwise have lost their savings.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and evaluate the AI agents at the core of our platform, across fraud investigation, frontline guidance, and threat intelligence.
  • Model how manipulation actually works: adapt and fine-tune LLMs to recognize intent, deception, and coercion in real conversations.
  • Build scalable, real-time pipelines that turn behavioral signals, case data, and the alerts our customers already generate into decisions our agents can act on.
  • Optimize AI models for latency, accuracy, and adaptability in high-volume fraud prevention use cases.
  • Work AI-natively. Use coding agents and AI tooling to prototype, experiment, and ship faster.
  • Stay at the forefront of LLMs, ML, and AI research, implementing the latest advancements in those fields.


Requirements

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in Data Science, AI, or NLP, preferably in fraud detection, security, or fintech.
  • MSc in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • Strong experience with agentic techniques and ML tooling.
  • Hands-on experience building, evaluating, and shipping AI agents, not only prototyping them.
  • Fluent with AI-assisted development (coding agents, LLM tooling) as part of how you actually work day to day.
  • Experience bringing a product from ideation to production, and owning it end to end.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and ownership: early-stage pace, end-to-end responsibility.

Nice to Have

  • Background in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, fraud, or financial crime AI.
  • Experience with RAG and vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector) and AI-driven search.
  • Experience working with financial institutions or in regulated, enterprise-scale data environments.
  • Familiarity with privacy-preserving AI or federated learning.

This is a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of AI-driven fraud prevention, building the agentic workforce that stands between the world's largest banks' customers and the people trying to manipulate them. 🚀

title: Jetty Operator - Grays
description:
Could you be the person we’re looking for to join our team in Grays as our new Jetty Operator? We want to hear from you!

The Jetty Operator is responsible for supporting safe, compliant and efficient jetty operations for Marine & Terminal Services clients.

The role provides a key operational link between vessels, terminals and the MATS team, ensuring vessel attendance, cargo transfer activities, documentation, communication, security duties and QHSSE requirements are completed to the required standard.

The role is essential in maintaining service quality, avoiding vessel delays and supporting customer satisfaction.

What would your day at GAC look like?

  • Ensuring vessels are safely berthed, correctly moored, and aligned with shore loading arms and terminal connections.

  • Carrying out pre-berth checks and managing the connection and disconnection of marine loading arms and hoses, including supporting lifting operations using cranes. This involves working both shoreside and onboard vessels.

  • Operating valves and monitoring vessel discharge operations ensuring all hourly and safety checks are being completed.

  • Completing and distributing operational documentation, including pre-berth and post-sailing checklists, jetty operator logs, handover reports, hourly checks, and security records.

  • Acting as a key link between internal and external stakeholders, ensuring information is communicated professionally and efficiently.

  • Carrying out all required security checks within agreed timescales and ensuring security documentation is completed accurately and submitted to the appropriate parties.

  • Participating in internal and external training programmes, keeping competencies up to date and ensuring training records are maintained accurately.

  • Promoting a positive safety culture by reporting hazards, near misses, incidents and safety concerns promptly.

  • Travelling to a variety of locations as required to deliver terminal and marine services

What are we looking for?

  • Minimum of 2 years’ industry experience

  • Jetty or terminal experience desired but not necessary as full training will be provided

  • Strong communication skills

  • Good understanding and appreciation of a proactive safety culture

  • Full, clean driving license with access to your own transport

  • Comfortable working outdoors in a marine environment and undertaking practical operational duties

  • Willingness to travel between sites (travel costs are covered)

The position requires flexibility to work days, nights and weekends.

Full-time hours are 156 hours per month, over 7 days with a competitive salary plus potential bonus and overtime.

What’s in it for you?

This is your chance to become part of the global GAC team which has been providing professional shipping, logistics and marine services since 1956. Everything we do is guided by the GAC Spirit, built on mutual loyalty between management and staff, and a belief in the value of our people as individuals - not just for the jobs they do.

With more than 7,500 colleagues in 300 strategically located offices in more than 50 countries around the world, we focus on quality, safety and sustainability with a human touch. Emphasising a long-term approach, innovation and ethics, our flexible and integrated portfolios are designed to work within and support our customers’ operations.

As our Jetty Operator in Grays, you will have the opportunity to work as part of a team who apply the highest standard of customer services to everything we do and aim to be industry leaders within all the sectors we serve.

GAC UK gives you the opportunity to work for an employer who is committed to offering all our staff an enjoyable and rewarding career, with significant training and development prospects.

You will also enjoy:

  • 38 days’ annual leave per year (inclusive of bank holidays) plus a day off on your birthday

  • Access to Vitality at Work Scheme

  • Company pension

  • Life assurance

  • Eyecare scheme

  • Employee assistance programme

  • Enhanced maternity and paternity benefits

  • Retail discounts scheme


In 2021, we launched our ten-year sustainability programme – MARS30. We are committed to “growing long term customer relationships across multiple products, whilst significantly reducing our environmental impact, improving the well-being of our people, and influencing our stakeholders to do the same.” We will accomplish our by mission by completing objectives aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

At GAC UK, who you are is just as important as what you do. The GAC Spirit reflects our culture across the company, emphasising loyalty and understanding between management and staff. We recognise that people’s lives extend far beyond their jobs. By promoting a healthy combination of work and play we achieve a happier workforce, delivering service excellence. We have a team of Mental Health First Aiders across the UK and a Wellbeing Working Group who meet monthly and regularly launch new internal wellbeing initiatives.

We’re passionate about diversity and inclusion, and we received Maritime UK Diversity in Maritime Charter Status in 2021, reflecting our commitment to taking real steps to improve diversity in our organisation.

In January 2026, Campaign Against Living Miserably (CALM) became our official Charity of the Year. Throughout the year, we will be raising funds to support CALM’s life‑saving suicide prevention helpline.

We’re looking forward to hearing from you.

Disclaimer:

Please note that as well as working to recruit staff members via GAC channels, GAC does use third-party recruiters to recruit for specific positions within the Group. Please do however, be aware of unaffiliated recruiters purporting to represent GAC that ask for payment in return for facilitating interviews. A genuine third-party recruiter working with GAC will never ask for payment to facilitate an interview. If you would like to make an application to join GAC, please always ensure to apply through our official channels on or our LinkedIn listing

title: Strategic Communications Specialist
description:
The Strategic Communications Specialist supports organizational communication efforts by developing and distributing compelling content that promotes Blue Learning’s mission, programs, campuses, and initiatives.

This position is responsible for creating written and digital content for a variety of audiences, managing select social media activities, supporting media relations efforts, and helping maintain a consistent brand presence across multiple communication channels. The Strategic Communications Specialist collaborates with departments across the organization to identify and share stories that highlight student success, educational programs, and organizational achievements.

Content Development and Communications

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Senior Software Engineer

Location: United States, San Mateo, CA

Department: Admin (PE)

Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Senior Software Engineer – Telemetry, Observability & Platform Analytics

Overview

The PlayStation Portal Platform team is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to lead Telemetry, Observability, and Platform Analytics initiatives that drive platform performance, stability, reliability, and operational excellence.

In this role, you will be responsible for defining and executing the telemetry strategy for PlayStation Portal (AOSP-based), including architecture design, data collection frameworks, analytics platforms, dashboard development, and automation. You will enable data-driven decision-making across the organization and help continuously improve platform quality and user experience.

You will work closely with Engineering, Quality Engineering (QE), Security, and Infrastructure teams to leverage data collected from millions of devices, identify opportunities for improvement, and deliver outstanding platform experiences for our users.

Key Responsibilities

Telemetry Architecture & Strategy

  • Define and drive the overall telemetry strategy across the platform
  • Establish KPIs for performance, stability, reliability, and security
  • Design and standardize platform telemetry data models and collection mechanisms
  • Design and implement Telemetry SDKs and data collection frameworks
  • Define data quality, schema management, and versioning strategies

Observability & Analytics Platform

  • Design and implement platform observability architectures
  • Build and manage unified Metrics, Events, and Traces pipelines
  • Develop real-time and batch analytics platforms
  • Enable engineering teams with scalable analytics and insights infrastructure
  • Drive data-informed quality improvements and operational excellence

Dashboard & Reporting

  • Design and develop Platform Health Dashboards
  • Visualize key performance, stability, and reliability metrics
  • Build reporting solutions for engineering leadership and executive stakeholders
  • Automate anomaly detection, trend analysis, and reporting workflows

Automation & CI/CD Integration

  • Automate telemetry validation and quality monitoring
  • Integrate quality and performance metrics into CI/CD pipelines
  • Develop automated performance regression detection systems
  • Automate benchmark execution and results collection
  • Define, implement, and maintain quality gates

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with QE teams to define and evolve quality metrics
  • Collaborate with Platform teams to implement telemetry collection mechanisms
  • Work with Security teams to design security-related metrics and monitoring
  • Partner with Infrastructure teams to optimize analytics and observability platforms

Required Qualifications

  • Genuine passion for creating outstanding user experiences and relentlessly improving platform performance, reliability, and quality through data-driven analysis and optimization
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of Android native development experience with strong expertise in Java, Kotlin, and Android Studio
  • Experience designing and implementing Telemetry and Observability systems
  • Experience developing Android/AOSP platform software
  • Experience building Metrics, Monitoring, and Analytics platforms
  • Experience using performance analysis and profiling tools (e.g., Android Studio Profiler, Perfetto, Systrace, atrace) for performance measurement, profiling, root cause analysis, and optimization at scale across system and application layers
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience leading technical initiatives in Agile development environments and collaborating effectively with cross-functional engineering teams
  • Proficiency in one or more of the following programming languages: Python, Java, Kotlin, or C++
  • Experience with dashboarding, visualization, and reporting tools
  • Experience designing and developing large-scale distributed systems

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with observability platforms such as Grafana, Kibana, Datadog, or similar tools
  • Experience with large-scale analytics platforms such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Spark, or equivalent technologies
  • Experience implementing and operating OpenTelemetry-based solutions
  • Experience developing consumer electronics products or gaming devices
  • Experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) or Reliability Engineering
  • Experience building machine learning-based anomaly detection systems
  • Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks such as React, React Native, Angular, or similar technologies
  • Experience designing and developing responsive user interfaces and dynamic web applications

At SIE, we consider several factors when setting each role’s base pay range, including the competitive benchmarking data for the market and geographic location.

Please note that the base pay range may vary in line with our hybrid working policy and individual base pay will be determined based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

In addition, this role is eligible for SIE’s top-tier benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), paid time off, wellness program and coveted employee discounts for Sony products. This role also may be eligible for a bonus package. Click here to learn more.

$193,300—$289,900 USD

Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.
