title: Part-Time Provider (Physician/NP/PA) - Night Shift
description:
Schedule: Three (3) 12-hour shifts with at least a 30-minute lunch break, 7:00 pm – 7:30 am, over a two-week period.

Supervised by: ORCA Center Senior Medical Lead Physician

Insurance Benefits: Medical, Dental, Life, Long-term Disability

Other Benefits: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), ORCA card subsidy, Paid Time Off (17 days per year), Retirement Plan

Union Representation: This position is a part of a union and is represented by SEIU Healthcare 1199NW


About DESC:

Recognized nationally as an innovator and leader in developing solutions to homelessness, DESC is a social services organization, supportive housing operator, and licensed behavioral health treatment provider focused on meeting the needs of people experiencing long-term homelessness and living with complex behavioral health and other medical conditions. Approximately 3,000 people are actively receiving services from DESC at any given point in time. Our vision is a community where all people are shown compassion, treated with dignity, and everyone has a safe, stable, and affordable place to call home.


DESC operates five shelter/emergency housing programs, 19 permanent supportive housing facilities with over 1,750 units, several hundred additional scattered site apartments, and a range of behavioral health services including outpatient mental health and substance use disorder treatment, residential crisis stabilization, street outreach, mobile crisis response, and treatment for opioid use disorder.


JOB OVERVIEW:

This role will provide direct clinical care within the DESC Opioid Recovery and Care Access (ORCA) Center. The ORCA Center is open 24 hours per day, 7 days per week, including holidays. It offers four overlapping types of services, delivered by a team of prescribers, nurses, medical assistants and peer specialists, with operational leadership support:

  • Care to individuals in stable condition who have experienced an opioid overdose, brought to the ORCA Center by first responders or transferred from local emergency departments.
  • Rapid initiation of medications for opioid use disorder (MOUD), including buprenorphine (sublingual and long-acting injectable) and methadone (under the “72-hour rule”, or Code of Federal regulations Title 21 §1306.07 (b)), for people with opioid use disorder (OUD), regardless of whether an opioid overdose has recently occurred.
  • Harm reduction counseling and OUD-related physical and behavioral health services, such as hepatitis C testing and treatment and HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis.
  • Follow-up care, at the ORCA Center or at times field-based, with individuals who have started MOUD to ensure support in MOUD continuation.

This is a clinical role without administrative or supervisory duties.


PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Clinical Care

  • Provide evidence-based treatment for OUD, including initiation and management of buprenorphine (sublingual and long-acting injectable) and, according to DESC protocols, methadone initiation.
  • Conduct harm reduction counseling and provide services related to infectious diseases such as syphilis, hepatitis C, and HIV (including PrEP).
  • Manage and treat conditions commonly seen in individuals with OUD, such as skin and soft tissue infections and linkage to mental health care.
  • Perform initial health assessments and follow-up visits for individuals starting or continuing MOUD.
  • Educate patients on health-related topics, treatment plans, and harm reduction strategies.
  • Document clinical care in accordance with DESC and regulatory standards.

Care Coordination

  • Collaborate with an interdisciplinary team of clinicians, peer specialists, and social workers to provide holistic care.
  • Ensure continuity of care for individuals transitioning between ORCA Center services and other health care providers.

Professional Development

  • Stay updated on best practices in addiction medicine and harm reduction through continuing education.
  • Participate in in-service training and case discussions to maintain high clinical standards.

title: Commercial Loan Processor & Closer III
description:
Job Summary Overview

This position serves a critical function within the origination process by coordinating with members, lenders, sales agents, and title companies, and collaborating cross-functionally to ensure an efficient and timely closing process in alignment with strict deadlines. Responsible for analyzing business loan structures to determine the appropriate due diligence required in alignment with risk, policy, and regulatory guidelines. Ensures loans are documented and funded in accordance with the credit approval and purchase contract. This position delivers an excellent member experience, both internally and externally, while ensuring all compliance requirements are fully met.


Essential Job Functions

  • Demonstrates expert-level understanding of lien perfection and entity formation documentation.
  • Handles high-complexity and nonstandard transactions with layered entities, collateral, or legal documentation.
  • Operates autonomously, exercises advanced judgement to resolve nonstandard issues independently and escalates exceptions as needed.
  • Proactively balances multiple files and identifies potential delays.
  • Responsible for maintaining the minimum accuracy scores required for this position.
  • Collaborates with legal counsel on complex transactions that involve layered entities, attorney-prepared documentation, and unique collateral structures.
  • Demonstrates advanced proficiency in systems (LaserPro, Sageworks, Silverlake, Symitar).
  • Manages complex priorities with a high level of independence while ensuring consistent, timely completion.
  • Reviews and understands the loan approval to determine borrower, collateral, guarantor, loan structure requirements, determines due diligence requirements and prepares a closing checklist accordingly.
  • Analyze complex business loan structures to determine due diligence requirements.
  • Understands, determines, and obtains appropriate approval for compliance requirements, such as Commercial Customer Identification Program (CIP), BSA, ECOA, OFAC, etc.
  • Serves as a liaison between the borrower(s), sales, credit, underwriting, portfolio management, loan servicing, external partners, and 3rd party vendors ensuring the credit union meets closing deadlines and expectations.
  • Orders and reviews third party reports, such as preliminary title reports, flood certifications, Certificate of Good Standing, UCC searches, site visits, insurance certificates, lien/judgment reports, and any other required reports, as necessary.
  • Promptly and accurately determines when underwriting approval conditions have been satisfied or takes appropriate corrective action to resolve discrepancies while escalating questions or disputes to appropriate personnel when necessary.
  • Responsible for managing multiple workflows and advancing each stage as the loan progresses toward closing.
  • Prepares the loan funding package and disbursement by drafting lender’s instructions, reviewing settlement statements, completes a verbal verification of wiring instructions and balances the loan disbursement with escrow/title.
  • Coordinates the loan closing with all internal and external parties to ensure funding deadlines and expectations are met.
  • Submits loan files for Quality Control Review and resolves discrepancies prior to requesting loan documentation from the documentation team.
  • Reviews draft loan documentation to identify and resolve documentation errors such as dates, vesting, legal descriptions, signatory blocks, and other relevant data to ensure accuracy prior to releasing drafts documents to the sales team.
  • Manages workload by reviewing pipeline reports, providing weekly updates, and tracking work in progress to ensure internal (SLAs) are met.
  • Processes Adverse Actions requests as assigned.
  • Reviews executed loan documents to verify signatures, dates, and other relevant data prior to funding, and verifies closing conditions are met.
  • Organizes electronic files according to standards and understands the loan origination system.
  • Inputs applicable ticklers prior to boarding and ensures timely collection of post close trailing documents such as, UCC-1 fixture filings, recorded DOT, subordinations, leases, and final title policies.
  • Files originals documents in the vault upon receipt.
  • Ensures all documents are accurately filed within the centralized documentation system (Synergy).
  • Focuses on learning, accuracy and consistency and serves as subject matter expert in commercial closing.
  • Serves as a resource and coach to junior staff; supports onboarding and training.
  • Partners with leadership to implement procedural refinements and efficiency improvements.
  • Must be able to perform all responsibilities under general supervision.
  • Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

title: Vendor Management Lead
description:
We're looking for a Vendor Management Lead to take ownership of contracts and drive best-in-class vendor and contract management across E.ON Next.

In this role, you'll be responsible for leading the full contract lifecycle ensuring alignment with business needs and regulatory standards. You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams to manage supplier relationships, oversee spend and mitigate commercial and operational risks.

This role requires monthly travel to Nottingham or partner sites, with the potential for overseas trips.

Here’s a taste of what you’ll be doing

  • Establish and maintain standardised contract and vendor management practices, including spend tracking, governance frameworks, and adherence to procurement policies to prevent maverick spend.

  • Draft, negotiate, and manage vendor contracts and schedules, ensuring alignment with E.ON Next’s operational needs, commercial objectives, and regulatory requirements.

  • Monitor and manage vendor performance and compliance, implementing regular review cadences, validating risk/reward outcomes, and ensuring contracts remain fit for purpose

  • Collaborate with Supply Chain and other stakeholders on tenders, procurement activities, and contract change management, ensuring robust risk assessment and governance throughout.

  • Lead commercial processes including PR/PO, GRN, and invoice validation, ensuring accuracy, appropriate fund allocation, and timely payment to suppliers.

  • Develop and maintain internal manuals and guidance materials, supporting consistent contract adherence and operational alignment across the business.

  • Identify and mitigate commercial, regulatory, and operational risks, proactively reporting and collaborating with internal teams to drive continuous improvement and issue resolution.

  • Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) for vendors and monitor their performance against contractual obligations.

  • Provide regular reports on contract status, vendor performance, and cost savings

Are we the perfect match?

Here’s what we need from you:

  • Demonstrated experience in managing the end-to-end contract lifecycle.

  • Skilled in vendor selection, onboarding and third-party relationship management.

  • Strong budget management and reporting capabilities.

  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to influence at senior levels.

  • Collaborative and solution-oriented, leveraging team input to resolve issues and drive results.

  • Growth-oriented mindset, continuously challenging and refining processes and ways of working for improvement.

ere’s what else you need to know

  • Role may close earlier due to high applications.

  • Competitive salary

  • Location – Nottingham with travel to our other sites when required.

  • Inclusive & Diverse - We’re the only energy company in the Inclusive Top 50 UK Employers. We’re also proud winners of Best Employer for Women and Human Company of the Year—recognising our inclusive, people-first culture

title: Turnkey / Energy Services Project Manager
description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.

Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home.

We boldly go.

Where is the work:

Prioritize engaging with customers. When not directly interacting with customers; collaborate with colleagues in your office.

Energy Services / Turnkey Project Manager will manage all aspects of a multi-million dollar construction project portfolio, from beginning to end, with direct responsibility for project execution in a given time frame and with available resources. Responsible for the administration, implementation and management of assigned construction projects.

  • Project Scope & Portfolio will have a mixture of trade work

  • Multiple technologies, vendors and subcontractors.

  • High degree of customer interface.

  • Contracts may contain penalty clauses, risk, liabilities, and or liquidated damages.

  • Trane will often be a Prime Contractor and leading multiple subcontractors.

  • Projects may include general construction systems and technologies that are outside of Trane’s normal core competency.

  • Require supervision of lower tier Project Superintendents.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following:

  • Professionally prepare, document, implement, control and update all aspects of assigned Projects including: Scheduling, Budgets, Buyout, Subcontractors, Permits, Safety Plan, Risk Assessments, Quality Plan, Communication Plan, Progress Reports, Meeting Minutes, Schedule of Values, Leading Owner Meetings, Leading Internal Meetings, Financial Forecasting, Testing/Commissioning, Punch-list, Turnover, and Close-out.

  • Mechanical HVAC systems knowledge – owner direct design build/estimator/developer duties.

  • General Contractor management duties.

  • Manages risks on projects to assure completion on time and on budget.

  • Selects and manages multiple subcontractors and suppliers as needed to execute the project.

  • Meets with; contractors, building owners, subcontractors, other trades, and internal Team to discuss scope of project, budgets, performance, and close-out.

  • Responsible for project cash-flow management: progress billing, collections support and monitoring, and resource management.

  • Ensures that quality standards are maintained for assigned projects.

  • Maintains customer satisfaction by investigating concerns, implementing corrective action, and communicating with customers and assigned staff.

  • Establishes professional relationship and communicates with field support staff and customers and their representatives. Interfaces constantly to maintain accurate status reports and project reviews.

  • Operates in a team-based environment by coordinating with Operations, Sales and Service to understand and fulfill project requirements. Establishes a professional relationship with the customer and interfaces constantly to maintain accurate status reports and project reviews.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Educational Requirements – Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or Construction Management with a minimum of 3 years of experience in the construction Industry or related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Ability to independently prioritize and manage time in a disciplined, productive manner.

  • Maintains highest levels of ethics, trust, and personal responsibility.

  • Preferred candidate would have OSHA 10 minimum and OSHA 30 preferred

  • Familiarity with financially guaranteed contracts, the operation of energy management systems, HVAC systems, temperature controls, and process control systems is preferred.

  • Must have a general working knowledge of basic engineering, electricity, mechanical HVAC systems and the building construction industry.

  • Must possess a valid driver’s license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to:

    • DUI in the previous 5 years

    • Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless / Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.

  • Travel to customer job sites is required (2-5 hour radius & overnights as assigned projects require), which may include outdoor work and/or work in mechanical/equipment rooms. During the site visits, the employee may be exposed to variable weather conditions; moving mechanical parts; heights, and other variable environmental conditions based on location.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Cloud Engineer based in Hungary.

Join a technical team focused on supporting and scaling modern cloud-based data environments.
In this role, you will help application teams onboard to Databricks and build reliable Data Landing Zones (DLZ).
You will work with Azure resources, Infrastructure as Code, automation, and deployment pipelines to deliver efficient solutions.
As a first-line technical point of contact, you will troubleshoot requests and help resolve issues through structured support processes.
You will also identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities and continuously improve operational workflows.
The role combines hands-on cloud engineering with application support in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.
It is an excellent opportunity to deepen your expertise in Databricks, Azure, IaC, and cloud automation while making a direct impact on data platform operations.

Accountabilities

  • Provide first-level technical support to application teams through the ServiceNow ticketing system, investigating and resolving common Databricks and cloud-related requests.
  • Gather, clarify, and analyze technical requirements for onboarding new Data Landing Zones (DLZs).
  • Execute pipelines, scripts, and automated processes to provision, configure, or modify Azure and Databricks resources.
  • Support the deployment of commonly requested Azure resources using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.
  • Identify repetitive manual activities and develop automation to improve efficiency, consistency, and support response times.
  • Collaborate with application, cloud, data, and other cross-functional teams to resolve technical issues and ensure smooth onboarding.
  • Create, maintain, and continuously improve documentation covering support procedures, workflows, configurations, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of cloud support operations and the overall Databricks environment.

    • Requirements:

    • 1–3 years of hands-on experience working with Databricks in a technical or operational environment.
    • 1–3 years of experience with Azure Data Factory.
    • Previous experience in application support, technical operations, cloud support, or a similar role.
    • Familiarity with major cloud platforms, particularly Azure, with exposure to AWS or GCP considered an advantage.
    • Experience using source-control systems such as Git, GitHub, or GitLab.
    • Understanding of Databricks capabilities such as Unity Catalog, role-based access control (RBAC), authentication mechanisms, and Delta Sharing is highly desirable.
    • Experience working within the Azure ecosystem and understanding of cloud resource management.
    • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, or AWS CDK.
    • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation platforms such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions is a plus.
    • Scripting or development experience with Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar technologies.
    • Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities, combined with attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
    • Ability to communicate clearly with application teams and collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

      • Benefits:

      • Opportunity to work hands-on with Databricks, Azure, cloud infrastructure, and modern data technologies.
      • Exposure to Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, automation, and cloud platform operations.
      • Collaborative environment with opportunities to work closely with application and cross-functional technical teams.
      • Opportunity to develop expertise in a growing data and cloud technology ecosystem.
      • Role combining technical support, cloud engineering, automation, and continuous improvement.
      • Potential for professional growth through exposure to a broad range of cloud and data platform challenges.

About DHL Blue Dart Express India:

Blue Dart Express Limited, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast-paced logistics environment and ever-evolving supply-chains. It wholly-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004.

Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.

We are proud to be consistently ranked among India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.

If you are looking to join a purpose-led, people-first, company that shapes India’s supply-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.

Position Overview:

The Senior Territory Service Representative (Senior TSR) – Operations is responsible for managing the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments while ensuring high standards of service quality, operational efficiency and customer experience across assigned territories.

In addition to executing daily pickup and delivery activities, the role supports operational excellence by handling key customer routes, mentoring newly inducted TSRs, resolving operational exceptions and ensuring consistent adherence to Blue Dart's operating standards. Acting as an experienced frontline representative of the Blue Dart brand, the Senior TSR plays an important role in delivering service reliability, supporting branch productivity and maintaining the highest standards of safety, professionalism and customer engagement.

Job Purpose:

To deliver superior pickup and delivery service across assigned territories while ensuring operational excellence, customer satisfaction, accurate COD collections, regulatory compliance and mentoring frontline team members to achieve Blue Dart's service and productivity standards.

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

Pickup & Delivery Operations

• Execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments across assigned territories while meeting defined service commitments.

• Ensure accurate handling, loading, transportation and delivery of customer shipments.

• Optimize daily route execution to maximize delivery productivity and customer coverage.

• Maintain high first-attempt delivery success and minimize service failures.

• Support branch operations during peak business periods and contingency situations.

Customer Service & Brand Representation

• Deliver an exceptional customer experience during every customer interaction.

• Professionally represent the Blue Dart brand while interacting with customers.

• Build positive relationships with regular customers and business accounts.

• Resolve routine customer concerns and escalate complex issues appropriately.

• Ensure excellent personal grooming, professional conduct and uniform compliance at all times.

COD & Documentation Management

• Collect and reconcile Cash on Delivery (COD) payments accurately.

• Ensure timely remittance of collections in accordance with company procedures.

• Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD) and complete all shipment documentation accurately.

• Ensure zero discrepancies in shipment documentation and cash handling.

• Maintain complete compliance with operational documentation requirements.

Operational Excellence

• Perform accurate shipment scanning using handheld devices and digital applications.

• Ensure timely system updates for pickups, deliveries and shipment exceptions.

• Strictly adhere to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and operational guidelines.

• Identify operational issues and recommend improvements to enhance productivity.

• Support implementation of process improvements introduced by branch operations.

Coaching & Team Support

• Support induction and on-the-job training of newly joined TSRs.

• Guide team members on operational procedures, customer interactions and safety practices.

• Share best practices to improve delivery productivity and service quality.

• Assist Shift In-charges during operational contingencies.

• Promote teamwork and knowledge sharing across the operations team.

Safety & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with all road safety regulations and Blue Dart safety standards.

• Drive safely while protecting customer shipments and company assets.

• Report accidents, operational incidents and security concerns immediately.

• Ensure adherence to statutory and operational compliance requirements.

• Maintain zero tolerance towards unsafe operating practices.

Vehicle & Asset Responsibility

• Maintain assigned vehicle or personal two-wheeler in safe operating condition.

• Ensure statutory documents and driving licence remain valid.

• Report maintenance requirements promptly.

• Ensure cleanliness and upkeep of the vehicle used for operations.

Workplace Discipline & Brand Representation

• Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.

• Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.

• Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.

• Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.

• Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

Stakeholder Collaboration

• Coordinate closely with Shift In-charges, Operations Supervisors and branch teams.

• Support smooth coordination between inbound, outbound and customer service teams.

• Participate in daily operational briefings and service reviews.

• Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service quality objectives.

Qualifications & Experience:

Education:

• Minimum 10th Standard Pass.

• 10th Pass or higher qualification preferred.

Experience:

• 3–6 years of relevant experience in courier, express logistics, last-mile delivery or field operations.

• Proven experience in customer deliveries, pickups, COD handling and route management.

• Experience working with handheld scanners or digital delivery applications will be preferred.

Eligibility Requirements:

• Valid Two-Wheeler or Four-Wheeler Driving Licence.

• Must own a two-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.

• Physically fit to perform field operations.

• Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

Skills & Capabilities:

• Route Planning & Territory Familiarity

• COD Collection & Reconciliation

description:
About the Role

looking for a Database Administrator with hands-on Snowflake experience to help support the performance, security, and reliability of our cloud data platform. You'll work alongside senior DBAs and data engineering to maintain Snowflake environments, execute on established best practices, and grow your expertise in cloud data warehousing. This role reports to a Senior DBA/Data Platform Lead and offers a strong path to develop deeper Snowflake architecture and governance skills in a supportive, collaborative environment.

What You'll Do

  • Support the administration, configuration, and day-to-day maintenance of Snowflake environments, including warehouses, databases, schemas, roles, and resource monitors.
  • Help implement and maintain Snowflake security controls under senior guidance: role-based access control (RBAC), data masking, row-level security, and network policies.
  • Monitor query and warehouse performance, flag bottlenecks in compute usage, clustering, and storage, and assist in tuning under the direction of senior team members.
  • Assist with cost governance tasks — monitoring warehouse usage, contributing to resource monitor setup, and surfacing optimization opportunities.
  • Support capacity planning efforts by tracking data volume and concurrency trends and reporting findings to senior staff.
  • Help execute and test backup, replication, failover, and disaster recovery procedures across Snowflake accounts.
  • Partner with data engineers to support and troubleshoot data pipelines, ELT/ETL jobs, and data models (e.g., dbt).
  • Assist in administering and troubleshooting integrations with tools such as Fivetran, Airflow, dbt, Tableau/Looker/Power BI, and Snowpipe for data ingestion.
  • Follow and help maintain DBA standards, runbooks, and change-management processes for the Snowflake environment.
  • Support broader database operations as needed, including other relational platforms (e.g., PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL) used across the organization.
  • Stay current on new Snowflake features and share relevant findings with the team.

What You'll Bring

  • 3-5 years of database administration experience, including 1-2 years working with Snowflake in a production environment.
  • Working knowledge of Snowflake architecture: virtual warehouses, micro-partitions, clustering keys, Time Travel, zero-copy cloning, Snowpipe, and Streams/Tasks.
  • Solid SQL skills and experience writing and troubleshooting moderately complex queries.
  • Some exposure to Snowflake security and governance concepts: RBAC, masking policies, secure views, and access policies.
  • Familiarity with Snowflake usage monitoring and cost awareness (e.g., ACCOUNT_USAGE, query profiling).
  • Exposure to infrastructure-as-code or CI/CD for data platforms (e.g., Terraform, schemachange, dbt, Git-based workflows) is a plus.
  • Basic working knowledge of at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Some experience with data pipeline/orchestration tools (Airflow, Fivetran, dbt, or similar).
  • General understanding of data modeling, data warehousing concepts, and ELT/ETL design patterns.
  • Good troubleshooting instincts and willingness to escalate and collaborate on production incidents.
  • Clear communication skills and comfort working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • SnowPro Core certification (or working toward it).
  • Exposure to additional database platforms (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, or MySQL).
  • Exposure to a regulated or security-conscious environment (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, etc.).
  • Some experience supporting BI/analytics teams.

title: Vinyl Graphic Technician
description:
POSITION TITLE: Vinyl Graphics Technician

TEAM: Manufacturing

REPORTS TO: Graphics Team Lead

FLSA CLASSIFICATION: Hourly, Non-Exempt

LOCATION: Headquarters (On-Site)

ABOUT US

At the heart of Gable lies a passion that transcends the conventional. We’re more than just creators of visual communications; we’re experts at creating experiences. We believe that every brand, building, and place has a unique story to tell, and our mission is to elevate the way they are seen, experienced, and remembered.

We are committed to fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment where team members can thrive and contribute to our shared success.

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Vinyl Graphics Technician supports Gable’s manufacturing operations by preparing, producing, and finishing vinyl graphics and related printed materials in accordance with work orders, production layouts, and quality standards. This role is responsible for setting up and running production files and equipment, preparing substrates, labeling and distributing finished parts, and properly disposing of scrap materials.

This position works closely with the Graphics Team Lead and cross-functional production teams to ensure work is completed accurately, safely, and within allocated project hours. The Vinyl Graphics Technician is expected to maintain a clean and organized work area, communicate production or inventory concerns, and follow all applicable safety and quality procedures.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The following list of functions for this position is not a limitedly defined list. Additional tasks may be required on the job that are not listed below. The list below serves as a guide for the essential functions that are expected from this position by Gable:

Production Setup and Equipment Operation

  • Review work orders, layouts, drawings, and production specifications to understand job requirements before beginning work.
  • Import, size, and prepare production files in Composer or other applicable production software.
  • Set up and operate digital printers, plotters, laminators, and related production equipment in accordance with job requirements and quality standards.
  • Load raw materials, run cut files, label completed parts, distribute finished materials to the appropriate areas, and properly dispose of scrap.

Vinyl Fabrication, Finishing, and Quality

  • Follow layouts to place computer-generated vinyl or full-color graphic images on designated substrates, media, or surfaces.
  • Prepare substrates for vinyl application, including cutting, cleaning, laminating, masking, and other required production steps.
  • Weed excess vinyl from computer-cut graphics and perform laminating, mounting, and finishing tasks as assigned.
  • Measure materials before and after production to verify accuracy, alignment, color quality, and finished appearance.
  • Perform assigned work within allocated project hours while maintaining Gable’s quality standards and production specifications.

Team Communication, Inventory, and Safety

  • Report inventory levels, material shortages, and stock reorder needs to the Graphics Team Lead.
  • Assist with unloading raw materials and moving materials to the appropriate storage or production areas.
  • Communicate production issues, labor needs, equipment concerns, or quality problems to management in a timely manner.
  • Maintain cross-team communication to support job flow, scheduling, and handoffs between production areas.
  • Comply with OSHA, MOSH, and company safety procedures, including required PPE, and maintain a clean, safe, organized, and disciplined work environment

QUALIFICATIONS

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; technical training in graphics, sign production, printing, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience in vinyl graphics production, sign fabrication, large-format printing, or preferred a similar production environment.
  • Ability to read work orders, layouts, drawings, measurements, and production specifications accurately.
  • Hands-on experience with vinyl cutting, weeding, masking, laminating, mounting, and application techniques.
  • Familiarity with large-format printers, plotters, laminators, hand tools, and basic production equipment.
  • Strong attention to detail, quality standards, color accuracy, alignment, and finished appearance.
  • Ability to measure, cut handle, and apply vinyl graphics to a variety of substrates and surfaces.
  • Basic computer skills; experience with design or production software such as Adobe Illustrator, Onyx, Flexi, or similar programs preferred.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a production team in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to learn new materials, equipment, an installation new methods.
  • Ability to follow safety procedures and wear required PPE in production or installation environments.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This position requires frequent hands-on production work in a manufacturing environment. The team member must have manual dexterity to operate production equipment, hand tools, and computer systems, along with visual acuity (with correction) and the ability to speak and hear effectively.

The position requires the ability to stand for extended periods, including shifts of up to twelve hours when needed, and to walk, bend, stoop, kneel, reach, and perform repetitive production tasks. The team member must be able to frequently lift or move materials weighing between 10 and 50 pounds.

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

This role operates primarily in a manufacturing and shop environment. The team member may be exposed to moving mechanical parts, production equipment, industrial materials, dust, fumes, and moderate to high noise levels.

Frequent shop noise may be loud, and hearing protection or other personal protective equipment may be required. Appropriate PPE must be worn when required in production, shop, or installation environments.

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

TRAVEL

N/A

ACCOMMODATION STATEMENT

Gable is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and in the workplace. If you require an accommodation to complete an application, participate in an interview, or perform the essential functions of a position, please contact us. Requests for accommodation will be considered on a case-by-case basis, consistent with applicable law.

COMPENSATION

Compensation is commensurate with education and experience. Compensation includes hourly pay, overtime eligibility, 401(K) participation, and ESOP participation.

title: Android Developer
description:

Eşsiz müşteri deneyimine ulaşabilmek için geleneksel bir kanal olan ve Ana Hizmetlerimizin altında yeralan çağrı hizmetlerimize; Dijital, Teknolojik ve Danışmanlık Hizmetlerimizi de ekleyerek güçlendirdik.

Daha hızlı, tasarruf sağlayan, kolay ulaşılabilen bir müşteri deneyimi sunmak için RPA (Robotik Süreç Otomasyonu), Dijital Yardım Masası, Social Sniffer, Konuşma Analizi, Bulut Santral, Chat & Chat Bot gibi dijital hizmetlerimizi kullanıyoruz.

Müşteri deneyimi uçtan uca bir süreç olduğu için; Deneyim Tasarımı, Kalite & Araştırma Yönetimi gibi danışmanlık hizmetlerimiz ile bu deneyimin tasarım aşamasını da analitik bir bakış açısıyla sunuyoruz.Ana hizmetlerimiz içerisinde yer alan çağrı hizmetlerimizi ise sadece ses kanalı ile vermekle kalmayıp, görüntülü görüşme ve otomatik sesli yanıt sistemleri (IVR) ile destekleyerek müşterilerimize eşsiz bir deneyim yaşatıyoruz.

Kişisel verilerinize ilişkin detaylı bilgi almak, Kanun’un 11. maddesinde düzenlenen haklarınızı kullanmak ve başvuru yöntemlerini öğrenmek için Turkcell Çalışan Adayı Aydınlatma Metni'ni'https://globalbilgi.com.tr/wpcontent/uploads/2023/12/TURKCELL_Calisan_Adayi_Aydinlatma_Metni.pdf' internet adresimizden inceleyebilirsiniz.

İş Tanımı

Turkcell Global Bilgi kadrosunda yer alarak, havacılık sektöründeki müşterimizin teknoloji ekipleri içerisinde konumlanacak bir Android Developer arıyoruz. Rol, müşterimizin proje ekipleriyle yakın iş birliği içinde çalışmayı gerektirmektedir.

İş Tanımı

  • Sürdürülebilir, güvenli ve modüler bir yapıda Clean Architecture ve SOLID prensiplerine uygun olarak yeni özellikleri devreye almak.
  • Kod üretim hızını ve kalitesini artırmak amacıyla Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor vb. yapay zeka araçlarını aktif ve verimli bir şekilde kullanmak.
  • Test ve prod ortamlarında ortaya çıkan hataları tespit etmek ve hızla çözüme kavuşturmak.
  • Kritik proje takvimlerinde ve yüksek baskı altında (wartime mode) soğukkanlılığı koruyarak çözüm odaklı çalışmak.
  • Kurumsal yapı içerisindeki hiyerarşik düzene, raporlama disiplinine ve çalışma takvimine tam uyum sağlamak.
  • Geliştirilen modüllerin teknik dokümantasyonunu güncel tutmak; Unit Test ve UI Test süreçlerini yürütmek.

Nitelikler

  • Üniversitelerin Bilgisayar Mühendisliği veya ilgili lisans bölümlerinden mezun.
  • Android uygulama geliştirme alanında en az 3 yıl profesyonel deneyim sahibi.
  • Android için Kotlin ve Jetpack Compose teknolojilerinde derinlemesine uzman.
  • Clean Architecture, MVVM ve MVI mimari desenlerine ve SOLID prensiplerine hakim.
  • Büyük ölçekli projelerde çoklu modül (multi-module) mimarisi deneyimi olan.
  • OOP (Nesne Yönelimli Programlama), veri yapıları, algoritmalar ve tasarım kalıpları konularında güçlü altyapıya sahip.
  • CI/CD süreçleri, Git akışları ve modern DevOps araçlarına hakim.
  • Mobil veri güvenliği ve güvenli kod yazma prensiplerine hakim.
  • Unit Test ve UI Test yazmayı geliştirme sürecinin bir parçası olarak gören ve uygulayan.
  • İstanbul’da ikamet eden.
  • Tercihen yüksek trafikli E-ticaret projelerinde veya benzeri hızlı tüketim/satış odaklı "high-pace" ortamlarda çalışmış olan.

Seni Neler Bekliyor?

  • #buradakariyervar uygulamamız ile otonom kariyer fırsatı!

  • Anlaşmalı üniversite ve dil okulları ile eğitim desteği!
  • Bireysel & takım koçluğu ve mentorluk programları!
  • Takdir ve ödüllendirme uygulamaları!
  • Annelere özel okulun ilk günü/karne günü izni!
  • Online psikolog, sağlık, diyetisyen, veteriner ve bitki danışmanlığı desteği!

  • Çalışanlara özel indirim ve kampanyalar!

title: Supply Chain Strategic Programs Lead
description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.

Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home.

We boldly go.

Where is the work:

Virtual

Job Title: Supply Chain Strategic Programs Lead

The Company

At Trane Technologies we Challenge the Possible. Our brands – including Trane® and Thermo King®– create access to cooling and comfort in buildings and homes, transport and protect food and perishables, connect customers to elevated performance with less environmental impact, dramatically reduce energy demands and carbon emissions, and innovate with a better world in mind. We boldly challenge what’s possible for a sustainable world.

The Role

Located at our North American Headquarters in Davidson, North Carolina, the Supply Chain Strategic Programs Lead plays a crucial role in shaping and implementing Trane Technologies' sustainability and diversity strategies within the supply chain. Reporting to the Supplier Diversity and Sustainability Leader, this position collaborates closely with key internal and external stakeholders to drive strategic initiatives, improve processes, and promote sustainable and inclusive practices.

What are the principal responsibilities of this job?

• Lead the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of supply chain sustainability programs aligned with corporate ESG goals and external frameworks (e.g., CSRD, SEC climate disclosures, OECD due diligence guidance).
• Manage small and diverse supplier identification and onboarding, performance tracking, and internal/external reporting.
• Implement human rights due diligence processes across the supply chain, with a focus on conflict minerals compliance (e.g., CMRT/EMRT) and forced labor risk mitigation.
• Conduct supply chain sustainability maturity assessments and supplier segmentation to identify ESG risks and opportunities, integrating findings into sourcing and procurement strategies.
• Partner with Procurement, Legal, Compliance, and Sustainability teams to ensure alignment of policies, procedures, and supplier expectations.
• Support supply chain digitization efforts by enhancing data collection, automation, and reporting capabilities across ESG metrics, supplier disclosures, and traceability systems.
• Drive supplier engagement and capability building, including training, communications, and performance improvement initiatives.
• Contribute to broader strategic supply chain initiatives as needed, including resilience planning, responsible sourcing innovation, and cross-functional transformation projects.

· Lead and support broad Supply Chain Strategic programs that advance enterprise priorities, strengthen cross-functional alignment, and enable scalable, forward-looking supply chain capabilities.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Sustainability, Business, or a related field.
• 3+ years of experience in supply chain, sustainability/ESG, procurement, or compliance roles.
• Strong knowledge of supply chain human rights due diligence, including conflict minerals regulations (e.g., Dodd-Frank Section 1502) and global responsible sourcing standards.
• Experience with supplier diversity programs.
• Familiarity with ESG reporting standards and regulatory landscapes (e.g., CSRD, GRI, SASB, TCFD).
• Demonstrated ability to manage complex datasets and support supply chain digitization initiatives (e.g., supplier platforms, dashboards, traceability tools).
• Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.Strong project management, business acumen and analytical capabilities

  • 3+ years working cross-functionally and with suppliers
  • Preferred - 2+ years working within Sustainability & Diversity

Key Competencies and Success Factors

  • Effective collaboration with diverse teams to align strategies and operations.
  • Skilled in project coordination, resource management, and strategic planning.
  • Proficiency in process adherence and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to communicate complex data in a clear and impactful manner.

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs that help our employees thrive in both their professional and personal lives. We are proud of our winning culture which is inclusive and respectful at its core. We share passion for serving customers, caring for others, and boldly challenging what’s possible for a sustainable world.

We are committed to achieving workforce diversity reflective of our communities. We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identify, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

title: Tandartsassistent / Tandartsassistente
description:
Tandartsenpraktijk Driel is een frisse, recent verbouwde praktijk met drie lichte behandelkamers en een eigentijdse uitstraling. Hier werk je in een enthousiast en goed op elkaar ingespeeld team van vier tandartsen, twee mondhygiënisten, vier assistentes (waarvan twee preventieassistentes) en een baliemedewerker. Samen bieden we brede tandheelkundige zorg met veel aandacht voor preventie, kwaliteit en persoonlijke benadering.

De sfeer is open, collegiaal en professioneel, en er is volop ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen, nieuwe vaardigheden te leren en actief mee te denken over de praktijk. Of je nu net begint of al ervaring hebt, bij ons voel je je snel thuis en krijg je de kans om als zorgprofessional te groeien. Een plek waar samenwerken, plezier en vakmanschap hand in hand gaan!

Wij zoeken een tandartsassistente in combinatie met balie werkzaamheden voor 3 - 4 dagen per week.

Wat ga je doen

Als tandartsassistente assisteer je een tandarts en maak je de behandelkamer gereed voor de volgende patiënt.
Wij zoeken een ervaren tandartsassistente (optioneel preventie) die het niet erg vind om een combinatie met ook balie werkzaamheden te verrichten.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • het maken van foto’s en afdrukken voor patiënten;

  • het geven van voorlichting en advies aan patiënten over het voorkomen van tandheelkundige problemen en het bevorderen van de mondgezondheid;

  • het ondersteunen bij de registratie en het op orde houden van het dossier;

  • assisteren aan de stoel en balie werkzaamheden..

Wat wij bieden

  • een dienstverband van 24 - 32 uur per week;

  • werkdagen: maandag t/m vrijdag, in overleg;

  • salaris tandartsassistent / tandartsassistente is tussen de €2430 en 3100 per maand afhankelijk van ervaringsjaren;

  • bij goed functioneren is er ruimte voor een vaste aanstelling;

  • reiskostenvergoeding en vakantietoeslag;

  • bij een 38-urige werkweek: 152 uur wettelijk verlof, 38 uur bovenwettelijk verlof en verlof op officiële feestdagen;

  • pensioenregeling; (niet bij receptie, MH, Tandarts)

  • bedrijfsuitjes, etentjes en borrels, kerstpakket;

  • jaarlijks een Tandarts Today dag voor alle praktijken;

  • jaarlijks € 200,- vergoeding voor het onverzekerde deel van je tandheelkundige behandelingen (voorwaarden van toepassing);

  • werkkleding conform WIP-richtlijnen ter beschikking gesteld door praktijk, denk aan werkjasjes, beschermingsmateriaal, naambadges en een vergoeding schoenen en broeken (voorwaarden van toepassing);

  • artikelen tegen kostprijs, denk aan bleekgel, tandenborstels, tandpasta en ragers;

  • vergoeding 50 % van de lidmaatschappen bij KRT, KRM, NVvp en NVOI. In overleg vergoeding cursussen ten behoeve van het behoud van dit lidmaatschap.

Wat wij vragen

  • diploma tandartsassistente, optioneel preventie assistente diploma of de ambitie om opgeleid te worden tot preventie assistente;

  • je hebt ervaring in een tandartspraktijk en bent bekend met tandheelkundige behandelingen en instrumenten;

  • goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift;

  • Je bent voldoende beschermd tegen Hepatitis B volgens de geldende norm Mondzorg.

Meer informatie?

Wil je meer informatie over deze vacature, neem een kijkje op onze website:

Enthousiast?

Wil je je carrière voortzetten of starten als tandartsassistent / tandartsassistente? Solliciteer via de sollicitatiebutton en stuur je CV en motivatie mee.

Over Tandarts Today

Onze teams doen het! Dat is het motto van Tandarts Today. Elke praktijk en medewerker is uniek. Daarom geloven we in sterke, lokale teams, gebaseerd op vertrouwen en ruimte voor ontwikkeling. We hebben oog voor elkaar, denken in oplossingen en zorgen ervoor dat jij met een yes!-gevoel aan het werk bent.

Zo blijven we dicht bij wat écht belangrijk is: het leveren van de beste mondzorg voor onze patiënten. Met de kracht van een keten én de persoonlijke aandacht van een lokale tandartspraktijk, bieden wij het beste van twee werelden.

Soort dienstverband: Parttime

Salaris: €2.430,00 - €3.100,00 per maand

Verwacht aantal uur: 16 – 24 per week

Aanvullende vergoedingen: Vakantiegeld

Arbeidsvoorwaarden:

  • Pensioen

  • Reiskostenvergoeding

Werkschema: ma-vr

Taal: Nederlands (Vereist)

Licentie/certificaat: diploma tandartsassistente (Vereist)

Werklocatie: Fysiek

title: Manufacturing Associate (Part-Time)
description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards, Cleanroom: no hair products, jewelry, makeup, nail polish, perfume, exposed piercings, facial hair etc... allowed, Office, Some degree of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) required (safety glasses, gowning, gloves, lab coat, ear plugs etc.)

Job Description

Manufacturing Associate (Part Time)

Location: Brisbane, Australia
Employment Type: Part-Time

Join a Team That Makes a Difference

Are you looking to build your career in the biopharmaceutical industry and gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced GMP manufacturing environment?

We're looking for a motivated Manufacturing Associate to join our Operations team. In this role, you'll play a key part in supporting the smooth operation of our manufacturing facility by coordinating quality systems, tracking operational performance, supporting continuous improvement initiatives, and collaborating with cross-functional teams.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys organisation, problem-solving, and working in a highly regulated environment where quality and patient outcomes are at the heart of everything we do.

What You'll Be Doing

description:

Covering the North East and Yorkshire Regions UK

Sales and Business Development:

title: Medewerker Bandenhotel
description:
Ben jij op zoek naar een afwisselende functie waarin je zowel onderweg bent als een rol speelt in het magazijn? In de functie van Medewerker Bandenhotel bij Van Mossel werk je vanuit ons centrale bandenhotel in Waalwijk, waar je verantwoordelijk bent voor het ophalen, bezorgen en opslaan van autobanden voor meerdere Van Mossel vestigingen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Medewerker Bandenhotel draai je mee in de logistieke operatie rondom het bandenbeheer. In de zomer- en wintermaanden, wanneer de bandenwissels veel gedaan worden, ben je vooral onderweg met de bakwagen om banden naar de verschillende Van Mossel vestigingen te brengen. In de rustige periodes daartussen krijg je de kans om meer binnen het magazijn te werken en andere taken op je te nemen.

Je werkzaamheden omvatten o.a.:

  • Het in- en uitruimen van banden in het magazijn.

  • Het ophalen en afleveren van bandensets bij de verschillende vestigingen met de bakwagen.

  • Licht administratieve taken rondom de banden en het magazijnbeheer.

  • In de rustige periodes: ondersteunen in het magazijn en het organiseren van de voorraad.

Wie ben jij?
Je hebt het vermogen om het overzicht te bewaren, zowel wanneer je onderweg bent als in het magazijn. Omdat je de banden zelf moet in- en uitruimen, is het belangrijk dat je fysiek fit bent en in staat om met de nodige kracht en precisie te werken. Daarnaast vragen we:

  • Je bent in bezit van rijbewijs B;

  • Je bent flexibel inzetbaar en woont in of vlakbij Waalwijk.


Wat bieden wij jou?
In 75 jaar tijd is de Van Mossel Automotive Groep uitgegroeid tot het grootste autobedrijf van Nederland. Naast een passend salaris kun je rekenen op een gezellig team waarbij hard werken en plezier maken hand in hand gaat.


Lijkt het je leuk om als chauffeur Bandenhotel aan de slag te gaan bij Van Mossel in Waalwijk? Solliciteren kan eenvoudig en snel via de website.

We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Technical Lead – Agentic AI / Generative AI to own the architecture, technical direction, and delivery of production-grade AI solutions. You will also work closely with Product, Data, Platform, Security, and other stakeholders to turn emerging GenAI capabilities into reliable, scalable, and business-ready solutions.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

AI Architecture & Development

  • Architect and develop Agentic AI and Generative AI systems from concept through production.

Production Engineering

  • Previous formal people-management experience.

title: Senior Facilities Co-ordinator - EHS
description:
Work Schedule

Second Shift (Afternoons)

Environmental Conditions

Office

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

DESCRIPTION:

The Senior Facilities Co-ordinator - EHS will be responsible for driving site-level Environment, Health & Safety programs at the Bengaluru office. The role will focus fully on core EHS operations, including employee and contractor safety, emergency preparedness, EHS training, incident reporting, Permit-to-Work controls, Management of Change, statutory and internal compliance, audits, and implementation of Thermo Fisher EHS standards.

The position is critical to maintaining a safe, compliant, and audit-ready workplace, particularly as Bengaluru continues to grow as a key global site with increasing employee presence in office.

Key Responsibilities

EHS Governance & Compliance

  • Support implementation of site-level EHS programs in line with Thermo Fisher global EHS standards and applicable local requirements.
  • Maintain EHS documentation, compliance trackers, risk assessments, incident records, action trackers, and audit evidence.
  • Support internal and external EHS audits and ensure timely closure of observations and corrective actions.
  • Coordinate with Global / Regional EHS teams for reporting, governance updates, and implementation of EHS initiatives.
  • Participate in site EHS meetings and provide regular updates on EHS performance, risks, and improvement actions.

Training, Induction & EHS Communication

  • Conduct EHS induction for new employees, contractors, vendors, and visitors.
  • Drive EHS awareness campaigns, safety alerts, toolbox talks, and site-level safety communications.
  • Maintain EHS briefing content, visitor safety videos, contractor induction material, and training records.
  • Coordinate external training and certification for ERT members, first aiders, fire wardens, and relevant site teams.

Emergency Preparedness & Life Safety

  • Support formation and maintenance of Emergency Response Team, Fire Marshals, First Aiders, and Quick Response Teams.
  • Coordinate mock drills, fire evacuation drills, emergency response exercises, and drill observation closure.
  • Maintain evacuation plans, emergency contact lists, emergency signage, incident logs, and life-safety infrastructure records.
  • Ensure readiness of emergency systems such as alarms, panic buttons, emergency exits, evacuation signage, first-aid boxes, spill kits, eyewash stations, and emergency communication tools.

Permit-to-Work, MOC & Contractor Safety

  • Manage Permit-to-Work controls for general work, electrical work, work at height, hot work, confined space work, and other high-risk activities.
  • Ensure Management of Change review for site modifications, seating expansions, refurbishment activities, and operational changes.
  • Review contractor safety compliance, PPE adherence, toolbox talks, work authorization, and site safety induction.
  • Conduct periodic site rounds to verify safe work practices and compliance with EHS requirements.

Technical & Soft Services Safety Controls

  • Maintain and monitor PPE matrix implementation for technical and soft services teams.
  • Ensure availability and usage of safety equipment such as insulated tools, FRP ladders, electrical safety gloves, arc flash suit, spill kits, and eyewash stations.
  • Conduct safety checks for facility maintenance activities, chemical handling areas, housekeeping activities, vendor work zones, and utility areas.
  • Identify unsafe conditions and drive corrective actions with vendors, facilities teams, and stakeholders.

EHS Systems, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Maintain EHS records and reports in applicable EHS systems such as Intelex or equivalent platforms.
  • Support emergency communication readiness through tools such as Everbridge or equivalent systems.
  • Prepare EHS dashboards, incident summaries, compliance reports, training records, audit action trackers, and management updates.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen site safety culture, emergency readiness, and operational controls.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Graduate with around 4 years of experience in core EHS, preferably in corporate office, facilities, IT/ITES, life sciences, manufacturing support, or large commercial workplace environments.
  • Working knowledge of EHS compliance, emergency preparedness, contractor safety, Permit-to-Work, risk assessment, incident reporting, and audits.
  • Basic understanding of fire safety, first aid coordination, electrical safety, chemical handling safety, PPE, workplace ergonomics, and emergency response.
  • Experience in conducting EHS inductions, toolbox talks, mock drills, site inspections, and contractor safety checks.
  • Ability to maintain documentation, dashboards, trackers, and compliance records.
  • Good communication skills and ability to coordinate with employees, contractors, vendors, facilities teams, HR, security, and regional/global EHS stakeholders.
  • Working knowledge of MS Excel, PowerPoint, and EHS reporting tools.
  • Certifications in fire safety, first aid, IOSH, NEBOSH, industrial safety, or equivalent EHS training will be an added advantage.

title: Product Manager, AI Entities
description:
Product Manager, AI Entities

Department: Product Management

Location: San Francisco (hybrid), Toronto (hybrid)

Compensation: $177,650 – $209,000 • Offers Equity • Multiple Ranges

Employment Type: FullTime

EvenUp is on a mission to close the justice gap using technology and AI. We empower personal injury lawyers and victims to get the justice they deserve. Our products enable law firms to secure faster settlements, higher payouts, and better outcomes for victims injured through no fault of their own in vehicle collisions, accidents, natural disasters, and more.

We are one of the fastest-growing vertical SaaS companies in history, and we are just getting started. EvenUp is backed by top VCs, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Bain Capital Ventures, SignalFire, and Lightspeed. We are looking to expand our team with talented, driven, and collaborative individuals who seek to have a lasting impact. Learn more at www.evenuplaw.com.

We're looking for a Product Manager to join our AI Platform group and own the systems that turn messy, unstructured case materials into accurate, structured "source of truth" data. This isn't your typical PM role: it's highly technical, backend-heavy, and focused on scalable AI extraction and data infrastructure. You'll work closely with senior ML and backend engineers to build the models, evals, pipelines, tooling, and APIs that power all of EvenUp's products.

You'll be responsible for a mission-critical part of our AI strategy: making sure the entities we generate are accurate, consistent, and trustworthy enough for law firms to rely on. If you've built ML/LLM-powered data pipelines, love the challenge of turning unstructured input into structured, reliable output, and want broad impact across a fast-growing product org, this role is for you.

This is a hybrid role with the expectation of working at least 3 days a week from our San Francisco or Toronto offices. Title and compensation to be determined based on candidate experience.


What you'll do:

  • Own the roadmap for a key part of our AI Platform, potentially including RAG services, text and image extraction and analysis services, model evaluation and deployment tools, and more.

  • Partner with ML and backend engineers to build scalable, reliable, and cost-effective systems that support product teams across the company.

  • Define success metrics, analyze performance and cost data , and use insights to inform priorities.

  • Work closely with other product managers teams to understand end-user needs and develop reusable platform capabilities that accelerate AI development.

  • Drive strategic decisions around model performance, vendor selection, and infrastructure scaling in a fast-evolving ecosystem.

  • Define success metrics for entity quality and pipeline performance.

  • Partner with other product managers and downstream teams to understand where entity quality or coverage gaps are limiting product experiences, and translate that into a prioritized platform roadmap.

  • Drive decisions on model performance, annotation strategy, and integration with continuous inference systems as the underlying ML approaches evolve.

What we look for:

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including time at a high-growth startup (Series B–E).

  • Experience building LLM/LMM-powered products or data infrastructure, with a strong understanding of how modern AI extraction and structured-data systems work end-to-end.

  • Technical fluency: you've worked closely with ML engineers, backend engineers, or data teams and can hold your own in technical discussions about model performance, data pipelines, and system design.

  • Comfort operating in a backend-heavy environment where your "users" are often internal teams and downstream product surfaces, and your work directly impacts data accuracy, reliability, and trust.

  • Analytical mindset: you use data to make decisions and are comfortable managing quality metrics (precision/recall, entity accuracy, coverage) alongside operational ones (latency, throughput).

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with RAG, agentic systems, and/or LLM/LMM optimization.

  • Familiarity with building internal platforms or tools that support other product teams.

  • B2B SaaS background, especially in products with significant AI or data components.

Benefits & Perks:

As part of our total rewards package, we offer attractive benefits and perks to our employees, including:

  • Choice of medical, dental, and vision insurance plans for you and your family.

  • Additional insurance coverage options for life, accident, or critical illness.

  • Flexible paid time off, sick leave, short-term and long-term disability.

  • 10 US observed holidays, and Canadian statutory holidays by province.

  • A home office stipend.

  • 401(k) for US-based employees and RRSP for Canada-based employees.

  • Paid parental leave.

  • A local in-person meet-up program.

  • Hubs in San Francisco and Toronto.

(Please note the above benefits & perks are for full-time employees)

Notice to Candidates:

To ensure fairness and proper consideration, we do not accept resumes or expressions of interest via email or social media messages. If you’re interested in a role, please submit your application directly through our careers page.

Please note that EvenUp may use AI notetakers and other recording devices in the recruiting process. If you interview with us, with your consent, we may record your conversations and summarize them into notes for internal use. Recording is optional, and declining will not affect your candidacy.

EvenUp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to diversity and inclusion in our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Team Leader

Join Our Growing Team!

West Coast Convenience is the parent company of Loop Neighborhood Market, Poppy Market, and other gas brands. Headquartered in Union City, CA, we operate a growing network of convenience stores, fuel stations, and car washes across California. Founded in 1978, the company also develops real estate and owns and operates its locations.


West Coast Convenience continues to expand and is seeking customer-focused individuals who want to make an impact. Position Summary:

As Team Leader, you are responsible for the store’s overall success in a hands-on leadership role focused on performance, operations, and customer experience.

· Lead the team with strong business acumen

· Drive sales and profitability across all departments

· Ensure operational excellence in a fast-paced environment

· Deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience

· Maintain focus on inventory, retail technology, and safety

The Team Leader sets the tone for the store by modeling our Core Values, building a strong team culture, and ensuring every shift runs efficiently and safely. We win as one, and living our brand is essential in every role.

· Hire, train, coach, and retain a strong team

Operations Management

· Oversee daily operations, cash handling, and store readiness

· Maintain cleanliness, safety, and equipment functionality


Sales & Profitability

· Drive sales through merchandising, availability, and service

· Manage inventory, expenses, and store performance


Customer Experience

· Deliver excellent service and resolve customer issues promptly

· Maintain a welcoming, customer-first environment


Compliance & Safety

· Follow company policies and all safety and regulatory standards

· Promote a safe, secure environment for employees and customers

· High school diploma or equivalent

· Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and basic math skills

· Ability to multitask, adapt quickly, and manage sales, expenses, and inventory

· Reliable transportation, valid driver’s license, and insurance

· Willingness to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays

The Team Leader position requires constant standing, bending and reaching with a moderate amount of manual dexterity, and frequent lifting up to 50 pounds. title: Construction Superintendent
description:
Ironmark Building Co. is looking for a commercial construction Superintendent to join our team!

Ironmark Building Co. is an award-winning commercial general contractor based in Minneapolis, MN and Mesa, AZ. We specialize in multifamily, mixed-use, hospitality, and commercial construction, earning a reputation for successfully delivering complex projects with exceptional quality and service.


What truly sets Ironmark apart is our people. We believe that strong relationships are the foundation of every successful project, and that starts with our team. We seek individuals who embody our core values of Safety, Accountability, Collaboration, and Hard Work, and who take ownership of their work while building lasting relationships with clients, partners, and teammates.


At Ironmark, we are committed to continuous improvement and investing in our employees' growth. We provide opportunities for professional development, encourage new ideas, and empower our team members to make a meaningful impact. As we continue to grow, we're looking for talented individuals who share our commitment to excellence and want to help shape the future of Ironmark.


The Superintendent will lead and manage all field construction activities on a major project located in Flagstaff, AZ. You’ll be responsible for all field aspects of the project’s budget, schedule, and general performance. This position may require candidate to travel to project locations as they arise in the future.


What you’ll do:

The successful Lead Superintendent will communicate and interact with owners, architects, engineers, government officials, and the public in a clear, concise, and professional manner. The Superintendent coordinates all site construction activities and supervises all field personnel as required to successfully complete the project on schedule and on budget. This includes maintaining the highest quality, supervising all trade and field personnel, and managing exemplary construction safety practices for all on-site activities. You will create and maintain positive, professional, and respectful relationships and maintain a safe, clean, and well-organized job site at all times.


Your duties will include:

  • Develop, maintain, and execute the project plan as laid out by the Project Manager and yourself.
  • Ensure a complete knowledge and understanding of all contract drawings, specifications, addenda, RFIs (requests for information), and any other job-related contracts and information for each project.
  • Supervise and coordinate all construction activities.
  • Supervise, direct, coach, and train Assistant Superintendents, Ironmark’s General Laborers, and Field Interns.
  • Create site specific plans and procedures that adhere to safety and record keeping requirements and Ironmark’s Safety Program to ensure a safe work environment.
  • Obtain necessary information from engineers, designers, inspectors, municipal/provincial authorities, and owners.
  • Maintain (1) set of complete, up-to-date drawings, including RFIs, etc., on jobsite for Ironmark use and architect/client meetings.
  • Manage job site setup and startup processes to include safety posting and procedures, security practices, field office location and layout, temporary utilities, staging areas, equipment, and manpower.
  • Develop and refine a computerized project schedule, working in conjunction with the Project Manager to confirm schedules are properly updated to meet various dates required and/or maintain accountability for delays.
  • Prepare work orders and field change orders and provide daily reports for all projects.
  • Coordinate, direct, and monitor subcontractor schedules via email and verbally.
  • Inspect and oversee the activities of the subcontractors for safety regulation compliance and completion of their contractual requirements.
  • Supervise receipt of supplies and all other onsite labor for safety, quality, accuracy, and workmanship.
  • Prepare and communicate RFIs with architects, engineers, etc.
