title: Porter
description:
Porter


Kissing Tree Master Community | San Marcos, Texas


$19–$20/hour + Comprehensive Benefits + 16 Paid Holidays


Hiring range based on experience, skills, and qualifications.


Collaboration. Authenticity. Connection. Balance.


At Cohere, we believe community is the most valuable amenity.


We do more than manage communities—we help create places where people connect, belong, and thrive. By partnering with some of the nation’s most innovative master-planned communities, we create places residents are proud to call home and where meaningful relationships flourish.


We’re looking for a Janitorial Porter to join our team at Kissing Tree Master Community, a 55+ community in the Texas Hill Country featuring resort-style amenities and thoughtfully designed spaces where residents can connect, stay active, and enjoy community life.


In this role, you’ll help maintain the cleanliness, appearance, and readiness of the community’s amenities and shared spaces. You’ll also support community events by setting up and taking down tables, chairs, equipment, and other materials.

This is an opportunity to take pride in creating a clean, welcoming, and well-maintained environment for residents, guests, and team members.


If you’re dependable, attentive to detail, and enjoy hands-on work in a community-focused environment, we’d love to meet you.


Why People Choose Cohere


The best communities are built by people who feel supported, valued, and empowered to do their best work. That’s why we invest in benefits, time away, and professional growth that help our team members thrive both personally and professionally.


Highlights Include:

  • Medical coverage available on your first day
  • Employer-paid dental coverage
  • Vision coverage
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Employer-paid Life Insurance, AD&D, and Long-Term Disability coverage
  • Pet insurance options
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health, financial, legal, and family support resources
  • Travel assistance and identity theft protection
  • Complimentary will preparation services
  • Generous paid time off
  • 16 paid holidays each year, including a Birthday Day and Volunteer Day, in addition to PTO
  • Professional development and growth opportunities

What You’ll Do


Maintain Clean and Welcoming Spaces

  • Clean and sanitize restrooms, offices, amenity areas, hallways, and other shared spaces
  • Sweep, mop, vacuum, dust, and clean floors, furniture, fixtures, and surfaces
  • Clean windows, glass doors, mirrors, and other high-touch areas
  • Empty trash and recycling containers and dispose of waste appropriately
  • Restock paper products, soap, and other janitorial supplies
  • Monitor assigned areas throughout the day and promptly address cleaning needs

Support Community Events

  • Set up tables, chairs, equipment, decorations, and other materials for community events and activities
  • Ensure event spaces are clean, organized, and ready for residents and guests
  • Take down event materials and return rooms to their standard setup following events
  • Assist with event-related cleaning before, during, and after community activities

Help Protect the Community’s Appearance and Safety

  • Pay close attention to details that affect the cleanliness and overall appearance of the community
  • Respond promptly to spills, special cleaning requests, and other immediate needs
  • Report maintenance concerns, safety hazards, damaged equipment, or supply needs to management
  • Operate cleaning tools and equipment safely and properly
  • Follow established safety procedures when handling cleaning products and completing assigned work

Provide Dependable Community Support

  • Complete assigned responsibilities independently and within established timelines
  • Maintain a professional and courteous presence when interacting with residents, guests, vendors, and team members
  • Work collaboratively with the community team to respond to changing priorities
  • Assist with additional porter, cleaning, event support, and community operations responsibilities as needed

What We’re Looking For

  • Previous janitorial, custodial, porter, housekeeping, facilities, hospitality, or similar hands-on experience is preferred
  • Strong attention to detail and pride in producing high-quality work
  • Dependable, punctual, and able to complete responsibilities with limited supervision
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and respond to changing community needs
  • Professional communication and customer service skills
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team
  • High school diploma or equivalent preferred

Additional Requirements

  • This is a full-time, onsite position based at Kissing Tree Master Community in San Marcos, Texas
  • Available shifts include Monday - Friday from 5:00 a.m.–1:30 p.m. (opening shift) and 1:30 p.m.–10:00 p.m. (closing shift)
  • Weekend shifts may be scheduled from 12:30 p.m.–9:00 p.m. or 1:30 p.m.–10:00 p.m.
  • Availability for occasional adjusted, mid, or overnight shifts may be required based on community needs, holidays, and special events
  • Team members may occasionally be scheduled for shorter two- to four-hour shifts to provide additional support during holidays or special events
  • Ability to remain active throughout the shift, including standing, walking, bending, and kneeling
  • Ability to lift, carry, push, or pull up to 50 pounds, including cleaning equipment, tables, chairs, and event materials
  • Comfortable completing work indoors and outdoors in varying weather conditions as needed
  • Ability to perform the essential responsibilities of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation

Equal Opportunity Employer


Cohere is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all team members are valued and respected.

title: Consumer & Equity Loan Maintenance Specialist
description:
Job Summary Overview


The position is responsible for representing Consumer Lending as the credit union point of contact for all consumer and equity loan maintenance, vehicle title, and insurance.


Essential Job Functions


  • Responsible for equity and consumer loan maintenance within Symitar per member, Risk, or Compliance request. This requires extreme attention to detail to ensure loan records and member records are modified accurately.
  • Responsible for assisting in research requests around loan maintenance and vehicle titles within organizational and vendor systems. This also requires the ability to problem solve and make recommendations based on research findings.
  • Analyzes, researches, and resolves escalated issues. Ensures clarity and direction and exhibits the necessary follow-through with members and/or staff involved.
  • Acts as support for Compliance and Consumer Lending Operations when system clean up and validation is required to ensure consumer and equity loans remain compliant within Symitar.
  • Handles total loss, GAP and Debt Cancellation claims and is responsible for working directly with Insurance companies, vendors, and the member. This includes collection of documents, researching loan history, and ensuring all time frames are met to eliminate CU and member risk.
  • Ensures timely submissions of all possible claims submitted with Lenders Protection and Allied Solutions to minimize deficiency losses for the credit union through the accurate and efficient claim handling.
  • Performs administration of premiums, refunds, and insurance product billing for Allied Solutions, Minnesota life, Arizona Group, and Assurance plus.
  • Performs Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable functions through the debiting and/or crediting of accounts. Manages billing issues with vendors and accounting as they arise. This includes ensuring vendors are properly charging for each of our services during monthly reconciliation.
  • Ensures successful vehicle lien perfection for consumer and commercial loans that use vehicles as collateral. This includes working directly with the commercial team to collect, process and perfect titling for commercial loans.
  • Will work directly with AZ MVD and Authorized Third Parties to determine ongoing member and lien perfection impacts and risks. Will report any trends that may cause risk during loan processing in lien perfection to Consumer Lending Servicing leaders.
  • Must meet AZ MVD and AZFCU compliance and regulatory requirements around vehicle lien placement and titling.
  • Accounts for CU and member risk when receiving requests around system maintenance exceptions, vehicle titling exceptions, and system issues. Must demonstrate the ability to problem solve complex and one-off situations as they arise when working with internal teams or members directly.
  • Considered consumer loan (SME) within Symitar and works closely with Consumer Lending Operations in PowerOn and Symitar testing, maintenance, and process improvements with a focus on continued enhancements and accuracy.
  • Reviews and recommends solutions for department and credit union wide processes by identifying obstacles within current procedures to enhance the member and employee experience.
  • Ensures individual and credit union adherence to policies and standard business practices.
  • Maintains professional standards and adheres to Arizona Financials’ values.
  • Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

title: Project Manager - Digitalisation & Ai
description:
Let’s shape the future of finance - together

At Isabel, we believe that real innovation happens when people and ideas connect

That’s why we’re building more than technology, we’re building an ecosystem.

One where every voice counts, and where your work can truly make a difference.

We’re looking for curious minds and collaborative builders. People who believe success means growing together, learning from each other, and challenging the status quo.

If that sounds like you, keep reading.

What you’ll do

Rather than managing one single project, you will oversee multiple initiatives with different scopes, timelines, stakeholders and technical partners. Your primary responsibility will be to ensure effective planning, governance, coordination and delivery across this portfolio.

You will join a small internal team that supports internal business teams and works closely with external delivery partners, including local partners and nearshore teams in Bulgaria.

Key Projects and Initiatives

Over the next 12 months, the portfolio will include projects in the following areas:

AI

  • Developing an AI agent to support Sales & Marketing teams in various activities, including account development, prospecting, profiling and information sharing.

  • Implementing an AI-driven customer support process flow, enabling customers to receive assistance from an AI agent in resolving questions and issues.

  • Further rolling out AI tools across the organisation.

  • Supporting the introduction and adoption of AI within the delivery organisation.

Customer Support

  • Delivering the AI-enabled customer support process flow described above.

  • Replacing the current telephony platform, Genesys, with Microsoft Contact Center.

  • Improving the Know Your Customer (KYC) process for our own customers through new tools and methodologies.

Finance

  • Implementing changes to billing processes, including support for new products and enhancements to existing products.

  • Supporting the technical upgrade of our ERP system, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations. Microsoft is moving towards the Power Platform and phasing out Lifecycle Services (LCS), and this transition will need to be managed accordingly.

As Project Manager, you will:

  • Plan, coordinate and monitor a portfolio of initiatives across multiple business domains.

  • Ensure clear governance, reporting, planning and follow-up for each project.

  • Organise and facilitate Steering Committee meetings with members of the Executive Team to provide direction and support decision-making.

  • Define quarterly Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) together with the team and key stakeholders.

  • Work closely with internal business teams, technical specialists and external delivery partners.

  • Manage dependencies, risks, priorities and stakeholder expectations across the project portfolio.

  • Actively contribute to coordination, functional and technical analysis, architecture and solution design when required.

What makes you a great fit

You will be part of a small internal team of approximately 3.5 FTEs. The team is responsible for:

  • Project coordination and follow-up

  • Functional and technical analysis

  • Architecture and solution design

While coordination and project management are the core of this role, the small size of the team means that you will be expected to actively contribute across these areas where needed.

Essential Skills and Experience

  • Proven experience managing multiple projects or a project portfolio in a digital, technology or transformation environment.

  • Strong stakeholder-management, planning and organisational skills.

  • Experience working with senior stakeholders and facilitating steering committees.

  • The ability to work effectively with external technology and delivery partners.

  • Functional understanding of the finance value chain, particularly billing and collections processes. Understanding the accounting treatment of these flows is an asset.

  • Functional understanding of customer support, sales and marketing domains.

  • Excellent written and spoken English is essential. Knowledge of Dutch and/or French is required to collaborate effectively with local stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • A general understanding of AI and AI tools, particularly agentic AI and AI development—not only AI tools for personal productivity.

  • Technical knowledge of the Microsoft Power Platform.

  • Technical knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

  • Technical knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations.

Why join us

At Isabel, we offer more than a job, we offer a place to grow, contribute, and thrive.

  • A human-sized Belgian company (250 people) where your ideas and impact matter

  • 50% hybrid work, flexible hours, and autonomy to manage your time

  • Coaching, training, and tailored development paths for every career stage

  • A flat, collaborative structure with real ownership and cross-functional work

  • Competitive rewards: Flex Income Plan, annual bonus, insurance, meal vouchers

  • A strong engagement culture and inclusive mindset

  • Easy mobility options: our MOBI strategy supports flexible, low-footprint commuting, whether by bike, public transport, or electric car

  • Professional gatherings that encourage collaboration and networking, as well as fun and purposeful activities led by our BeFun team

  • A certified Top Employer with 30 years of tech leadership and ambition

Ready to join us?

Your voice, your vision, and your impact all have a place here.

Let’s shape smarter solutions and a stronger digital economy. Together.

description:
Senior Optimization Programmer

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. title: Projectleider Sociaal Werk / Coördinator Amsterdam-Noord
description:
Jouw kantoor? Dat is net zo goed het jongerencentrum, het buurthuis of de stoep in Amsterdam-Noord. Als meewerkend projectleider en coördinator verbind je bewoners, jongeren, collega’s en partners. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit, brengt structuur en zet signalen uit de wijk om in concrete actie. Geen hiërarchische leidinggevende rol, maar wél een sleutelpositie met zichtbare maatschappelijke impact.

Over DOCK

In elke wijk zijn verhalen te vinden: van mensen die elkaar helpen, dromen najagen of soms even vastlopen. Bij DOCK staan we middenin de wijk – we kennen de verhalen. Je vindt ons op straat, in het buurthuis, online en op school, en we luisteren naar wat er echt speelt. We verbinden mensen, openen deuren en laten zien wat wél kan. Zo groeien netwerken, ontstaat vertrouwen en worden buurten sterker. We doen dat menselijk, betrokken en deskundig — altijd met optimisme en ambitie voor duurzame impact. Want niemand hoeft er alleen voor te staan. Samen met bewoners en partners bouwen we aan gemeenschappen waar iedereen meetelt en mee kan doen.

Over de functie

DOCK groeit in Amsterdam-Noord. Nieuwe jongerencentra en snel ontwikkelende wijken bieden volop kansen. Jij ondersteunt een jong en bevlogen team binnen het jongerenwerk en coördineert activiteiten rondom verschillende thema’s. Je combineert coördinatie en vakinhoudelijke coaching met actieve uitvoering op locatie en in de wijk. Samen bekijken we welke opdracht en urenomvang het beste aansluiten bij jouw ervaring, beschikbaarheid en interesse.

Wat ga je doen

  • Je coördineert de dagelijkse uitvoering, programmering, bezetting en voortgang van projecten.

  • Je werkt actief mee op locatie en in de wijk en bent zichtbaar, benaderbaar en makkelijk te vinden.

  • Je coacht collega’s, nieuwe medewerkers en stagiairs op vakinhoud, houding en professionele ontwikkeling.

  • Je signaleert knelpunten en ontwikkelingen en vertaalt deze naar verbeteringen en concrete acties.

  • Je bewaakt en versterkt de kwaliteit en stimuleert uniforme werkwijzen binnen en tussen teams.

  • Je onderhoudt relaties met bewoners, gemeente, ketenpartners en lokale initiatieven en vertegenwoordigt het team op operationeel niveau.

  • Je stemt af met de teamleider en clustermanager en levert input voor teamdoelen, capaciteit en de ontwikkeling van beleid en aanbod

Wie ben jij

Je bent een sociaal professional die makkelijk schakelt tussen de dagelijkse praktijk en de grotere opgave in de wijk. Je geeft feedback zonder op macht te sturen, brengt rust en overzicht en krijgt mensen mee. Je wacht niet af: je ziet wat nodig is, maakt het bespreekbaar en pakt door.

Daarnaast:

  • heb je hbo-werk- en -denkniveau, bij voorkeur met een relevante opleiding zoals Social Work, MWD, SPH, Pedagogiek of vergelijkbaar;

  • Heb je een mbo-opleiding én relevante inhoudelijke ervaring? Laat je dan zeker niet tegenhouden en solliciteer vooral jouw praktijkervaring kan juist het verschil maken

  • heb je minimaal 3 jaar ervaring binnen het sociaal domein, jongerenwerk, buurtwerk of een vergelijkbare maatschappelijke omgeving;

  • ben je communicatief sterk, verbindend, proactief en vasthoudend;

  • kun je organiseren, structureren, analyseren en verbeteringen praktisch uitvoeren;

  • heb je een coachende houding en stevige vakinhoudelijke basis;

  • ben je flexibel inzetbaar en voel je je thuis in een dynamische wijk waar niet iedere dag hetzelfde verloopt

Bij DOCK geloven we in mensenwerk met hart en ziel. Dat betekent werken vanuit veiligheid, respect en integriteit. We verwachten dat je handelt volgens onze gedragscode, professioneel samenwerkt, zorgvuldig omgaat met vertrouwelijke informatie en grenzen bewaakt in contact met bewoners en collega’s.

Een VOG maakt onderdeel uit van de procedure.

Wat bieden wij jou

  • Een aanstelling voor 16 uur per week

  • Een jaarcontract, met intentie tot verlenging

  • Salaris conform CAO Sociaal Werk, schaal 9: trede 5 t/m 10 van € 4281,00 – € 4942,00 bruto per maand (o.b.v. 36 uur) (inschaling afhankelijk van opleiding en ervaring)

  • Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB)

  • Loopbaanbudget en ontwikkelmogelijkheden

  • Pensioenopbouw bij Pensioenfonds Zorg & Welzijn

  • Je komt terecht in een jong en bevlogen team, waarin ruimte, veiligheid en samenwerking centraal staan. Amsterdam-Noord is volop in ontwikkeling en DOCK groeit mee. Dat biedt jou volop kansen om initiatief te nemen, mee te bouwen aan nieuwe opdrachten en jezelf als professional verder te ontwikkelen.

Solliciteren

Ben je geïnteresseerd? Solliciteer dan via en upload je cv en motivatie voor 7 september 2026.

Voor inhoudelijke vragen over de functie kun je contact opnemen met Karima Aouled si Ahmed via kaouled@dock.nl


Voor vragen over de sollicitatieprocedure kun je mailen naar recruitment@dock.nl.

title: Residential Counselor - Night Shift, CRP
description:
Days Off: Sunday, Monday

Shift: Night (11:30pm - 8:00am)

Shift Differential: $1.00 per hour

Insurance Benefits: Dental, Life, Long-term Disability, Medical (no premiums/payroll deductions for employee coverage)

Other Benefits: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), ORCA card subsidy, Paid Time Off (34 days per year), Retirement Plan

Union Representation: This position is a part of a union and is represented by SEIU Healthcare 1199NW.


About DESC:

Recognized nationally as an innovator and leader in developing solutions to homelessness, DESC is a social services organization, supportive housing operator, and licensed behavioral health treatment provider focused on meeting the needs of people experiencing long-term homelessness and living with complex behavioral health and other medical conditions. Approximately 3,000 people are actively receiving services from DESC at any given point in time. Our vision is a community where all people are shown compassion, treated with dignity, and everyone has a safe, stable, and affordable place to call home.


DESC operates five shelter/emergency housing programs,19 permanent supportive housing facilities with over 1,750 units, several hundred additional scattered site apartments, and a range of behavioral health services including outpatient mental health and substance use disorder treatment, residential crisis stabilization, street outreach, mobile crisis response, and treatment for opioid use disorder.


JOB DEFINITION:

The Crisis Respite Program (CRP) Counselor is a member of a multi-disciplinary team responsible for providing ongoing assessment, crisis stabilization, engagement, monitoring and supporting short term case management services to homeless and mentally ill adults.


MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Monitor and maintain safety and cleanliness of CRP client rooms, common room and team office.
  • In concert with CRP Treatment plans, consult with other staff and outside agencies as needed regarding client issues and needs.
  • Promote personal and environmental cleanliness among clients.
  • Answer telephones and record messages for clients and staff.
  • Monitor clients and be alert for signs of anxiety, depression, and crises.
  • Intervene in client crises; chart/log these interventions and other significant interactions in CRP and Emergency Housing logs as appropriate.
  • Answer questions about program procedures, goals, rules, and limits.
  • Provide supportive counseling to those clients in need of it.
  • Consult with clinicians regarding program and client issues.
  • Support service plans of CRP clients.
  • Enforce program and Emergency Housing rules in respectful and assertive fashion, and maintain order, while preserving dignity of all concerned.
  • Conduct hourly client room safety checks.
  • Facilitate healthy milieu and positive interaction in client common areas
  • Review client charts for missing documents and bring to the attention of clinicians.
  • Assemble blank charts, as instructed, to meet on-going program needs.
  • Maintain cooperative and respectful working relationships with other DESC staff and staff of other agencies.
  • Work in compliance with state regulations, King County and DESC policies and procedures.
  • Work with and support community volunteers who volunteer during shift.
  • Actively participate in staff meetings and in-service trainings as required by supervisor.
  • Monitor and ensure the return of all linens and other DESC property issued to clients.
  • Bring program and client concerns to the attention of the CRP Program Manager.
  • Document services provided during shift.
  • Comply with medication monitoring procedures.
  • Assist with registration and data entry as needed.
  • Other duties as assigned.

LIVING CONDITIONS:

Support your clients with achieving and maintaining healthy living conditions. This can include but is not limited to attending care conferences related to living conditions, outreaching and supporting clients in their residential units with tools and skills to maintain their units, coordinating with housing staff, participating in cleaning out clients’ units, and documenting barriers to maintaining healthy living conditions.

title: Construction Supervisor Manufacturing Supervisor
description:
Company information:


Volumod (Vol-U-mod) is a multi-family modular construction company located on the Far East Side of Indianapolis, Indiana.


Volumod’s team of more than 100 skilled professionals builds apartment buildings and other multi-family housing in sections - called modules - within a heated-and-cooled facility. On the factory floor, each home moves through 20 different stations, including framing, electrical, plumbing, flooring, drywall, siding, roofing, and interior finish, with kitchens and bathrooms installed, to produce a home that is 90% complete!

At Volumod, we’re not just delivering a better product to our clients. We’re also passionate about seeing lives transformed within the Volumod organization as our employees improve their lives with a great job and whole-person support that helps them thrive in every area. We offer living wages, major medical coverage, 401K contributions, and a culture of hope. Will you join us?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they believe they can perform every job description task. We are most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and that candidate may come from a less traditional background.

About DESC:

Recognized nationally as an innovator and leader in developing solutions to homelessness, DESC is a social services organization, supportive housing operator, and licensed behavioral health treatment provider focused on meeting the needs of people experiencing long-term homelessness and living with complex behavioral health and other medical conditions. Approximately 3,000 people are actively receiving services from DESC at any given point in time. Our vision is a community where all people are shown compassion, treated with dignity, and everyone has a safe, stable, and affordable place to call home.


DESC operates five shelter/emergency housing programs,19 permanent supportive housing facilities with over 1,750 units, several hundred additional scattered site apartments, and a range of behavioral health services including outpatient mental health and substance use disorder treatment, residential crisis stabilization, street outreach, mobile crisis response, and treatment for opioid use disorder.


POSITION OVERVIEW:

DESC is seeking a strategic, relationship-driven fundraising professional to serve as our Individual Giving Coordinator—a key member of the Fund Development team responsible for managing and growing DESC’s mid-level giving and annual fund programs.

As a frontline fundraiser, this role focuses on building meaningful relationships with donors, strengthening engagement, increasing philanthropic support, and advancing donor retention and upgrade strategies. Through thoughtful stewardship, personalized outreach, and strategic solicitation, the Individual Giving Coordinator will manage a portfolio of mid-level donors, oversee DESC’s annual fund and recurring supporter efforts, and support the execution of organization-wide giving campaigns.


The Individual Giving Coordinator will help elevate DESC’s fundraising program by connecting donors to the organization’s mission and impact, while demonstrating a commitment to principles aligned with Community-Centric Fundraising—including centering community voice, promoting equity, and fostering mutual accountability.


The ideal candidate is passionate about advancing DESC’s mission and skilled at building meaningful, lasting relationships with donors and supporters. They are energized by engaging individuals in conversations about community impact and philanthropy and are motivated by helping donors connect their values with opportunities to support DESC’s work.


MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

As the Individual Giving Coordinator, your job duties will include:


Individual Donor Relationship Management

  • Manage a portfolio of 250-300 active and prospective mid-level donors and family foundations.
  • Develop and implement tailored solicitation and stewardship moves management plans.
  • Conduct personal visits to directly solicit gifts, including mid-level and major gifts, with a focus on increasing donor commitment and connection to our work.
  • Share prompt and meaningful gratitude with individual donors in assigned range and portfolio, in accordance with DESC’s gift acknowledgment procedures.
  • Identify donors with the potential and inclination to make major or planned gifts, and flag them for collaborative cultivation.
  • Build trust-based relationships that encourage ongoing engagement and advocacy and center Community Centric Fundraising principles.
  • Communicate accurate information and ideas to DESC supporters, partners, and the public.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of current issues, trends, policies, and funding related to homelessness services to engage knowledgeably with donors, supporters, and community partners, while demonstrating flexibility and adaptability in response to evolving priorities, opportunities, and timelines.

Annual Fund Management

  • With the partnership of DESC’s Sr. Manager – Individual Giving, develop and execute a broad-based annual plan for cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship of non-managed supporters to help DESC’s Individual Giving Team meet revenue goals, maximize donor participation, and encourage renewal and upgrade of gifts.
  • Manage DESC’s monthly donor program and recurring donors' programs including regular communications, donor relations, retention, and growth of program.
  • Track and evaluate the success of the annual giving program and assess the effectiveness of specific strategies.
  • Partner with DESC’s Donor Database Administrator to ensure gifts are accurately coded and segmented, optimize donor data integrity and reporting, and utilize the donor database to track, analyze, and report annual performance metrics related to unmanaged donors.

Prospecting

  • Proactively identify and cultivate new individual donors through research, outreach, and engagement events.
  • Engage in team-wide prospecting strategy meetings and recommend strategy for mid-level and annual fund donors.
  • Represent DESC at public events, presentations, and speaking engagements to educate about the organization’s mission and identify new prospects interested in supporting DESC’s work.

Fundraising Campaigns

  • With the support of DESC’s Sr. Manager – Individual Giving, help spearhead fundraising campaigns including Give-Big, Giving-Tuesday, written appeals and other fundraising events.
  • Conduct personalized outreach and direct ask solicitation to donors for DESC’s fundraising campaigns, giving events, and year-end giving campaigns
  • Coordinate outreach and solicitation efforts for unmanaged donors across annual fundraising campaigns, helping to identify target audiences, tailor messaging, and drive donor engagement and giving.

Data Management & Reporting

  • Maintain donor database (Salesforce) records with donor engagement, significant activities, financial projections and mutli-year gift strategies.
  • Monitor key data performance indicators including donor growth, retention, and revenue.
  • In collaboration with the Sr. Manager of Individual Giving, prepare reports for leadership, committees, and Board stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with DESC’s Donor Database Administrator to develop and maintain donor database systems that support Annual Fund metric planning, tracking, and reporting, and monitor progress toward fundraising goals and key performance indicators.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with DESC's Fund Development Team and other DESC stakeholders to identify opportunities to connect donor interests to organizational priorities and engagement events.
  • Support and attend special events, including large-scale fundraising events and organization-wide events that advance donor engagement, community awareness, and philanthropic support.
  • Contribute to Community Centric Fundraising initiatives, organizational engagement efforts, and annual work planning.
  • Other duties as assigned.

REPORTING STRUCTURE:

This role reports to the Senior Manager of Individual Giving and works closely with DESC’s Fund Development team to ensure alignment with organizational fundraising and communication strategies.

title: Residential Counselor - Swing Shift
description:
Days Off: Friday, Saturday

Shift: Swing

Shift Differential: $0.50 per hour

Insurance Benefits: Medical (no premiums/payroll deductions for employee coverage), Dental, Life, Long-term Disability

Other Benefits: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), ORCA card subsidy, Paid Time Off (34 days per year), Retirement Plan

Union Representation: This position is a part of a union and is represented by SEIU Healthcare 1199NW.


About DESC:

Recognized nationally as an innovator and leader in developing solutions to homelessness, DESC is a social services organization, supportive housing operator, and licensed behavioral health treatment provider focused on meeting the needs of people experiencing long-term homelessness and living with complex behavioral health and other medical conditions. Approximately 3,000 people are actively receiving services from DESC at any given point in time. Our vision is a community where all people are shown compassion, treated with dignity, and everyone has a safe, stable, and affordable place to call home.

DESC operates five shelter/emergency housing programs, 19 permanent supportive housing facilities with over 1,750 units, several hundred additional scattered site apartments, and a range of behavioral health services including outpatient mental health and substance use disorder treatment, residential crisis stabilization, street outreach, mobile crisis response, and treatment for opioid use disorder.


JOB DEFINITION:

We are looking for energized and passionate Residential Counselors to manage basic day-to-day operations at our Permanent Supportive Housing Projects. Residential Counselors assist the individuals living in our supportive housing with their daily needs, with special emphasis on challenges related to severe and persistent mental illness and substance use disorders.


MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Interact with residents in the general milieu and common areas.
  • Assist clinical staff in the coordination of services to residents; contact residents outside service providers as necessary.
  • Assist clinical staff in engaging residents through creative, resourceful strategies that build trust and confidence.
  • Assist clinical staff in the initiation, facilitation and promotion of on-site activities, therapeutic support groups, outings and community meetings.
  • Manage all building operations in the absence of other project and clinical staff as assigned.
  • Operate all functions in lobby office, including checking visitors in and out, answering telephones and monitoring security systems.
  • Maintain safety and security by monitoring all general access areas and enforcing project rules.
  • Intervene in crises, respond to emergencies, and initiate action as required, including contact with emergency response systems.
  • Write significant events involving residents and building operations activities in a daily log; read log daily.
  • Assist with room turnovers, new resident leasing and orientation; rent collection and facilities inspections.
  • Respond to resident complaints.
  • Work cooperatively with clinical and maintenance staff sited at the project and with visiting providers; refer residents to clinical and other staff as necessary
  • Initiate appropriate response to maintenance requests.
  • Participate in staff meetings and trainings.
  • Assist with other property management functions as assigned.
  • Other duties as assigned.

title: Backend Developer - ScaleUp
description:
Backend Developer - ScaleUp

At HubX we build mobile apps, used and loved by millions all around the world.

We have a track record of building and growing mobile apps on various verticals that have reached over 400 million users across 6 continents and 190+ countries.

We are looking for a talented “ Backend Developer ” for the ”ScaleUp” to join our team.

As a talented "Backend Developer” you have plenty of opportunities at your fingertips. So, why should HubX be your next move? We offer you an opportunity to make a huge impact in the lives of millions of users through our products, and even the mobile app industry at large in the next years to come. Ownership is at the core of how we work. From day one, you’re trusted with real responsibility. Together with your team, you’re free to choose a direction, experiment boldly, fail fast, learn, and turn the next idea into something even better.

We operate through 7 independent studios, each focused on building and scaling its own products with full end-to-end ownership. This studio model empowers small, cross-functional teams to move fast, make decisions autonomously, and turn ideas into global products.

Scaleup

ScaleUp Studio allows users to create realistic photos and videos that resemble their own inputs. With apps like Home AI, MyTunes, PlantApp and AI Video, it offers various applications under the Graphic & Design and Photo & Video categories. The main focus is to provide realistic creation solutions while keeping up with trends through different templates and styles.

X Culture: Do What You Love

At HubX, we pride ourselves on fostering an environment of collaboration, creativity, and innovation. Our #XCulture is more than just a workplace ethos; it's a lifestyle. We believe passion drives success. At HubX, Do What You Love isn’t just a motto; it's the foundation of our work.

Some of your responsibilities

  • Develop Backend Applications: Work on creating backend applications and enhance the quality of our system architecture.
  • Refine Integrations Between Applications: Improve and fine-tune the integrations to ensure seamless interaction between different applications.
  • Analyze and Resolve Technical Issues: Identify, analyze, and fix technical and application-related problems.
  • Deploy New Releases: Manage the deployment of new software releases to ensure smooth updates.
  • Act as a key technical reference within the backend team in our Istanbul office, providing technical expertise, supporting team coordination, and ensuring alignment with best practices.

What we look for

  • Educational Background: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Experience: Minimum of 3 year of experience delivering production-ready backend code in an Agile team environment.
  • Technical Knowledge: Solid experience with RESTful APIs, event-driven microservices, and message queues (e.g. Pub/Sub, RabbitMQ), ideally on a cloud-native/serverless stack.
  • Proficiency: Proficient in Node.js (TypeScript) or .NET (C#, .NET Core).
  • Database Knowledge: Knowledge of databases like MongoDB and PostgreSQL.
  • Caching Strategies: Experience with Redis and effective caching strategies.
  • Version Control: Proficient in Git version control, including branching and merging strategies.

Nice to have

  • Experience with microservice architectures and event-driven systems
  • Hands‑on project experience with GCP, AWS, or other cloud platforms
  • Familiarity with whitelabel system structures and chatbot technologies
  • Experience working with .NET / C#

The perks and benefits of working with us

We would like you to focus on what you do best, we take care of the rest.

  • Daily essentials: We provide commuting and meal support to make your workday easier.
  • A brand new MacBook and a designed welcome kit.
  • Wellbeing: We support your overall wellbeing with private medical insurance (TSS), HPV vaccination, Heltia membership, and for our women teammates critical women’s health coverage, and annual Beije membership.
  • Gym Reimbursement: We support annual gym membership because we want you to be in tip‑top shape psychically and mentally.
  • A unique and top‑notch office: Whether you're based in the heart of Istanbul's vibrant Maslak district or enjoying panoramic sunset views from the tallest building in Izmir, you'll work in thoughtfully designed spaces built for creativity and collaboration. Our office is also pet‑friendly, because we believe great workdays include our furry friends too.
  • Office fuel: Unlimited coffee from XPresso, a fully stocked kitchen with breakfast and snacks throughout the day, and our HubX Breakfast Club, where we come together regularly to start the day with good food and even better conversations.
  • Learning & development: We support your continuous learning with an education budget and weekly Cambly speaking sessions.
  • Team events that create lasting memories, including our traditional All Hands gatherings where the whole company comes together, as well as more humble celebrations and happy hours. Curious about our vibe? Take a look at our Instagram!
  • Strong company culture: Our approach is built on open communication and teamwork, strengthened by our #XCulture and community‑driven X clubs that bring people together around shared interests.
  • X Community discounts: Being part of HubX comes with perks, enjoy exclusive discounts and more as a valued member of our community.
  • HubX app memberships: As a HubX teammate, you enjoy complimentary premium access to HubX apps, so you can experience and benefit from the products we build every day.
  • Birthday perks: to celebrate you, we offer a dedicated birthday leave along with a birthday gift voucher, so you can enjoy your special day your way.

The Recruiting Process

At HubX, we value transparency and efficiency. Here’s a glimpse into our streamlined recruitment process:

  • People & Culture Interview: Engage in a conversation with our People & Culture team to discuss your background, aspirations, and how we align with each other’s goals.
  • Case Study Assignment: Showcase your skills through a practical task related to the role.
  • Technical Interview: Meet with your potential team lead for an in-depth review of your case study and technical expertise.
  • Welcome Aboard!: If all goes well, we’re excited to extend an offer and welcome you to the team.

description:
We’re Sonesta International Hotels.
The 8th largest hotel company in the U.S.—and growing fast.

An epic blend of full-service and focused hotels in major cities, Sonesta’s uniquely diverse portfolio of owned, managed, and franchised properties makes us everywhere you want to be. Together We Thrive—bringing quality, value, and amazing hospitality to every guest, every stay, across 1000+ properties in eight countries and counting.

Job Description Summary

The primary responsibility of the Lobby Ambassador is to welcome and initiate the overall first impression of our guest's arrival experience. The Lobby Ambassador monitors traffic flow and guest queues within lobby; directing guests as appropriate to minimize wait times. This position will assist with Concierge Services, Bell Services, and Front Desk Services.

  • Key Job Functions

    • May be required to run guests errands as needed
    • Act as the point of reference for guests who need assistance or information

      • Act as the first point of contact between guests and an organization

      • Understand customer's needs and provide them with personalized solutions by suggesting activities and facilities provided by the hotel
      • Coordinate Guest travel plans as needed
    • Bell Services
      • Greet all guest entering and exiting hotel

The work scope includes on-the-floor Quality oversight of manufacturing activities including observing formulation and aseptic processes, performing AQL visual inspection of finished drug product vials, GMP documentation and Batch Record review, line clear and product changeover activities, disposition of incoming raw materials, review and approval of facility work orders, and other various QA functions as needed. Real time continuous monitoring of manufacturing related systems and processes to ensure compliance with applicable regulatory and industry standards, quality improvements, and safety/efficacy for phase appropriate GMP manufacture of drug products.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Perform QA on-the-floor activities supporting client projects, including room release, auditing critical processes, reviewing GMP documentation in real time, and resolving issues that occur during manufacturing.

  • Act as first responder for on the floor quality issues in a timely manner, documentation of all events/investigations and required immediate corrective actions.
  • Co-ownership of nonconforming material investigations.
  • Review of Quality Control environmental and utility monitoring data and test results
  • Review and approval of work orders impacting manufacturing facilities and utilities
  • Root cause analysis using methodologies, such as: fishbone, 5 whys, etc.
  • Advise and coach internal customers on proper documentation of tasks
  • Initiation of Quality Systems (deviations, CAPA, Nonconformances).
  • Perform Acceptable Quality Limit (AQL) visual inspection of final drug product
  • Support Visual Inspection, packaging, and labeling operations
  • Create, review, and approve final product labels
  • Perform inspection of final product retains
  • SOP revision as it pertains to process improvements.
  • Participate in site quality and process improvement initiatives. Represent QA on project teams and represent QA perspective as necessary.
  • Support internal, client, and regulatory audits and inspections.
  • Obtain Qualified Trainer status on department specific training tasks; train new and less experienced team members.
  • Recommend and support improvement ideas and projects
  • Interact with clients during client visits
  • Guide personnel indirectly and directly involved in GMP operations pertaining to cGMP compliance, internal procedures, regulatory requirements and industry best practices.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant scientific field.
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience in relevant GMP industry, with minimum 1 year experience in Quality, or Equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • ASQ certification is a plus
  • Exposure to RCA, technical writing, and working with quality related investigations

Preferred:

  • Knowledge and ability to apply basic scientific principles to solve operational, as well as routine quality tasks

title: Mondhygiënist / Mondhygiëniste | De Goorn
description:
Tandartspraktijk Kies bestaat uit een hecht en professioneel team van 13 collega’s: 4 tandartsen, 2 mondhygiënisten, 4 assistentes, 2 balie-assistentes en een praktijkmanager. We werken in 4 lichte behandelkamers met moderne apparatuur, waaronder een OPG, BA Ultimate Polisher en een mondscanner, daarnaast beschikken we over een goed uitgeruste sterilisatieruimte.

Er heerst een fijne, overzichtelijke werksfeer waarin iedereen zich welkom voelt. De praktijk is goed bereikbaar met auto, fiets en ov, heeft parkeergelegenheid en winkels in de buurt. Een toegankelijke werkplek waar kwaliteit en samenwerking centraal staan.

Makkelijk te bereiken vanuit Enkhuizen, Purmerend, Alkmaar, Heerhugowaard en natuurlijk Amsterdam!

Wat ga je doen

Jij zorgt voor gezonde monden en blije patiënten. Als mondhygiënist help je bij het voorkomen en behandelen van tandvleesproblemen en geef je advies dat echt het verschil maakt. Een greep uit jouw dagelijkse werkzaamheden:

  • Preventieve en curatieve gebitsreinigingen (waaronder initiële behandelingen, recalls en verwijderen van tandsteen en plaque);

  • Voorlichting geven aan en het motiveren van patiënten over mondverzorging (en opstellen en uitvoeren van behandelplannen);

  • Bijhouden van patiëntendossiers;

  • Nauw samenwerken met tandartsen en andere collega’s in het behandelteam.

Wat wij bieden

  • een dienstverband van 8-16 uur per week;

  • werkdagen: ma en wo;

  • salaris Mondhygiënist / Mondhygiëniste is tussen de €3000 en 6000 per maand afhankelijk van ervaringsjaren;

  • bij goed functioneren is er ruimte voor een vaste aanstelling;

  • reiskostenvergoeding en vakantietoeslag;

  • bij een 38-urige werkweek: 152 uur wettelijk verlof, 38 uur bovenwettelijk verlof en verlof op officiële feestdagen;

  • bedrijfsuitjes, etentjes en borrels, kerstpakket;

  • jaarlijks een Tandarts Today dag voor alle praktijken;

  • jaarlijks € 200,- vergoeding voor het onverzekerde deel van je tandheelkundige behandelingen (voorwaarden van toepassing);

  • werkkleding conform WIP-richtlijnen ter beschikking gesteld door praktijk, denk aan werkjasjes, beschermingsmateriaal, naambadges en een vergoeding schoenen en broeken (voorwaarden van toepassing);

  • artikelen tegen kostprijs, denk aan bleekgel, tandenborstels, tandpasta en ragers;

  • vergoeding 50 % van de lidmaatschappen bij KRT, KRM, NVvp en NVOI. In overleg vergoeding cursussen ten behoeve van het behoud van dit lidmaatschap.

  • bovenstaande voorwaarden gelden voor een loondienstverband. De inhoud van de overeenkomst voor ZZP’ers is in overleg.

Wat wij vragen

  • diploma Mondzorgkunde;

  • Je bent voldoende beschermd tegen Hepatitis B volgens de geldende norm Mondzorg;

  • goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift.

Wil je meer informatie over deze vacature, neem een kijkje op onze website:

Enthousiast?

Wil je je carrière voortzetten of starten als Mondhygiënist / Mondhygiëniste? Solliciteer via de sollicitatiebutton en stuur je CV en motivatie mee.

Over Tandarts Today

Onze teams doen het! Dat is het motto van Tandarts Today. Elke praktijk en medewerker is uniek. Daarom geloven we in sterke, lokale teams, gebaseerd op vertrouwen en ruimte voor ontwikkeling. We hebben oog voor elkaar, denken in oplossingen en zorgen ervoor dat jij met een yes!-gevoel aan het werk bent.

Zo blijven we dicht bij wat écht belangrijk is: het leveren van de beste mondzorg voor onze patiënten. Met de kracht van een keten én de persoonlijke aandacht van een lokale tandartspraktijk, bieden wij het beste van twee werelden.

title: Lead Clinical Supervisor - Night Shift, CDF
description:
Days Off: Sunday, Monday

Shift: Night (10:00PM - 6:30AM)

Shift Differential: $1.00 per hour

Insurance Benefits: Medical (no premiums/payroll deductions for employee coverage), Dental, Life, Long-term Disability

Other Benefits: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), ORCA card subsidy, Paid Time Off (34 days per year), Retirement Plan


About DESC:

Recognized nationally as an innovator and leader in developing solutions to homelessness, DESC is a social services organization, supportive housing operator, and licensed behavioral health treatment provider focused on meeting the needs of people experiencing long-term homelessness and living with complex behavioral health and other medical conditions. Approximately 3,000 people are actively receiving services from DESC at any given point in time. Our vision is a community where all people are shown compassion, treated with dignity, and everyone has a safe, stable, and affordable place to call home.


DESC operates five shelter/emergency housing programs, 19 permanent supportive housing facilities with over 1,750 units, several hundred additional scattered site apartments, and a range of behavioral health services including outpatient mental health and substance use disorder treatment, residential crisis stabilization, street outreach, mobile crisis response, and treatment for opioid use disorder.


JOB DEFINITION

The Crisis Solutions Center (CSC) provides stabilization, treatment, and referral services for up to 46 individuals at a time, with the goal of diverting people experiencing mental illness and substance use disorders from hospitals and jails to a more appropriate therapeutic setting. CSC includes the Crisis Diversion Facility (CDF), a residential acute crisis stabilization program, and Crisis Diversion Interim Services (CDIS), a step-down program serving individuals who are homeless or at risk of homelessness.

In partnership with CSC Project Managers, the Lead Clinical Supervisor provides shift-level clinical and administrative leadership across CDF and CDIS, supporting the implementation of program standards, workflows, and service expectations. This role oversees frontline staff supervision, client engagement, and short-term case management services, while ensuring safe transitions between programs and effective discharge planning. The Lead Clinical Supervisor is a Mental Health Professional and plays a key role in coaching staff, maintaining clinical quality, and supporting integrated operations across the CSC continuum.

This position is not tied to a specific shift and may support day, swing, or night operations based on program needs.


MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Program & Clinical Leadership

  • Support CSC Project Managers in the planning, implementation, and coordination of client care and integrated service delivery across CDF and CDIS.
  • Provide shift-level leadership to ensure consistent engagement, assessment, and short-term stabilization case management services.
  • Implement clinical, case management, and operational practices as directed by Project Managers, and provide feedback on effectiveness, gaps, and emerging needs.
  • Guide and participate in screening and assessment activities to ensure services are appropriately matched to the target population.

title: Finance Lead
description:
Location: Makati City, Metro Manila, Philippines

About the Role

Join SIDE, a global game services company working with developers and publishers around the world to bring games to life.

We are looking for a Finance Lead to manage the end-to-end financial operations of our Philippines business, ensuring accurate accounting records, timely reporting and compliance with Philippine statutory requirements. The role will support cash flow management, audits, budgeting and MIS reporting, while coordinating with internal teams and external agencies to maintain contract accuracy and overall finance process integrity.

What You'll Be Doing

Finance Management

  • Manage finance activities including preparation of the P&L, Balance Sheet and statutory requirements in accordance with local regulations.
  • Maintain and perform bookkeeping functions, including:
    • General Ledger
    • Accounts Payable, including vendor invoice processing and payments
    • Accounts Receivable, including customer invoice processing and payment follow-ups
    • Payroll
    • Local Statutory Reporting
    • Management Reporting (MIS)
  • Develop and maintain timely and accurate financial statements and reports appropriate for users and in accordance with Filipino Accounting Principles.
  • Ensure the organisation meets its statutory requirements by coordinating with the external accounting agency to ensure taxes and income tax requirements are met and that financial information is secure and stored in compliance with current Philippine legislation.
  • Prepare and support all required information for Group and Local Audit requirements and consult with internal and external auditors as necessary.
  • Manage and prepare cash flow forecasts in accordance with policy and ensure that the cash needs of the company are maintained.
  • Raise customer invoices locally once work has been delivered and ensure all supporting executed agreements are in place before invoices are raised and delivered to customers.
  • Coordinate with the Local Accounting Agency to ensure all required inputs are provided and received and appropriate local compliance requirements are adhered to.

MIS and Reporting

  • Maintain financial records for each location / Line of Business in a manner that facilitates management reporting.
  • Assist the India Accounting and Finance team with preparation of the budget by providing relevant information on a regular basis.
  • Manage the monthly MIS and reporting pack and share the required inputs with the Indian team on a regular basis.
  • Respond to enquiries from stakeholders including Sales, Finance and Operations regarding the terms of active contracts.
  • Communicate and manage the workflow of all contract stages.

Other Responsibilities

  • Perform such other duties mandated by the Company as are customarily performed by someone holding this position and undertake other responsibilities the Company may deem appropriate.

What We're Looking For

  • Accounting Degree / Certification
  • 4 to 6 years of experience in bookkeeping and accounting activities
  • Good English speaking and writing skills
  • Good understanding and knowledge of Finance and Local Accounting systems
  • A "Make It Happen" attitude, with the ability to work under pressure and support the organisation based on business requirements
  • Knowledge of the MS D365 application will be a plus
  • Good knowledge of MS Office, specifically Excel and Word
  • A good collaborator with the right attitude towards work

About SIDE

SIDE brings games to life through specialist services spanning game development, quality assurance, art production, localisation, audio production, player support and more. Our technical, creative and business teams work across the global games industry, supporting studios and publishers throughout the game development lifecycle.

If your experience matches the requirements above and you're interested in applying your finance expertise within an international games business, we'd like to hear from you.

description:

Together with our family of brands - Backstage, CAPS, Checks & Balances, Final Draft, Media Services, Sargent-Disc, and The TEAM Companies – we operate as a combined entertainment technology and services provider offering industry standard screenwriting accounting software, digital payroll products, data & reporting, and a host of creative tools. We are a production’s best ally every step of the way. #OneCastOneCrew

Position Overview

Final Draft is seeking an experienced full-stack Tech Lead with a deep understanding of complex cloud-based systems to provide technical and architectural leadership for our engineering team. In this role, you’ll be leading our technical transition from shrink-wrapped and mobile applications development to becoming a cloud-based SaaS company.

You will join our existing team of 13 full-stack software engineers (SWE), software engineers for testing (SDET), product manager, and UI/UX designers who are building platform-agnostic client applications (Windows, MacOS, iOS, and Android), multi-region redundant cloud-based backend services that powered them, and providing API-level access to our third-party partners. We adhere to Lean-Agile and SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework), value independence, autonomy, and trust our engineers to pick the best tools suited for their tasks while working collaboratively towards the common goals. We use Jira to manage various project boards, task and dependencies management and tracking. We also use DORA metrics to provide insight into our software development processes.

As Tech Lead , you will be working on the entire system, front-to-back, including feature development, infrastructure, production reliability and monitoring. While this is an individual contributor role, you will be mentoring engineers and providing code reviews. The approximate division will be 50% hands’ on coding and 50% leadership. Your work will have a direct impact on our very fast-growing existing community and will be seen and used by millions of people around the world in the future.

The Tech Lead will report to Final Draft’s Vice President of Engineering.

Core Responsibilities

  • Lead and mentor our engineering team, and provide code reviews that reflect acceptance criteria, robustness, style, and maintainability

  • Drive technical direction as we move from a desktop and mobile app to a cloud-based company

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that projects are delivered on time and meet business and customer requirements

  • Partner with product team to design and architect new features that will enhance productivity of our writers and solve existing pain points

  • Maintain best practices to ensure platform uptime, stability, and responsiveness, and implement new policies as needed

  • Drive velocity and identify ways we can increase velocity overtime

Key Qualifications

  • Deep expertise in cloud platforms like AWS (strongly preferred), Azure, or GCP is essential.

  • Recent development experience in cloud-based NoSQL (MongoDB is preferred) required

  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript or JavaScript for backend and React, React Native, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for the front-end.

title: Team Lead/Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
Svitla Systems Inc. is looking for a Team Lead/Senior Full Stack Developer for a full-time position (40 hours per week) in Argentina. Our client is a prominent GovTech company offering a cloud-based ERP solution.

You'll lead the platform's small, senior development team. This is both a deeply hands-on engineering role and a technical leadership role: you build across the stack, with your center of gravity in the .NET 10 back end, set the patterns, lead one other senior full-stack engineer, partner with the QA automation engineer, and are accountable for what the team ships. This is a small, senior team by design. We are not looking for people who wait to be handed fully specified tickets. We are looking for engineers who can take an ambiguous problem, reason about it critically on their own, choose a defensible path, and own the outcome end to end. This role sits at the center of a tight senior triangle. You partner daily with the Product Owner, who owns the functional and design specifications, and with the Platform Architect, who owns the architecture specifications and platform-wide technical direction. Your job is to turn both into working software: translate the Product Owner's functional and design specs into sound service and API designs, implement them faithfully within the architecture the Architect sets, and own the delivery of that work through your team, one other senior full-stack engineer and the QA automation engineer.

About the team: They build the platform layer that integrates government-software products, the connective tissue every customer and every product team depends on. That means a personalized Home Portal (an Angular single-page app), a .NET backend-for-frontend that aggregates two dozen module APIs, centralized user management and identity across every acquired application, a unified API management edge, and automated customer provisioning.

The stack is Angular 19 on the front end and ASP.NET Core on .NET 10 / C# on the back end, with Auth0, Azure API Management, EF Core and Dapper against Azure SQL, Azure Service Bus, and Redis, all on Azure. The architecture the team set up now will be held for years.

Requirements

  • Strong experience in production development with C#/.NET and Azure. You know how distributed systems fail and how to build ones that do not.
  • In-depth understanding of back-end development, but also you have confident experience with Angular/ TypeScript for the front end, enough to design across the boundary, review it, and ship it when needed.
  • Working ownership. You have designed non-trivial systems, made the hard trade-offs, and lived with the results, and can explain why you chose what you chose.
  • Technical leadership. You set direction and lead through clarity and example, not gatekeeping.
  • Uncompromising accountability. You own the reliability and security of what the team ships. When it is wrong, you say so first, and you fix the cause.
  • Independent, defensible thinking. You form your own view from first principles, invite challenge, and can be moved by a better argument, and you expect the same of your team.
  • You own features from problem statement to production and beyond. When something you built breaks at 2 a.m., you want to know why and fix the root cause, not paper over it.
  • You hold yourself to the standard before anyone else has to. You say what you will deliver, deliver it, and flag risk early and honestly when reality changes.
  • You find the next most valuable thing to do and start it without being told. Blockers are problems you drive to resolution, not reasons to stop.
  • Independent critical thinking. You question assumptions, including your own and ours. You can defend a technical decision with reasoning and trade-offs, disagree with a senior voice when the evidence supports you, and change your mind when it does not.
  • You bring options to the table, not just problems. You find the simple design hiding inside a complicated requirement, and you are willing to challenge how it has always been done.
  • You are not a passive implementer of either. We expect you to pressure-test a spec when something does not add up, surface technical constraints and trade-offs the Product Owner needs to weigh, and
  • push back on a decision when the evidence warrants, bringing options and a recommendation, not just objections.
  • Clear, early, honest communication in both directions is the core of the role.

Nice to have

  • Experience with FastEndpoints, .NET Aspire, Clean Architecture, and service-oriented (non-CQRS) designs.
  • Experience with Azure SQL performance work, EF Core migrations, and multi-schema / multi-tenant data design.
  • Understanding of Angular/Blazor for front-end, and a track record of mentoring senior engineers in a government / public-sector, ERP, or multi-tenant SaaS context.
  • Experience in integrating LLMs, RAG, or AI agents into product features, beyond using an AI code assistant.
  • Understanding of building and owning CI/CD pipelines and release management in Azure DevOps.
  • Familiarity with GitHub (including GitHub Actions) and Jira as the team migrates toward these tools.

Responsibilities

  • Lead by doing: write and review the hardest code, design the critical paths, and set the standard for FastEndpoints, FluentResults, testing, error handling, and observability across the .NET 10 services (backend-for-frontend, user management, and more) on Azure.
  • Own identity, authorization, and tenancy correctness across Auth0, Azure API Management, and the service layer, where mistakes are security incidents.
  • Guide EF Core and Dapper data design against Azure SQL for correctness and performance at scale, no N+1s, no accidental cross-tenant reads, no surprise table scans.
  • Work across the stack when delivery calls for it, including the Angular 19 front end, so no part of the platform stalls on a single person.
  • Shape the messaging and integration backbone, Azure Service Bus events between the platform and the acquired module teams.
  • Lead the team day-to-day, mentor the other engineer, run pragmatic design and code reviews, and create the conditions for senior people to do their best work.
  • Represent the platform in cross-team architecture decisions and defend those decisions with clear reasoning and trade-offs.

Why join Svitla

Svitla Systems is a global digital solutions company headquartered in the U.S. and operating across the Americas, Europe, Asia, and APAC. Since 2003, we have served a wide range of clients - from innovative start-ups to Fortune 500 companies. Our success is built on partnership. By integrating seamlessly with clients' teams, we create lasting collaborations that drive real results. We are strong advocates of workplace flexibility, remote culture, individual approach to professional and personal growth.

Our global mission is to build a business that contributes to wellbeing of our partners, personnel, and their families, improves our communities, and makes a lasting difference in the world. Together, we are coding a brighter tomorrow - and living it.

About Us

At Cast & Crew, we’ve empowered creativity and supported the global entertainment industry for decades. Together with our family of brands - Backstage, CAPS, Checks & Balances, Final Draft, Media Services, Sargent-Disc, and The TEAM Companies – we operate as a combined entertainment technology and services provider offering industry standard screenwriting accounting software, digital payroll products, data & reporting, and a host of creative tools. The industry continues to move faster than ever, and the need for our expertise, our technology, and our people has never been greater. We are a production’s best ally every step of the way. #OneCastOneCrew

Position Overview

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Security Operations (SecOps) Manager to lead our security operations team in protecting the endpoints, identities, email, and corporate data that power the entertainment industry's payroll and financial operations. This role is critical to detecting, responding to, and preventing security threats against the systems and data that our clients—major studios, streaming platforms, and production companies—rely on every day.

As the SecOps Manager, you will lead a team responsible for security monitoring, incident response, endpoint protection, email security, identity security and governance, and security awareness. You'll work at the intersection of security operations, threat detection, and incident management, partnering closely with IT, engineering, and business teams to ensure rapid response to threats and continuous improvement of our security posture.

This is a leadership role for someone who is equally comfortable setting operational strategy, mentoring team members, and rolling up their sleeves to investigate complex security incidents. You will manage a team of security analysts and engineers, drive our security operations maturity, lead incident response efforts, and champion a security-first culture across the organization.

Core Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive security operations strategy aligned with business objectives and risk tolerance

  • Define the roadmap for security monitoring, detection, and response capabilities across the enterprise

  • Partner with IT and infrastructure teams to embed security monitoring and controls across the systems they own and administer

  • Establish and mature incident response processes, playbooks, and escalation procedures

  • Own the operational security metrics—detection and response times, endpoint coverage and compliance, phishing resilience—that feed our established executive security KPI program, reporting progress to the CISO

  • Participate in proofs of concept and design partnerships with emerging security vendors — particularly AI-driven technologies — helping evaluate new products and shape their roadmaps alongside security leadership

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of security analysts and engineers

  • Foster a collaborative, learning-oriented team culture that balances security rigor with operational efficiency

  • Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development planning for direct reports

  • Scale the team as the organization grows, including hiring and onboarding new security talent

  • Provide technical guidance and remove blockers to enable your team's success

Security Operations & Incident Response

  • Oversee security monitoring and SIEM operations, ensuring effective detection and alerting

  • Lead incident response efforts, conducting investigations, root cause analysis, and implementing preventive measures

  • Serve as the escalation point for critical and after-hours security incidents, and manage on-call rotations and escalation workflows for the team

  • Manage endpoint detection and response (EDR) platforms and endpoint security posture

  • Oversee email security operations including anti-phishing, anti-malware, and email gateway management

  • Lead security awareness and training programs to reduce human risk factors

  • Develop and maintain incident response playbooks, runbooks, and tabletop exercises

  • Manage day-to-day operational relationships with security tooling vendors and managed service providers

Identity Security & Governance

  • Define identity security policy and standards — single sign-on (SSO), multi-factor authentication (MFA), and conditional access requirements — for the identity platforms administered by IT

  • Monitor user and permissions hygiene across the enterprise, including joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle and least-privilege enforcement, driving remediation with IT

  • Lead periodic access reviews and certification campaigns in partnership with IT and GRC

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with IT and infrastructure teams to ensure security tools integrate effectively with enterprise systems

  • Partner with the GRC team on SOC 2 compliance requirements related to security operations, including control evidence and audit support

  • Collaborate with the Product Security team on monitoring, detection, and response for application-layer threats

  • Communicate security risks, incidents, and priorities effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Key Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in security operations, incident response, or related security roles, including 3+ years directly managing security teams (hiring, performance management, and career development)

  • Deep technical expertise in at least two of the following areas:

    • Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) administration and log analysis

    • Incident response and digital forensics

    • Endpoint detection and response (EDR) platforms

    • Email security and anti-phishing technologies

    • Identity security and governance, including IdP policy design (e.g., Okta, Microsoft Entra ID), SSO/MFA/conditional access, and access lifecycle governance

    • Security awareness and training program management

  • Strong understanding of common attack vectors, threat intelligence, and detection methodologies

  • Experience developing and executing incident response playbooks and tabletop exercises

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex security concepts to diverse audiences

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Industry certifications such as CISSP, GCIH, GCFA, GCIA, or Security+

  • Experience in regulated industries (finance, healthcare, entertainment) with compliance requirements

  • Familiarity with SOAR platforms and security automation

  • Experience with cloud security monitoring (AWS, Azure)

  • Knowledge of threat hunting and proactive detection techniques

  • Experience managing managed security service provider (MSSP) relationships

  • Experience supporting SOC 2 audits

  • Experience with proofs of concept or design partnerships with emerging security vendors, particularly AI-based tooling

Key Competencies & Attributes

  • Strategic thinker who can balance long-term vision with short-term execution

  • Collaborative leader who builds trust and influence across teams

  • Calm under pressure with the ability to lead effectively during security incidents

  • Pragmatic problem-solver who understands business context and risk tradeoffs

  • Continuous learner who stays current with evolving threats, tools, and best practices

  • Clear communicator who can articulate security priorities to executives and board members

  • Empathetic manager who invests in team growth and creates psychological safety

Special Work Conditions

  • Sedentary – Involves sitting most of the time but may involve walking or standing for brief periods of time. Some positions may entail exerting up to 15 lbs. of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force to lift, carry, push, or pull.

  • Travel up to 5%
