  • Associate's degree and 3 years or related work experience

  • In Lieu of degree and 3 years work experience, HS Diploma or GED and 7 years of experience

Basic / Required Qualifications - RRE Maintenance Coordinator (MC) - Basic / Required Qualifications

  • Associate's degree and 5 years or related work experience

  • In Lieu of degree and 5 years work experience, HS Diploma or GED and 9 years of experience

Specific Requirements

  • Must have the ability to be respirator qualified

  • Basic knowledge of power plant operation and the Work Management process

  • Working knowledge of company computer systems/programs that are utilized in the Work Management process

  • Basic scheduling tool knowledge

  • Demonstrated effective time management skills

  • Demonstrated effective skills in problem solving

  • Ability to effectively perform independently with minimal direction

  • Interpersonal skills to effectively work with all station groups

  • Basic ability to lead effective/efficient meetings

  • Good written and oral communication skills

Additional Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience and demonstrated computer skills including the ability to use various applications such as Microsoft Office Products (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Project), work management system (Maximo), Plant Information (PI) program

  • Experience and demonstrated written and oral communication skills, including the ability to present information, facilitate meetings and provide direction to others

  • Working knowledge of overall operating fundamentals and principles of generating station systems, equipment and processes

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently in a leadership capacity

  • Demonstrated ability and previous experience in understanding, interpreting, communicating and analyzing financial data

  • At least 5 years of plant operations, maintenance, and/or work management experience

  • Proficient interpreting and understanding equipment/component diagrams, drawings, and schematics

  • Financial and accounting knowledge and skills including ability to analyze data

  • 2 years of experience in contract management

  • 2 years of experience in project management

  • Proficient in Maximo or computer-based Maintenance Management Systems

  • Must be able to read, comprehend, inspect, calculate, count, retain and make sound decisions

Working Conditions

  • Required to observe work in all areas of generating facilities which are power plant, industrial environments operating 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, which includes exposure to heat, cold, noise, dust and humidity

  • May be required to climb ladders and stairs at various heights; enter vessels or equipment with limited access; walk, stoop, bend or squat

Mobius is an award winning, Small Business Administration (SBA) certified Historically Underutilized Business Zone (HUBZone) company and certified Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB) providing engineering, analytical, and programmatic expertise to the Federal Government and commercial customers. Our mission is to provide innovative advanced technology solutions to customers facing issues of national and global significance. Come join our team! Mobius is seeking a Navy Insider Threat HUB Analyst. In this role, you will study, analyze, advise, research and develop deliverables to advance the detection, deterrence and mitigation of insider threat activity in the Department of the Navy (DoN), while safeguarding National Security, service information and data on both Navy and civilian contractor’s information systems through the application of knowledge and resources in achieving the Navy’s mission requirements defined herein. The OPNAV Insider Threat Hub possesses an integrated capability to monitor, audit, fuse, and analyze incoming information for insider threat detection and mitigation. Hub personnel analyze information and activity indicative of an insider risk and refer that data to the appropriate officials for investigation and/or resolution.

Duties of a Navy Insider Threat HUB Analyst may include:

  • Perform in one or more of the following areas: cyber threat analysis, incident response, intrusion detection, network/computer forensics, data loss prevention technologies, enterprise audit analysis, and/or automated Audit/Anomaly Threat Detection technology.
  • Assist in the development, implementation, and management of Insider Threat/cybersecurity collection, detection, deterrence, analysis, and mitigation
  • Conduct information technology audits, incident responses, and/or network monitoring at the Enterprise level, to include the use of security tools to conduct such work.
  • Assist in generating analysis reports and briefing other team members and/or senior management on analytical findings as well as support the development of Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs)
  • Receive automated user activity monitoring/audit data and alerts from sensors deployed on Navy’s classified and unclassified SCI networks from the UAM Team and include those findings “if any” in their analytical report and/or Insider Threat Risk Assessment (ITRA).
  • Provide the Government, tracking metrics captured on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis: Cases worked, closed, and current open cases that should reflect the analyst duties and workload. Metrics also include Insider Threat Risk Assessments written, submissions into the Navy’s case management system, and the DoD Insider Threat Management Analysis Center System of Systems (DITMAC DSOS).
  • Perform analysis and provide assessments to the Government and assist the Government in resolving identified discrepancies in an attempt to detect, deter, and mitigate a potential Insider Threats.
  • Assist with the facilitation of testing new/existing software for the purpose of case management, data set review, and/or the development of Hub related policies.
  • Evaluate existing Hub related policies, modify policies where needed to achieve program objectives, and/or develop new policies as necessary.

title: Director, Investor Relations & Communications
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Investor Relations & Communications based in United States.

This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for shaping corporate narrative, investor engagement, and external communications within an innovative life sciences organization.
You will serve as a key relationship owner for current and prospective investors, analysts, media, and other strategic stakeholders.
The role combines investor relations, corporate communications, executive positioning, and strategic storytelling around important clinical, regulatory, and financial milestones.
You will translate complex scientific and financial information into clear, compelling, and compliant communications that strengthen market understanding and confidence.
Working cross-functionally with Finance, Clinical, Regulatory, Legal, and Corporate Operations, you will ensure consistent messaging across internal and external audiences.
You will also help establish the investor infrastructure and communication strategy needed to support future financing activities and long-term market positioning.
This opportunity is ideal for an experienced life sciences communications professional who thrives in a fast-paced, high-stakes, and highly visible environment.

Accountabilities

  • Develop and execute the investor relations strategy, including engagement planning, proactive investor outreach, content development, and relationship tracking.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for current and prospective investors, equity analysts, relevant media, and other external stakeholders.
  • Develop and maintain investor-facing materials, including presentations, fact sheets, financing announcements, press releases, Q&A documents, and corporate communications.
  • Manage public-facing communication channels, including the corporate website and social platforms, ensuring messaging is accurate, timely, consistent, and compliant.
  • Coordinate investor and analyst engagement through conferences, non-deal roadshows, industry events, and other strategic forums.
  • Lead messaging around key corporate milestones, including clinical data readouts, regulatory developments, financings, grants, partnerships, and commercial progress.
  • Monitor investor sentiment, market developments, competitive activity, sector trends, and peer communications to inform leadership decisions and external positioning.
  • Manage relationships with external investor relations and public relations agencies, ensuring effective execution, visibility, and crisis-response support.
  • Prepare executives for investor meetings, media interactions, conferences, and speaking engagements through tailored briefings, messaging, and coaching.
  • Establish a consistent investor communications cadence, including recurring updates, Board-related communications, quarterly reporting, and ad hoc news flow.
  • Translate internal business and scientific developments into compelling investor-facing narratives while maintaining accuracy and strategic consistency.
  • Partner with Clinical, Regulatory, CMC, Legal, Finance, and other functions to ensure external communications meet technical, financial, legal, and compliance requirements.
  • Support internal communications and collaborate across corporate functions to maintain alignment between internal messaging and external positioning.
  • Contribute to Board materials, corporate reporting, strategic communications, and investor engagement initiatives.
  • Support the organization's presence at scientific conferences, trade shows, and investor events, helping strengthen pre-commercial positioning as programs advance.

    • Requirements:

    • 8–12 years of experience in investor relations, corporate communications, strategic finance, or related functions within biotech, pharmaceutical, healthcare, orthopedic, or life sciences organizations.
    • Proven experience developing and executing investor relations strategies and managing relationships with buy-side and sell-side stakeholders.
    • Demonstrated experience supporting or leading investor communications within a pre-commercial or early-commercial life sciences company.
    • Deep understanding of the biotech and life sciences landscape, including capital markets, development milestones, clinical communications, and regulatory considerations.
    • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex scientific, clinical, and financial information into clear and compelling narratives.
    • Strong understanding of how investor communications can support corporate positioning, fundraising, strategic partnerships, and long-term value creation.
    • Experience coordinating closely with Clinical, Regulatory, Legal, Finance, and other functions to produce accurate and compliant external communications.
    • Strong organizational and project-management capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple high-priority initiatives and tight deadlines.
    • Excellent independent judgment, discretion, and professionalism when handling confidential or sensitive corporate information.
    • Confidence serving as a public-facing representative at investor meetings, conferences, media engagements, and industry events.
    • Bachelor's degree required; an MBA, MS, or equivalent advanced degree in life sciences, finance, communications, or a related discipline is strongly preferred.
    • Experience with corporate websites, social media, and cross-channel communications supporting investor and reputational objectives is advantageous.
    • Familiarity with SEC regulations and disclosure practices relevant to private and public biotech organizations is preferred.
    • Experience managing PR/IR agencies and external communications campaigns is desirable.
    • Financial analysis or capital markets experience, including the ability to interpret market sentiment and peer performance, is a plus.
    • Experience with crossover financing rounds, IPO positioning, or strategic partnerships is advantageous.
    • Orthopedic or MedTech industry experience is particularly valuable.

      • Benefits:

      • High-visibility leadership opportunity within an innovative life sciences organization.
      • Significant ownership of investor relations, corporate narrative, and external positioning.
      • Opportunity to work closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams across Clinical, Regulatory, Finance, Legal, and Corporate Operations.
      • Direct exposure to major clinical, regulatory, financing, and strategic milestones.
      • Opportunity to shape investor infrastructure and communications strategy ahead of future growth and commercialization.
      • Collaborative environment with meaningful strategic responsibility and executive visibility.
      • Opportunity to engage with investors, analysts, scientific communities, strategic partners, and industry leaders.

Join a technical team focused on supporting and scaling modern cloud-based data environments.
In this role, you will help application teams onboard to Databricks and build reliable Data Landing Zones (DLZ).
You will work with Azure resources, Infrastructure as Code, automation, and deployment pipelines to deliver efficient solutions.
As a first-line technical point of contact, you will troubleshoot requests and help resolve issues through structured support processes.

It is an excellent opportunity to deepen your expertise in Databricks, Azure, IaC, and cloud automation while making a direct impact on data platform operations.

  • Execute pipelines, scripts, and automated processes to provision, configure, or modify Azure and Databricks resources.
  • Support the deployment of commonly requested Azure resources using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.
  • Identify repetitive manual activities and develop automation to improve efficiency, consistency, and support response times.
  • Collaborate with application, cloud, data, and other cross-functional teams to resolve technical issues and ensure smooth onboarding.
  • Create, maintain, and continuously improve documentation covering support procedures, workflows, configurations, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of cloud support operations and the overall Databricks environment.

    • Requirements:

    • 1–3 years of hands-on experience working with Databricks in a technical or operational environment.
    • 1–3 years of experience with Azure Data Factory.
    • Previous experience in application support, technical operations, cloud support, or a similar role.
    • Familiarity with major cloud platforms, particularly Azure, with exposure to AWS or GCP considered an advantage.
    • Experience using source-control systems such as Git, GitHub, or GitLab.
    • Understanding of Databricks capabilities such as Unity Catalog, role-based access control (RBAC), authentication mechanisms, and Delta Sharing is highly desirable.
    • Experience working within the Azure ecosystem and understanding of cloud resource management.
    • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, or AWS CDK.
    • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation platforms such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions is a plus.
    • Scripting or development experience with Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar technologies.
    • Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities, combined with attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
    • Ability to communicate clearly with application teams and collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

      • Benefits:

      • Collaborative environment with opportunities to work closely with application and cross-functional technical teams.

title: Energy Consultant
description:
Salary: £35,000 - £45,000 depending on experience.

Location: Remote-first, flexible working arrangements, with all UK-based locations considered. Our flexible office collaboration spaces, for those wishing to use them, are in London, Exeter, Birmingham and Bristol.

Term: Permanent, full-time (up to 40 hours per week). Reduced hours and flexible working patterns may be considered. Please state any requirements or preferences in your application.

Grade: Consultant.

Closing Date: 13th September 2026. Applications for this position may close early if a suitable candidate is found before the closing date. Early application is recommended.

We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of sex, gender identity, age, disability, ethnicity, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

We are only accepting direct applications (no recruiters please).

Unfortunately, we cannot consider applications requiring visa sponsorship now, or in the future.

ABOUT CITY SCIENCE

City Science was founded in 2015 with a core mission of delivering decarbonisation. We help organisations who are committed to decarbonisation achieve meaningful and quantifiable carbon reductions quickly and efficiently. We work collaboratively across our business to provide integrated solutions to our clients. Our range of clients is extensive and includes major bodies such as DESNZ, the Climate Change Committee (CCC), and a range of forward-thinking local authorities. Our business includes award-winning research, software and product development teams who produce innovative and uniquely insightful digital tools, like our GIS software, Cadence, to successfully deliver our projects.

Our Energy & Environment team leads complex consulting commissions across a broad range of technical disciplines and technologies. Examples of the projects we deliver includes:

  • District Heat Network studies (we are a supplier on the Heat Network Zoning DESNZ framework)

  • Local Area Energy Plans (LAEP) and Local Heat & Energy Efficiency Strategies (LHEES)

  • Renewable & Low Carbon Energy Assessments

  • Alternative Fuel Strategies (e.g. Hydrogen, SAF) and Industrial Decarbonisation

  • Technology specific research (such as our DACCS work for the Climate Change Committee)

Further information about some example projects we have delivered can be found on our website.

ABOUT THE ROLE

City Science is seeking a Consultant level candidate who can support delivery of our broad range of consulting commissions in our Energy & Environment Team.

We are particularly interested in candidates with a technical background (e.g. physical sciences or engineering), or those with an economics/finance background but with experience of applying these skills to the energy and low-carbon sectors.

Whilst our preference is for candidates with professional experience (2+ years), we encourage applications from those who have recently completed a relevant PhD. Experience in areas such as district heat networks, carbon accounting (particularly scope 3 emissions), local area energy plans, community energy and renewable energy is highly desirable.

You will contribute to the delivery of projects via research, report writing, analysis, and the production of models. Whilst a key requirement of this role is technical proficiency, we also have an expectation that you will contribute to common consultancy non-technical tasks such as project management, bid writing, stakeholder engagement, and client relationship management. We are a small consultancy, and everyone contributes across a range of activities, supports the achievement of business objectives, and helps identify future opportunities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Consultant within City Science’s Energy & Environment team, you will be responsible for:

· Research, modelling, and analysis across a range of energy and net zero projects

· Data analysis (in Excel predominantly).

· Producing high quality reports and presentations for clients

· Supporting business development and the winning of new work, including preparing proposals, identifying new opportunities and promoting our business.

· Providing quality assurance for projects and technical deliverables

· Build and maintain strong client relationships.

ABOUT YOU

You’re motivated, proactive and customer-focused with exceptional attention to detail and the needs of our clients. You have broad technical knowledge and a genuine interest in decarbonisation, sustainability and low carbon solutions.

You’re a great collaborator, committed to the success of the team, with the flexibility to intelligently adapt to the task at hand. Most importantly, you are motivated to deliver high-quality work, solve complex problems and contribute positively to the success of the team.

Essential Requirements

· 2+ years of relevant work experience, or a PhD.

· Degree qualified in a STEM subject, or degree qualified in economics/finance with experience of applying those skills to decarbonisation or sustainability projects and technologies.

· Demonstrable knowledge and understanding across the energy and environment sectors.

· Strong Excel skills and data visualisation capabilities.

· Independent problem solving and ability to develop structured approaches.

· Ability to efficiently produce high-quality reports and documents.

· Ability to communicate technical outputs to a range of technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Desirable

· A PhD, or Master’s degree in finance or a relevant technical discipline.

· Chartered status or working towards chartership.

· Completed project management qualifications (e.g. PRINCE2, APM).

· Knowledge and experience of GIS and coding (e.g. Python).

· Experience of working in a consultancy environment.

· Experience of one or more of: district heat networks, carbon accounting (particularly scope 3 emissions), energy system modelling, local area energy planning, or net zero financing.

If you're excited by this opportunity but don't meet every listed requirement, we encourage you to apply. We recognise that relevant skills and experience can be developed through different routes.

REWARDS & BENEFITS

This role offers:

· The opportunity to work on a diverse range of projects across our consultancy business.

· The opportunity for career progression.

· Ongoing mentoring, training and support from senior professionals within the business (including towards professional chartership).

· Paid membership of one professional institution.

· Flexible working arrangements.

· 25 days annual leave entitlement, plus bank holidays, and ability to buy a further 5 days.

· Membership of our group pension scheme.

· Enhanced maternity and paternity policy.

· Eye care vouchers.

· Cycle to work scheme.

· Employee assistance programme.

FURTHER INFORMATION
We are building a team that is motivated by collaboration and a desire to solve problems for our customers. We want people to take ownership of their area of responsibility, make informed decisions, be proactive and take pride in their work.

title: Restaurant Hostess
location: Saybrook Point Resort and Marina - Old Saybrook, CT 06475
description:
Job Title: Restaurant Hostess

FLSA Classification: Non- Exempt (Hourly)

Salary Range: Prevailing Minimum Wage- $19.00 per hour

Reports to: Restaurant Manager

Summary/objective: Welcome and warmly greets guests on arrival. Answer telephone within 3 rings, take reservations and manage the efficient and timely seating of our guests to a table that best serves their wishes.

Essential functions

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

  • Greet each guest, enthusiastically and with a smile to create a friendly positive experience.
  • Schedules dinging reservations for guests in advance. Often makes a decision about where the group will sit.
  • When immediate seating is limited, records guest names and number of people in party.
  • Provide guests with estimated waiting time, always maintaining a professional, courteous attitude when confronted with hostile, impatient or irate guests.
  • Seats guests based on guest preferences and balancing of customer flow in service stations.
  • Call out name and number of party when tables become available.
  • Directs and instructs the dining room personnel on customer needs to ensure customers receive fast and quality service from the moment they arrive.
  • Should a party have special needs or request accommodations, hostess ensures the groups requirements are met. This may include services needed for small children, as well as for individuals with disabilities or food allergies.
  • Upon seating, offer guests a menu and inform them of their servers name. Inspect table for proper presentation and completeness.
  • Thanks guests as they leave and invite them to return.
  • Relay guest comments or suggestions to the manager.
  • Explain the restaurant concept to guests.
  • Filling in for absent staff as needed.
  • Assisting with special events as needed.
  • Understand and can communicate products and services available at the Inn and Spa.
  • Perform all other duties as assigned by management.
  • Fully aware of and comply with Inns policies and procedures as identified in the procedure manual and handbook.
  • Adhere to all Health and Safety policies and procedures

Work environment

  • Working conditions are based in a hospitality setting.
  • May be indoor or outdoor setting depending on outlet.
  • Associates may be exposed to weather conditions prevalent at the time.
  • Noise level in work environment is usually moderate.

Physical demands

  • To perform this job successfully, the individual must be able to stand, move and work throughout the food and beverage area and property, including walking up to 1 ½ mile, climbing stairs and sitting at a desk/workstation for the duration of the shift.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands and fingers, handle or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl; talk or hear; taste or smell.
  • The associate must occasionally lift and/or move up to 30 pounds.
  • Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus.

Saybrook Point Resort & Marina requires all newly hired employees to provide documentation that they are legally authorized to work in the United States.

Affirmative Action/EEO statement

Saybrook Point Resort & Marina is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against otherwise qualified applicants on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, gender identity or expression, or veteran status.

Offered Benefits

All employees are eligible for our 401(k)-retirement savings plan, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), employee discounts, holiday premium pay for hours worked on designated holidays, and financial assistance through our Employee Relief Fund and Hardship Loan Program. Eligible full-time employees also receive medical, dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, paid holidays, and tuition reimbursement.

title: Junior Controller (€ 3.500 - € 5.000)
description:
Wil jij groeien in Finance & Control binnen een innovatieve hightech omgeving waar jouw werk direct bijdraagt aan overzicht en betere beslissingen?

Als Junior Controller zorg je voor een betrouwbare financiële basis én krijg je de kans om je stap voor stap te ontwikkelen in het brede vak van controlling. Je werkt mee aan administratie, afsluitingen, rapportages en analyses. Daarbij leer je van ervaren collega’s en krijg je steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Verwerken en controleren van facturen, debiteuren, crediteuren en grootboek.

  • Bewaken van kwaliteit, volledigheid en juistheid van de financiële administratie.

  • Ondersteunen bij maand-, kwartaal- en jaarafsluitingen.

  • Voorbereiden van rapportages, analyses, auditinformatie en liquiditeitsprognoses.

  • Signaleren van afwijkingen en verbeteren van processen en digitalisering.

description:

Volumod (Vol-U-mod) is a multi-family modular construction company located on the Far East Side of Indianapolis, Indiana.


Volumod’s team of more than 100 skilled professionals builds apartment buildings and other multi-family housing in sections - called modules - within a heated-and-cooled facility. On the factory floor, each home moves through 20 different stations, including framing, electrical, plumbing, flooring, drywall, siding, roofing, and interior finish, with kitchens and bathrooms installed, to produce a home that is 90% complete!


The modules are then wrapped, transported by semi truck, and lifted with a crane to form multifamily communities. Modular construction improves speed, consistency, quality, and efficiency compared with traditional, onsite construction, bringing value to our clients.


At Volumod, we’re not just delivering a better product to our clients.   • Check parts for accuracy and quality.

  • Communicate production issues, material needs, and quality concerns to supervision

Work Environment:

  • Indoor manufacturing and woodworking shop

Eligible employees receive medical, dental, and vision insurance, along with company-paid life and disability coverage. title: Failure Analysis Engineer
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

Key Responsibilities

  • Component-Level Troubleshooting: Analyze electronic circuits and individual PCB components to identify and diagnose faults, failures, and performance issues.
  • PCB and Transceiver Module Inspection: Inspect PCBs and transceiver modules for visible defects, including solder bridges, cold solder joints, component placement errors, and damaged components.
  • Failure Analysis: Conduct failure analysis on transceiver modules, evaluating optical, electrical, and mechanical components to determine root causes of defects and malfunctions.
  • Testing and Diagnostics: Utilize a variety of test and diagnostic equipment, including oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, spectrum analyzers, optical spectrometers, and other specialized instruments.
  • Documentation and Reporting: Maintain detailed records of analyses, findings, corrective actions, and solutions. Prepare comprehensive failure analysis reports and technical documentation.
  • Repair and Rework: Perform repair and rework activities on PCBs and transceiver modules, including soldering, desoldering, component replacement, and validation testing.
  • Data Analysis: Analyze test and manufacturing data from PCBs and transceiver modules to identify trends, recurring issues, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Quality Control and Continuous Improvement: Ensure repaired and reworked products meet quality standards and specifications. Collaborate with Quality teams to analyze failure statistics, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions to reduce recurrence.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience for bachelor’s degree holders, or 3 years for Master's degree holders, in test engineering within the optoelectronic devices, optical transceiver/transponder, or fiber-optic communications industries.
  • Proficiency in statistical analysis tools, such as Minitab, JMP, SQL, or Python.

Working conditions consist of a normal office environment. Work is primarily sedentary and requires extensive use of a computer and involves sitting for periods of approximately four hours. Work may require occasional standing, walking, kneeling and reaching. Must be able to lift 10 pounds occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently. title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer
description:
Omilia is a leader in Conversational AI. Our cloud platform powers natural, human like customer conversations over voice and chat for some of the largest enterprises in banking, insurance, telecommunications and hospitality, handling hundreds of millions of interactions a year. We build our own deep tech across the stack, from speech recognition and natural language understanding to dialog management, and we integrate natively with the major CCaaS platforms. We are a company of roughly 500 people, distributed across Europe and North America, in the middle of an ambitious platform modernization program: Kubernetes everywhere, autoscaling for every service, a next generation observability stack, and AI woven through our own engineering lifecycle.

Role Purpose

Omilia Cyber is looking for a Senior Cloud Security Engineer with strong DevOps expertise to safeguard our AWS cloud ecosystem. Core to the role: adopting GitOps methodologies, developing Terraform, and executing secure updates through CI/CD pipelines. The role leads strategic security projects, automates protection mechanisms, and partners across teams to strengthen cloud security posture.

Accountabilities:

  • ﻿﻿Design, implement, and manage security policies using a Policy as Code approach; write Terraform and deploy changes via peer-reviewed CI/CD pipelines.
  • Integrate and maintain automated security scanning tools within CI/CD pipelines to catch misconfigurations before they are merged.
  • Monitor, manage, and respond to findings using CSPM/CNAPP tools; drive remediation of cloud risks, threats, misconfigurations, and compliance violations with engineering teams.
  • Identify and implement cloud controls to strengthen security posture, and validate controls are enforced across the entire cloud ecosystem.
  • Design and implement automation that detects non-compliance and self-heals in real time.
  • Proactively review and respond to security threats and anomalies from detection and alerting tools; support incident response, penetration test findings, and audit remediation.
  • Partner with Engineering, Platform, Compliance, and Product teams to embed security best practices into the SDLC and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Ensure products meet or exceed industry regulations and internal standards; maintain security processes, policies, and documentation.
  • Support audits and assessments, providing evidence of compliance and driving remediation efforts.
  • Review network security controls and access entitlements, eliminating overpermissive access and maintaining least privilege.

Requirements

Technical / Professional Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in cloud security, infrastructure security, or a hands-on DevSecOps technical role.
  • Deep practical experience writing and managing Terraform, with a strong background in deploying and managing infrastructure via CI/CD pipelines.
  • Deep expertise in AWS security services (e.g., Security Hub, GuardDuty, IAM, CloudTrail, Config).
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language (Python, Bash, Go) for automation tasks.
  • In-depth understanding of cloud security principles, Kubernetes, network security, access control, and incident response procedures.

Soft / Behavioural Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and strong communication skills.
  • Capacity to lead initiatives and collaborate effectively with diverse teams and external partners.

Formal Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Information Security (nice to have).
  • Security certifications (e.g., CISSP, CCSP, CCSK, GIAC) are a plus.
  • DevOps certifications (e.g., Terraform Certified Associate) are a plus.
  • Cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect, AWS Certified Security) are a plus.
  • Understanding of AI and contact center industries is a plus.

Benefits

  • Fixed compensation;
  • Long-term employment with the working days vacation;
  • Development in professional growth (courses, training, etc);
  • Being part of successful cutting-edge technology products that are making a global impact in the service industry;
  • Proficient and fun-to-work-with colleagues;
  • Apple gear.

Omilia is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that embracing diversity in all its forms enriches our workplace and drives our collective success. We are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels welcomed, valued, and empowered to contribute their unique perspectives without regard to factors such as race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, heredity, disability, age, or veteran status, all eligible candidates will be given consideration for employment.

title: Math & ELA Tutors
description:
Position Overview

Hill Tutoring is seeking driven and caring educators to join our team as reading/writing tutors. Tutors provide remedial support to K-12 students in the areas of math, reading, and writing. Tutors are trained in our methodology and use it, as applicable, along with best practices to provide tutoring support in individual or group sessions. Tutors work in a part-time capacity and can work year-round, mostly during after school hours. We are seeking tutors who can provide 8-10 hours per week of instruction.

Applicants should have a thorough understanding of learning differences and possess a strong foundation in the preferred tutoring area. Preference will be given to candidates with 1) a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in special education, 2) certification in special education, 3) certification in related field, and/or 4) experience working with students learning differences.

Hill Tutoring provides:

  • Extensive training in Hill Methodology
  • Mentor support
  • Ongoing Professional Development opportunities (earn CEUs)
  • Supportive administrative team and collaborative colleagues
  • Tutoring occurs M-F beginning at 3:45 and Sat/Sun beginning at 9am
  • Potential for high volume, 1:1 tutoring during school hours
  • Year-round tutoring on Hill’s campus
  • Supplies and materials provided (access to robust technology and tech support)
  • Student matching and billing all done by Tutoring Admins
  • Starting at $35/hour

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

About Hill Learning Center:

Founded in 1977, Hill Learning Center’s mission is to transform students with learning differences into confident, independent learners. Hill Learning Center supports students, educators, and families with research-based, culturally relevant programs designed to meet the needs of students with learning differences, attention challenges, gaps in foundational academic skills, and difficulties with executive function.


Hill serves students in grades K-12 through school, summer, and tutoring programs at Hill and in local schools. Students receive individualized, research-based instruction in reading, writing, math, and executive function skills. Programs focus on helping students develop the academic, organizational, self-advocacy, and social-emotional skills they need to succeed in school and in life.


Hill offers virtual and in-person educator professional development opportunities for K-12 teachers and schools, providing an understanding of learning disabilities and ADHD and the instructional strategies and tools teachers need to deliver research-based instruction and intervention in reading, writing, math, and executive function skills.


Hill helps families better understand, support, and advocate for their children with learning differences and attention challenges. Hill School families have access to counseling services, postsecondary planning, and other learning opportunities and support. Hill also offers online learning and Hill Connect—a free series for parents and caregivers—and partners with local schools and nonprofits to provide resources and programming for the families and communities they serve.


Core Values

We Learn We are lifelong learners. We approach all that we do with a growth mindset and a commitment to continuous learning and improvement. We learn from our students, our colleagues, other educators, and our partners. We seek out and embrace new ideas while remaining true to strategies we know work.

We Empower We empower students to take charge of their own learning and lives. We empower teachers to use their knowledge, skills and creativity to lead students to success. We empower staff to discover new and better ways of doing things.

We Reach We strive to reach an ever-increasing number of students, teachers, and schools to support their growth and success. We partner to extend our reach, expand our expertise, and learn from others. We challenge and support students, teachers, our partners, and our colleagues to reach their full potential.

We Relate We develop personal relationships with students, parents, teachers, colleagues, and partners. We empathize. We listen. We communicate. We collaborate. We connect. We relate.

We Care We care about students and their families. We care about teachers. We care about each other. We care about making a difference in students' lives, in schools and school districts, and in our community.


Diversity, Equity & Inclusion Statement

Hill believes every student needs success.

We honor and value each individual.

We celebrate differences and diversity.

We are stronger when we are inclusive.

We strive for equity in all we do.

title: Crisis Outreach Clinical Shift Supervisor - Swing Shift
description:
Days Off: Thursday, Friday, Saturday

Shift: Swing (3:00pm - 1:30am)

Shift Differential: $0.50 per hour

Insurance Benefits: Medical (no premiums/payroll deductions for employee coverage), Dental, Life, Long-term Disability

Other Benefits: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), ORCA card subsidy, Paid Time Off (34 days per year), Retirement Plan


About DESC:

Recognized nationally as an innovator and leader in developing solutions to homelessness, DESC is a social services organization, supportive housing operator, and licensed behavioral health treatment provider focused on meeting the needs of people experiencing long-term homelessness and living with complex behavioral health and other medical conditions. Approximately 3,000 people are actively receiving services from DESC at any given point in time. Our vision is a community where all people are shown compassion, treated with dignity, and everyone has a safe, stable, and affordable place to call home.


DESC operates five shelter/emergency housing programs,19 permanent supportive housing facilities with over 1,750 units, several hundred additional scattered site apartments, and a range of behavioral health services including outpatient mental health and substance use disorder treatment, residential crisis stabilization, street outreach, mobile crisis response, and treatment for opioid use disorder.


About Mobile Rapid Response Crisis Team (MRRCT):

The Mobile Rapid Response Crisis Team (MRRCT or “Meerkat”) at DESC, is a county funded program responsible for addressing the imminent and emergent needs of community members in crisis, in the central region of King County primarily covering the entirety of Seattle. The DESC team has been providing mobile crisis response services to the community for well over a decade.

As a nonprofit with over 45 years of experience focused on serving our community’s adults living with long histories of homelessness, behavioral health, and other disabling conditions, DESC is uniquely positioned to connect people in crisis to the important support and survival services they may need to overcome and prevent future occurrences of crisis, behavioral health distress, or other instabilities in our community.


JOB DEFINITION:

Each Crisis Outreach Shift Supervisor is responsible for ensuring their team’s timely, effective, and coordinated response into the field as they are dispatched and deployed by Crisis Connections. Shift Supervisors work alongside the staff they supervise providing real-time, on the ground supervision, coaching and guidance for how to resolve crisis situations their teams are responding to in the community. Crisis Outreach Shift Supervisors have the responsibility of implementing the systems created by the MRRCT program leadership related to proper documentation standards, implementation and adherence to DESC policies and procedures, supervision and performance management of their team, and ensuring their team members participate in all relevant training and on-going education necessary.


As part of the MRRCT each shift supervisor will at times be responsible for providing clinical and psychosocial assessments in the field and mental health evaluations to determine least restrictive alternatives to involuntary treatment.


MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Understand the expectations of MRRCT as described in King County’s Provider Manual.
  • Oversee maintenance and upkeep of employee files and records for compliance to program requirements.
  • Co-lead the day-to-day operations of their assigned shift.
  • Dispatch to outreaches as needed alongside team.
  • Co-host and participate in all required team meetings.
  • Provide 1:1 supervision with supervisees 2x/ month at minimum.
  • Coordinate day –to-day schedule, making changes and adjustment due to staff call outs and call volume.
  • Maintain staffing model through managing weekly and monthly scheduling in coordination with staff requests for PTO.
  • Monitor for good working conditions all vehicles in MRRCT fleet, in collaboration with their Project Manager. Ensure vehicle and driver safety policies and procedures are followed by all team members. Report and respond to issues promptly.
  • Maintain strong knowledge of all DESC policies and procedures. Assure compliance with same.
  • Provide routine administrative and clinical supervision of team including combination of Certified Peer Crisis Outreach Specialist, Crisis Outreach Specialist, and Mental Health Professional Crisis Outreach Specialists, including performance evaluations on a regular and scheduled basis and maintain supporting documentation in confidential supervision and personnel files.
  • Maintain strong knowledge of the collective bargaining agreement between management and union represented staff. Assure compliance with same.
  • Provide clinical consultation as needed for the evaluation of the psychiatric, substance use, and housing needs of clients, and advocating for clients to access the most effective disposition available in the community.
  • Teach and promote core DESC values, crisis intervention and de-escalation skills, and causes and effects of homelessness essential to ensure the safety of clients and staff.
  • Help staff build competent crisis outreach skills and standard of practice related to clinical documentation and service coordination.
  • Help staff build conflict resolution skills and understand how to give and receive feedback.
  • Actively participate in hiring functions to ensure full staffing across all shifts and position types.

title: BILLER & COLLECTOR SPECIALIST
description:
Job Summary:

The Billing and Collection Specialist, plays a crucial role in managing financial transactions, ensuring accuracy, and maintaining compliance. Responsibilities revolve around ensuring accurate and timely billing for assigned service line, analyzing patient accounts, identifying overpayments, processing refunds, and managing credit balances in accordance with established policies and regulations. This position is responsible for supporting and contributing to the team efforts in the achievement of pre-established accounts receivable performance goals of:

  • Net and Gross Days outstanding in Accounts Receivable
  • Percent of Accounts receivable aged greater than 90 days
  • Cash Collection Goals
  • Credit Balances as a Percent to outstanding receivables
  • Denials Resolution

The Patient Account Billing and Collection Specialist performs daily activities related to the successful closure of aged accounts receivable

  • Claim submission, corrections and RTPs
  • Perform Account Status and Follow up
  • Resolve Credit Balances
  • Respond to and resolve claim payment denials
  • Correspondence resolution
  • External audit requests related to credit balances

Key Responsibilities:

1. Utilize the Meditech BAR module to review and analyze patient accounts for accurate billing and collections.

2. Resolve account discrepancies, including rejected or denied claims, by investigating and correcting errors.

3. Review and interpret medical documentation, including medical records, superbills, and encounter forms, to ensure accurate coding and billing.

4. Work closely with healthcare providers and coding staff to clarify any documentation discrepancies or coding-related issues.

5. Generate and submit insurance claims electronically or through paper submission, adhering to all relevant billing regulations and guidelines.

6. Monitor claim statuses and follow up with insurance companies to resolve any outstanding claims or issues.

7. Collaborate with internal departments, such as Registration, Coding, and Finance, to ensure accurate and timely billing processes.

8. Stay updated on industry changes, including coding updates, insurance regulations, and reimbursement policies, and implement necessary changes in billing practices.

9. Maintain accurate records of account management and documentation of billing activities, claim submissions, and payment receipts including Meditech notes and canned text, etc. as directed.

10. Utilize appropriate internal/external applications in conjunction with Meditech to review patient accounts to identify overpayments, duplicate payments and other discrepancies leading to inaccurate account balance.

11. Accurately calculate refunds owed to patients, insurance companies, or other third-party payers.

12. Processes refund requests promptly and efficiently while adhering to the internal protocols and regulatory guidelines.

13. Accurately determines balances and adjustments on accounts that have questionable balances and adjusts accordingly.

14. Monitor and manage credit balances on patient accounts, ensuring timely resolution and appropriate adjustments in accordance with internal protocols and requirements.

15. Collaborate with Cashiers, finance, and payers and applicable third-party vendors to resolve complex refund and credit balance issues.

16. Communicate effectively with patients, insurance representatives, and other stakeholders regarding refund status and inquiries.

17. Maintain detailed records of refund transactions, credit balance adjustments, and related correspondence.

18. Generate reports to track refund activity, credit balance trends, and outstanding issues for management review.

19. Uses proper fee schedules, codes and "caps" as necessary for specific third-party payers.

20. Interprets mail requests from payers, determines necessary action and responds in a timely manner.

21. Interacts with insurance companies to resolve problems, questions, and issues with accounts providing any information required by faxing or mailing records as necessary, not limited to appeals, reconsiderations, telephone follow through, as appropriate per payor.

Je bent een echte aanpakker die graag de handen uit de mouwen steekt. title: Direct Current Datacenter System Architect
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Program Manager Solid State Transformer

__

Your role and responsibilities
We are looking for a Power Systems Architect to join our Direct Current Data Center Incubator, playing a critical role in driving the transformational shift toward next-generation Direct current data center architectures. Working closely with strategic customers—especially hyperscalers—you will help shape the future of data center architectures by translating complex customer challenges into innovative, optimized electrical solutions.

In this highly visible role, you will act as a trusted technical advisor across the full project lifecycle, combining deep technical expertise with strong consultative skills. You will influence market opportunities, support customer adoption, reduce churn, and enable flawless execution of pioneering Direct Current data center projects.

Work model: hybrid (#LI hybrid)

Key Responsibilities

  • In collaboration with ABB data center segment and account managers partners closely with key customers—particularly hyperscalers—to support their transition from conventional AC data centers to advanced Direct Current data center architectures.
  • Design and engineer end-to-end electrical power system solutions for data centers, delivering competitive, scalable, and future-ready system architectures.
  • Design protection and control— Designing Direct Current ‑specific protection schemes and overall control schemes for the future architecture including sequence of operation, managing the load and active monitoring.
  • In collaboration with ABB R&D teams, develop power system studies providing early insights into novel architectures and support customer projects.
  • Collaborate with internal engineering and product teams to specify products and identify technology gaps.
  • Support pilot projects, ensuring completeness of technical solution and documentation necessary for successful delivery of novel Direct Current data center solutions.
  • Design and define test plans and test setups for the LVDC system, components and power converters to validate the proposed solutions.
  • Contribute to technical thought leadership in emerging Direct Current power architectures and industry trends.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in power system design, consulting, or solution architecture.
  • Strong background in data center power systems, or exposure to Direct Current power solutions (experience in adjacent industries such as marine or industrial Direct Current systems is highly valued).
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering complex, high-impact technical solutions.
  • Knowledge of electrical power systems, including switchgear, transformers, protection, control systems.
  • Ability to operate effectively in evolving technical environments.
  • Willingness to travel internationally, particularly to the United States.
  • Strong Cross-cultural awareness.
  • Fluent English (mandatory).

More about us

ABB's Distribution Solutions Division facilitates the efficient and reliable distribution, protection and control of power by improving electric power quality while strengthening the resilience of the grid. The Division offers segment-specific products and solutions that largely serve utilities, industry and infrastructure segments, often providing the requisite medium-voltage link between high-voltage transmission systems and low-voltage users. With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions at its core, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 66 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, reclosers, fuses, contactors, relays, instrument transformers, sensors, motor control centers, as well as low-voltage switchgear for the ANSI standard markets.

This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Senior Data Center Operations Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Data Center Operations Engineer to join our growing team in Milan and help shape the future of our flagship project, Colosseum, one of Europe’s most powerful AI supercomputers, currently in development.

Designed to run our proprietary AI models at scale, it forms the compute backbone behind the intelligence we deliver to the world’s most demanding industries.

To achieve the highest level of performance, datacenter infrastructure has become a tightly integrated part of supercomputers where power, cooling and the building management systems provide critical consumable resources that should be optimized like any other resource in the system to extract maximum performance in a reliable way. We also strive towards optimal responsible embedding in the local environment. Tuning the heat recovery systems to optimize for the community district heating systems and tuning the power systems to support and stabilize the local grid are critically important to deliver on our societal responsibilities.

In this role, you will maintain the infrastructure and ensure its reliability and performance. You will respond to incidents and support troubleshooting and resolution activities when issues arise.

You will also contribute to the architecture and design of next-generation systems, helping shape future infrastructure evolution. A key part of the role involves automating processes, integrating systems, and implementing ongoing improvements and optimizations.

As a part of the team, you will stay up to date with the latest technologies and industry trends, actively bringing new ideas. You will collaborate closely with other team members to evaluate and implement these improvements effectively.

What You Have

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Computer Engineering, or a related field.

  • At least 6 years of experience as a Data Center Operations Engineer or in similar roles.

  • Certification to work with MV/LV electrical systems (Medium Voltage / Low Voltage)

  • Certifications (PES / PAV / PEI or equivalent, DCIS or equivalent)

  • Strong understanding of data center operations and critical infrastructure environments

  • Solid knowledge of industry standards, including ISO 50001 (Energy Management Systems)

  • Hands-on experience with data center monitoring, control, and integration systems, including BMC for the IT hardware and related tools

  • Experience with infrastructure monitoring and management protocols such as Redfish, SNMP, and MQTT

  • Working knowledge of Python for automation and integration tasks

  • Experience with modern system integration frameworks and APIs (e.g. MCP or similar technologies)

Who You Are

  • A versatile engineer, comfortable operating in complex and fast-paced environments.

  • Driven and fearless, you proactively tackle challenges and overcome obstacles with determination.

  • A systems thinker, capable of understanding the broader architecture and identifying dependencies across platforms and technologies.

  • A collaborative team player who is enthusiastic, curious, and passionate about problem-solving, thriving both independently and within cross-functional teams.

  • An effective communicator with strong interpersonal skills, able to engage with diverse stakeholders and foster collaboration.

  • Fluent in English and eager to contribute in a multicultural and international environment.

Benefits

Perks

  • Learning Friday. If our team members know more, so do we. That’s why we give everyone a training budget that they can spend on books, online courses or other training materials.

  • Smart Working. Trains can be a drag, you can save some commuting time by working from home.

  • Salary is based on experience and topped up with other bonuses.

We offer a competitive salary, as well as an opportunity to receive company equity. The typical salary for this role ranges between € 50.000 and € 70.000. As you gain experience and make more significant contributions to the business, your compensation will be reviewed to match your impact. Additionally, depending on your seniority and your performance, you’ll have the opportunity to receive stock options, with a variable value calculated from your base salary, giving you the chance to directly participate in the company’s success.

About Domyn

Domyn is a company specializing in the research and development of Responsible AI for regulated industries, including financial services, government, and heavy industry. It supports enterprises with proprietary, fully governable solutions based on a composable AI architecture — including LLMs, AI agents, and one of the world’s largest supercomputers. At the core of Domyn’s product offer is a chip-to-frontend architecture that allows organizations to control the entire AI stack — from hardware to application — ensuring isolation, security, and governance throughout the AI lifecycle. Its foundational LLMs, Domyn Large and Domyn Small, are designed for advanced reasoning and optimized to understand each business’s specific language, logic, and context. Provided under an open-enterprise license, these models can be fully transferred and owned by clients. Once deployed, they enable customizable agents that operate on proprietary data to solve complex, domain-specific problems. All solutions are managed via a unified platform with native tools for access management, traceability, and security. Powering it all, Colosseum — a supercomputer in development using NVIDIA Grace Blackwell Superchips — will train next-gen models exceeding 1T parameters. Domyn partners with Microsoft, NVIDIA, and G42. Clients include Allianz, Intesa Sanpaolo, and Fincantieri.

title: Head of Liabilities
description:
About CodeNinja
CodeNinja is a technology and AI consulting firm delivering embedded and forward-deployed engineering and leadership talent across KSA, Pakistan, Egypt, and Latin America. We partner with leading financial institutions to help them build high-performing teams and scale critical business functions.

About the Role
We are hiring a Head of Liabilities to lead the retail liabilities business for our banking client — owning CASA, savings, term deposits, and investment/bancassurance propositions end-to-end. This is a senior leadership role responsible for driving deposit growth, optimizing CASA mix, managing cost of funds, and shaping product and pricing strategy across the liabilities portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the P&L for the retail liabilities business, including CASA, savings, term deposits, and investment/bancassurance products
  • Drive deposit growth strategy and CASA optimisation to improve balance sheet mix and reduce cost of funds
  • Lead pricing strategy across liability products in line with ALM and treasury guidelines
  • Develop and launch new liabilities and investment/bancassurance propositions aligned to market and customer needs
  • Partner with Treasury/ALM on funding strategy, liquidity management, and cost of funds optimisation
  • Oversee Sharia-compliant deposit structures where applicable, ensuring product compliance with regulatory and Sharia board requirements
  • Build and lead a high-performing liabilities product and sales team
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Digital, and Branch/Distribution teams to drive product penetration and customer acquisition
  • Monitor competitive landscape and market trends to inform product and pricing decisions
  • Report on portfolio performance, growth metrics, and P&L to senior leadership

Requirements

Must-Haves

  • 12+ years of banking experience, with 7+ years in a senior leadership role in consumer liabilities, deposits, or investments
  • Strong track record in CASA growth and optimisation
  • Solid understanding of ALM principles and cost of funds management
  • Experience with Sharia-compliant deposit structures
  • Demonstrated ownership of a liabilities P&L
  • Strong product strategy and pricing capability

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with bancassurance or investment product distribution
  • Exposure to digital deposit/investment platforms
  • Regional GCC banking experience

Why Join Us
Join a high-impact leadership role shaping the liabilities strategy for a major banking client, with direct P&L ownership and the opportunity to drive meaningful growth in a competitive market.

Disclaimer
This job description is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of the role and is not exhaustive. Responsibilities and requirements may evolve based on business needs.

title: Java Developer
description:
Bir Turkcell grup şirketi olarak 1999 yılında kurulduğumuzda amacımız hep eşsiz bir müşteri deneyimi yaşatmaktı.Yıllar geçse de amacımız hiç değişmedi ve bugün biz yine aynı odak noktası ve artan heyecanımızla; toplam 15 lokasyonda, 16 binden fazla çalışanımızla firmaların müşteri deneyimini iyileştirmeye devam ediyoruz.

Telekom sektöründeki köklü tecrübemizin yanı sıra; finans, sigorta, e-ticaret, perakende, ulaştırma, hızlı tüketim, havacılık, otomotiv, teknoloji, enerji ve kamu sektörlerinde hizmet vermekteyiz.

Eşsiz müşteri deneyimine ulaşabilmek için geleneksel bir kanal olan ve Ana Hizmetlerimizin altında yeralan çağrı hizmetlerimize; Dijital, Teknolojik ve Danışmanlık Hizmetlerimizi de ekleyerek güçlendirdik.

Daha hızlı, tasarruf sağlayan, kolay ulaşılabilen bir müşteri deneyimi sunmak için RPA (Robotik Süreç Otomasyonu), Dijital Yardım Masası, Social Sniffer, Konuşma Analizi, Bulut Santral, Chat & Chat Bot gibi dijital hizmetlerimizi kullanıyoruz.

Müşteri deneyimi uçtan uca bir süreç olduğu için; Deneyim Tasarımı, Kalite & Araştırma Yönetimi gibi danışmanlık hizmetlerimiz ile bu deneyimin tasarım aşamasını da analitik bir bakış açısıyla sunuyoruz.Ana hizmetlerimiz içerisinde yer alan çağrı hizmetlerimizi ise sadece ses kanalı ile vermekle kalmayıp, görüntülü görüşme ve otomatik sesli yanıt sistemleri (IVR) ile destekleyerek müşterilerimize eşsiz bir deneyim yaşatıyoruz.

‘’Turkcell İletişim Hizmetleri A.Ş. ve Grup Şirketleri, kişisel verilerinizin hukuka uygun olarak toplanması, saklanması, paylaşılmasını sağlamak ve gizliliğini korumak amacıyla mümkün olan en üst seviyede güvenlik tedbirleri almaktadır. İletmiş olduğunuz özgeçmişiniz doğrultusunda, kişisel verileriniz veri sorumlusu olarak Turkcell ve Grup Şirketleri tarafından toplanarak işlenebilecektir. Kişisel verilerinize ilişkin detaylı bilgi almak, Kanun’un 11. maddesinde düzenlenen haklarınızı kullanmak ve başvuru yöntemlerini öğrenmek için Turkcell Çalışan Adayı Aydınlatma Metni'ni ‘’https://globalbilgi.com.tr/wpcontent/uploads/2023/12/TURKCELL_Calisan_Adayi_Aydinlatma_Metni.pdf’’ internet adresimizden inceleyebilirsiniz.”

İş Tanımı

Turkcell Global Bilgi kadrosunda yer alarak, havacılık sektöründeki müşterimizin teknoloji ekipleri içerisinde konumlanacak bir Java Developer arıyoruz. Rol, müşterimizin proje ekipleriyle yakın iş birliği içinde çalışmayı gerektirmektedir.

  • Java (tercihen Java 11+) ve Spring Boot ile ölçeklenebilir, yüksek performanslı ve dayanıklı servisler/RESTful API'ler geliştirmek.
  • OOP, SOLID, temiz kod (Clean Code) ilkeleri ve tasarım kalıplarına (Design Patterns) uygun, sürdürülebilir yazılım mimarileri kurgulamak.
  • Oracle, PostgreSQL ve NoSQL (Couchbase, MongoDB) veritabanlarında veri modellemesi yapmak; Hibernate/JPA ve SQL performans optimizasyonlarını (N+1 vb. sorunları gidererek) sağlamak.
  • Angular, React ve TypeScript araçlarını kullanarak modern, bileşen tabanlı (component-based) frontend geliştirmelerine katkı sunmak.
  • Mikroservis, event-driven (Kafka, RabbitMQ vb.) ve dağıtık sistem mimari tasarımlarına, teknik dokümantasyona ve sistem iyileştirmelerine aktif katkı sağlamak.
  • Unit testler (JUnit 5, Mockito) yazarak kod kalitesini korumak, Code Review süreçlerine katılmak ve yeni özellikleri devreye almak.
  • ELK Stack gibi loglama/izleme araçlarıyla test ve canlı ortam (production) hatalarını analiz etmek, çözüm üretmek.
  • Üniversitelerin Bilgisayar Mühendisliği veya ilgili bölümlerinden mezun,
  • Yazılım geliştirmede en az 3 yıl deneyimli,
  • Java (8 / 11 / 21) ekosistemine, Collections, Stream API, Concurrency ve JVM (Garbage Collection, Memory Model) çalışma mantığına hâkim olmak.
  • İlişkisel (Oracle, PostgreSQL) ve NoSQL (Couchbase, MongoDB) veritabanlarında tecrübeli; güçlü SQL yazma, ORM (Hibernate) ve performans bilincine sahip olmak.
  • RESTful API tasarımı, Mikroservis mimarisi (Service Discovery, API Gateway), senkron/asenkron ve dağıtık sistemler hakkında tecrübe veya bilgi sahibi olmak.
  • Mesajlaşma sistemlerinde (Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ veya benzeri kuyruk tabanlı yapılar) tecrübe veya aşinalık sahibi olmak.
  • Angular, React, TypeScript ve modern bileşen tabanlı arayüz geliştirme pratiklerine hâkim olmak.
  • Git (branching, PR), CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI), Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift, Maven/Gradle ve uygulama sunucuları (WebLogic vb.) tecrübesine sahip olmak.
  • Loglama araçları (ELK Stack, Elasticsearch vb.) ile canlı ortam (production) sorunlarını analiz edebilme ve çözebilme becerisine sahip olmak.
  • Unit test (JUnit 5, Mockito) ve Clean Code alışkanlığı olan, analitik düşünebilen ve teknik kararlarını gerekçelendirebilmek.

Seni Neler Bekliyor?

  • Farklı çalışma modeli alternatifleri sunan “Ahenk” ile çalışma fırsatı! (Uzaktan, Hibrit, Ofisten)
  • #buradakariyervar uygulamamız ile otonom kariyer fırsatı!
  • Mesleki ve kişisel eğitim & gelişim fırsatları! (Liderlik Gelişim Programları, Focus Data-RPA-Agile-AI İnovasyon Sertifika Programları)
  • Anlaşmalı üniversite ve dil okulları ile eğitim desteği!
  • Bireysel & takım koçluğu ve mentorluk programları!
  • Takdir ve ödüllendirme uygulamaları!
  • Annelere özel okulun ilk günü/karne günü izni!
  • Online psikolog, sağlık, diyetisyen, veteriner ve bitki danışmanlığı desteği!
  • Sosyal kulüpler ile keyifli, zinde ve mutlu bir çalışma ortamı!
  • Çalışanlara özel indirim ve kampanyalar!

title: Teamondersteuner Leiden
description:
Welke uitdaging ga je aan?

Jij bent de verbindende teamondersteuner / administratief medewerker die de afdeling bij elkaar brengt. In deze nieuwe functie lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan de dienstverlening van onze zorgverleners.

Als teamondersteuner / administratief medewerker voer je alle operationele werkzaamheden uit. Je werkt op een locatie van een of meerdere zorgverleners. Als teamondersteuner ben jij de centrale persoon die diverse werkzaamheden uitvoert. Je bent proactief en biedt ondersteuning als het aanspreekpunt voor de diverse zorgverleners.

Dit doe je door;

  • Agendabeheer voor zorgverleners; cliënt en niet cliënt gebonden afspraken;

  • Secretariële ondersteuning, zoals het opstellen van correspondentie;

  • Ondersteunen van zorgverleners bij algemene vragen over bijvoorbeeld zorgregistratie en het EPD (elektronisch patiëntendossier);

  • Informeren van (nieuwe) zorgverleners over de registratie;

  • De schakel zijn tussen verschillende afdelingen binnen Rivierduinen.

Wie ben jij?

Als teamondersteuner / administratief medewerker ben jij de centrale persoon die diverse werkzaamheden voor zorgverleners uitvoert. Je bent dienstverlenend, je hebt geduld en doorzettingsvermogen en je kan zelfstandig werken. Verder ben je integer en kan je op een professionele wijze met betrouwbare informatie omgaan. Je bent iemand die een schakel kan zijn tussen de verschillende afdelingen en personen en goed zijn of haar grenzen kan aangeven.

Verder beschik je over:

  • Aantoonbaar MBO werk- en denkniveau; ervaring binnen GGZ is een pré;

  • Ervaring met zorgadministratie;

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk;

  • Digitale vaardigheden en actuele kennis van Microsoft office.

Waar ga je werken?

Als teamondersteuner ontvang je hiërarchisch leiding van de manager zorgadministratie. Je functioneel en operationeel leidinggevende zal een manager van één van de zorgfuncties zijn in Leiden. De werkdagen zijn van maandag t/m donderdag.

Wat krijg je van GGZ Rivierduinen?

  • Een jaarcontract voor 32 uur met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband;

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de €2735,- en €3.560,- op basis van een 36-urige werkweek (FWG 35 conform CAO GGZ) ;

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering 8,33% van het bruto jaarsalaris;

  • 8.33% vakantietoeslag, 166 vakantie-uren en 35 LFB-uren per jaar (bij een fulltime dienstverband);

  • Reis- en onkostenvergoeding;

  • Een pensioenregeling bij pensioenfonds Zorg en Welzijn;

  • Meerkeuze systeem arbeidsvoorwaarden (bijvoorbeeld voor de aankoop van een elektrische fiets of het kopen van extra verlofdagen);

  • Keuze uit twee aantrekkelijke collectieve ziektekostenverzekeringen;

  • Jaarlijks een balansbudget van maximaal €1000,- , om te zetten naar extra verlofuren of uit te betalen als bruto loon; Indien ingezet voor opleiding, bedraagt het €1.400 op voltijdsbasis.

  • Opleiding en ontwikkeling via onze Rivierduinen Academie waarbij je de mogelijkheid hebt tot het volgen van zorginhoudelijke scholingsprogramma's voor professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Meer weten?

Heb je vragen of wil je meer informatie? Neem gerust contact op met Kimberley van Beugen recruiter via 06 13318415 of stuur een mail naar k.vanbeugen@rivierduinen.nl

Goed om te weten; onze sollicitatieprocedure omvat een referentiecheck en bij indiensttreding vragen we om een verklaring omtrent het gedrag (VOG).

GGZ Rivierduinen

GGZ Rivierduinen biedt geestelijke gezondheidszorg (ggz) aan mensen van alle leeftijden met ernstige, psychische klachten en hun naasten. Onze 2.100 collega’s bieden zorg aan zo’n 15.000 cliënten in de gemeenten in de regio’s Alphen aan den Rijn, Duin- en Bollenstreek, Gouda, Leiden, Leidschendam en Zoetermeer. Rivierduinen heeft onder andere poliklinieken, wijkteams, acute zorg, klinieken, verblijfsafdelingen, dagbesteding en een specialistische afdeling voor eetstoornissen.

Onze bevlogen medewerkers zijn het kloppende hart van onze organisatie. Daarom geven we je graag de ruimte. Zo zorgen we dat je werk vandaag en morgen bij je past. Wil je doorgroeien? Dan kun je met onze opleidingen en onderzoeksfaciliteiten zelf de regie nemen in je ontwikkeling. Met je vakkennis ben jij steeds de onmisbare schakel in de samenwerking met onze cliënten, hun naasten, je collega’s en onze ketenpartners. Zo maak jij het verschil!

title: Capaciteit Medewerker
description:
Dit is Guidion

Wij beschikken over een platform waarop ons landelijk dekkende netwerk van technisch zelfstandige specialisten en verpleegkundigen is aangesloten. Zij voeren namens grote merken als Vodafone Ziggo, Odido en Comfort Partners werkzaamheden uit bij mensen thuis. Hoe we dat doen? Op onze eigen, unieke manier: door de volledige klantreis voor consumenten zo leuk en makkelijk mogelijk te maken. Het resultaat? Wij maken ieder jaar ongeveer 1 miljoen mensen blij met onze service. En daar zijn we trots op!

Dit is de functie

Als Capaciteit Medewerker ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de operationele uitvoering van capaciteitsmanagement binnen Telecom UX. Je zorgt ervoor dat er in alle regio’s voldoende capaciteit beschikbaar is (onze ondernemers) en dat hun inzet optimaal aansluit op de hoeveelheid werk. Door indicatoren zoals ‘doorlooptijden’ en ‘workload’ scherp te monitoren, stuur jij proactief bij, om onze targets te behalen. Je schakelt dagelijks met collega’s van het planningsteam en ondernemers in het veld om ervoor te zorgen dat alles soepel verloopt.

Verder zijn jouw verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Monitoren en bijsturen van capaciteit voor alle regio’s en werkstromen.

    • Coördineren van tijdelijke inzet van ondernemers in andere regio’s (relocations) en afspraken maken met hen hierover.

    • Beheren van fictieve beschikbaarheid.

  • Signaleren van knelpunten en aandragen van structurele verbeteringen (bijv. regio-indelingen, werving).

  • Controleren van routeoptimalisatie en het analyseren van knelpunten.

  • Verwerken van capaciteit gerelateerde ondernemer-verzoeken.

  • Beheren van service resource instellingen in Salesforce.

  • Samenwerken met het planningsteam om acties helder af te stemmen.

Dit ben jij

Je bent iemand die energie krijgt van puzzels oplossen en overzicht houdt. Je hebt een scherp oog voor detail en vindt het belangrijk dat planningen en capaciteit kloppen. Met jouw analytische blik herken je snel patronen en knelpunten en je bent niet bang om beslissingen te nemen. Daarnaast ben je communicatief sterk en weet je goed samen te werken, maar ook zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Verder ben je 32 tot 40 uur per week beschikbaar.

Jij herkent jezelf in deze eigenschappen:

  • Nauwkeurig en analytisch sterk

  • Proactief en oplossingsgericht

  • Flexibel en besluitvaardig

  • Communicatief vaardig

  • Zelfstandig en kritisch

Dit krijg je van ons

  • Een passend salaris van € 2.600,- tot € 2.900,- op basis van werkervaring;

  • Onbeperkte vrije dagen (!);

  • Ondersteuning van een leidinggevende die jou verder kan helpen in jouw ontwikkeling;

  • Een omgeving waarin we met Management Drives werken. Een cultuur waarin we het beste uit onszelf willen en kunnen halen;
