title: Cloud Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Cloud Engineer based in Ireland.

Join a technical team focused on supporting and scaling modern cloud-based data environments.
In this role, you will help application teams onboard to Databricks and build reliable Data Landing Zones (DLZ).
You will work with Azure resources, Infrastructure as Code, automation, and deployment pipelines to deliver efficient solutions.
As a first-line technical point of contact, you will troubleshoot requests and help resolve issues through structured support processes.
You will also identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities and continuously improve operational workflows.
The role combines hands-on cloud engineering with application support in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.
It is an excellent opportunity to deepen your expertise in Databricks, Azure, IaC, and cloud automation while making a direct impact on data platform operations.

Accountabilities

  • Provide first-level technical support to application teams through the ServiceNow ticketing system, investigating and resolving common Databricks and cloud-related requests.
  • Gather, clarify, and analyze technical requirements for onboarding new Data Landing Zones (DLZs).
  • Execute pipelines, scripts, and automated processes to provision, configure, or modify Azure and Databricks resources.
  • Support the deployment of commonly requested Azure resources using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.
  • Identify repetitive manual activities and develop automation to improve efficiency, consistency, and support response times.
  • Collaborate with application, cloud, data, and other cross-functional teams to resolve technical issues and ensure smooth onboarding.
  • Create, maintain, and continuously improve documentation covering support procedures, workflows, configurations, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of cloud support operations and the overall Databricks environment.

    • Requirements:

    • 1–3 years of hands-on experience working with Databricks in a technical or operational environment.
    • 1–3 years of experience with Azure Data Factory.
    • Previous experience in application support, technical operations, cloud support, or a similar role.
    • Familiarity with major cloud platforms, particularly Azure, with exposure to AWS or GCP considered an advantage.
    • Experience using source-control systems such as Git, GitHub, or GitLab.
    • Understanding of Databricks capabilities such as Unity Catalog, role-based access control (RBAC), authentication mechanisms, and Delta Sharing is highly desirable.
    • Experience working within the Azure ecosystem and understanding of cloud resource management.
    • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, or AWS CDK.
    • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation platforms such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions is a plus.
    • Scripting or development experience with Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar technologies.
    • Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities, combined with attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
    • Ability to communicate clearly with application teams and collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

      • Benefits:

      • Opportunity to work hands-on with Databricks, Azure, cloud infrastructure, and modern data technologies.
      • Exposure to Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, automation, and cloud platform operations.
      • Collaborative environment with opportunities to work closely with application and cross-functional technical teams.
      • Opportunity to develop expertise in a growing data and cloud technology ecosystem.
      • Role combining technical support, cloud engineering, automation, and continuous improvement.
      • Potential for professional growth through exposure to a broad range of cloud and data platform challenges.

description:

  • Maintain positive relationships with co-workers, managers, directors, clients, and stakeholders.

  • Understand and support the Open-Door Philosophy of Humane Animal Rescue.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

  • Time management and organizational skills.
  • Ability to multi-task and prioritize work.
  • Ability to communicate effectively.

Work Environment:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be exposed to hazards associated with aggressive animals.??The employee will primarily be working in an animal shelter environment.??The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate


Physical Demands:

Incumbent must be able to read, see, hear, and speak. During work, employee may be required to bend, stoop, squat, climb, and walk. This position will require the ability to stand for up to seven (7) hours per shift. The role routinely requires handling of animals in varying degrees of behavior and requires keen observational skills, as well as dexterity with a leash and other training equipment used with both cats and dogs. title: Team Member

Employee Incentives:

Additional Info:

  • Minimum of 21 years old to work 3rd shift

title: Principal Broker
description:
Company:

Marsh Risk

Description:

Marsh Risk is seeking candidates for the position of Principal Broker to join our Corporate and Commercial team at Marsh. This role will be based in Cairns or Townsville. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.

Principal Broker - Corporate & Commercial

This role will suit an experienced insurance broker with 5+ years’ experience managing a commercial or corporate portfolio of business. This role will provide exposure to a diverse portfolio of risks, leading and participating in large new business tenders and proposals, building a network of opportunities and designing and placing complex insurance programs.

We will count on you to:

  • Grow a corporate/commercial portfolio of key revenue-generating accounts while ensuring high-quality customer service.

  • Develop, pursue and convert new business opportunities.

  • Grow a commercial portfolio through new logo and organic expanded opportunities.

  • On-board new clients and deliver on our value proposition.

  • Develop and maintain meaningful working relationships with insurers at a senior level.

What you need to have:

  • 5+ years of commercial broking experience.

  • Proven ability to produce new business.

  • Extensive knowledge of risks and insurance products for key industry sectors.

  • Strong market presence within General Insurance.

What makes you stand out:

  • Strong new business network to generate opportunities.

  • Energy, enthusiasm, and proactive attitude.

  • High degree of commitment to client service.

  • Ability to develop and maintain strong relationships with clients.

Why Join Our Team?

  • We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.

  • We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.

  • Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

Transitioning from a capital city to Cairns is often motivated by the desire to escape the hustle and bustle of city life and achieve a better work/life balance.

Cairns offers an excellent living environment for those looking to make a difference in their community or career. It serves as the gateway to two World Heritage sites: the Great Barrier Reef and the Wet Tropics Rainforest.

Regardless of where you reside in Cairns, you can easily access a creek, rainforest trail, or beach with just a short walk or drive.

You'll also benefit from reduced commuting time and costs. Housing is more affordable, and for families, education expenses, especially for private schools, are lower. A tropical lifestyle change could be just what you need

About Marsh:

Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Applications will only be considered from candidates who have the appropriate approval to work in Australia. Successful applicants will be required to complete a Criminal & Bankruptcy check prior to commencing of employment.

Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

title: Reliability Lab Engineer
description:
Littelfuse (NASDAQ: LFUS) is a diversified industrial technology manufacturing company shaping solutions for the safe and efficient transfer of electrical energy. Headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, USA, we serve customers across industrial, transportation, and electronics markets worldwide. With approximately 16,000 employees we design and manufacture innovative technologies that support electrification, energy efficiency, and advanced automation. Our global reach is matched by a culture that empowers innovation and long-term growth. Guided by our principles We Care, We Succeed With Our Customers, and We Own the Outcome, we work collaboratively, think boldly, and deliver solutions that move industries forward.

Our Reliability Lab Engineer is embedded in the local laboratory environment, executing qualification and reliability test requests while developing technical expertise in reliability testing methods, equipment, standards, and failure mechanisms. The role combines extensive hands-on testing activities with increasing technical responsibility for troubleshooting, data review, standards understanding, and execution of complex test requests. The role operates within the Reliability Testing Chapter and collaborates closely with the local laboratory organization and relevant cross-functional stakeholders.

About the Position:

  • Execute complete qualification and reliability test requests independently

  • Prepare, set up, start, monitor, and complete complex reliability tests

  • Perform advanced measurements and data collection activities

  • Plan resources, schedules, equipment allocation, and execution activities for assigned test requests

  • Review test requirements and ensure proper execution

  • Create, modify, and maintain measurement programs

  • Review and approve measurement programs created by technicians

  • Support troubleshooting of test setups, equipment, and execution-related issues

  • Develop understanding of reliability standards, qualification requirements, and stress methods

  • Develop understanding of reliability-related failure mechanisms

  • Participate in investigations related to test deviations and abnormal behavior

  • Support technical discussions with requestors and laboratory stakeholders

  • Contribute to continuous improvement of laboratory execution practices

​About You:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, or comparable

  • 1–3+ years of experience in reliability testing, semiconductor testing, quality, manufacturing engineering, or laboratory operations preferred

  • Understanding of reliability testing principles and qualification methodologies

  • Understanding of laboratory measurement systems and execution practices

  • Willingness to develop expertise in reliability standards and failure mechanisms

  • Strong analytical and organizational skills

  • Good English skills

#LI-DR

At Littelfuse, we support employee growth and development. Guided by our culture principles, our teams work together to deliver value for customers and make a positive impact in the communities where we operate. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to grow and contribute. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, performance-based incentives, flexible work arrangements, and development opportunities.

description:
SEIU Healthcare 1199NW, a progressive healthcare union is part of the fastest growing union in the country. We are a union of over 37,000 healthcare workers strong and growing in Washington State and Montana. We work toward economic and racial justice in our communities and building strong worker led unions that advocate for good jobs, safer staffing and a voice on the job for frontline staff in hospitals, clinics, behavior health and social service agencies.

title: Flood Mitigation Instructor - P/T
description:
The Carpenters Training Center (CTC) is seeking a skilled and knowledgeable Flood Mitigation Instructor to join our team on a part-time basis. The instructor will deliver hands-on training to members, equipping them with the technical expertise and practical skills needed to execute flood mitigation tasks in real-world environments. The ideal candidate will have substantial experience in flood mitigation, including site preparation, installation techniques, and maintenance, all while ensuring compliance with approved safety standards. The role will focus on guiding members through the correct use of flood mitigation systems, ensuring they are prepared to respond effectively during flood situations.


Job Responsibilities:

· Develop and deliver flood mitigation training programs that align with industry standards and safety protocols.

· Provide hands-on instruction in flood mitigation methods, including setup, application, and the deployment of flood mitigation structures.

· Train members on proper site preparation, grouting, leveling, anchor bolting, and the installation of expansion shield anchors while fostering a safety-first culture by adhering to safety guidelines and promoting best practices in every aspect of training.

· Ensure members understand how to maintain and deploy gaskets and other essential flood mitigation components, ensuring operational readiness in non-emergency situations.

· Teach members how to install and maintain various types of flood mitigation doors (e.g., swing doors), along with frame installation and preparation of concrete surfaces.

· Evaluate member performance through practical assessments, providing constructive feedback to enhance skill development.

· Stay current with trends, new technologies, and best practices in flood mitigation to ensure the program remains relevant and effective.

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Senior Java Software Engineer

Location: Minneapolis, MN

Department: Information Technology


Position Responsibilities:


This role is responsible for designing and developing Java based application software that powers advanced medical devices used in MRI guided cardiac procedures. Working at the application and system level, you will build software supporting real time navigation, device communication, clinical workflows, and user interaction while ensuring compliance with FDA regulations and medical device software standards.

  • Design, develop, and maintain Java based application software supporting capital medical equipment products.
  • Develop application and system level software that enables real time navigation, device control, and clinical workflows.
  • Collaborate cross functionally with engineering, clinical, regulatory, quality, and manufacturing teams to define and refine product requirements.
  • Build reliable, scalable, and safety compliant software aligned with IEC 62304 and FDA Class II and III medical device standards.
  • Develop and execute automated, unit, and integration testing while supporting formal Verification and Validation activities.
  • Support product lifecycle activities including design transfer, manufacturing integration, software releases, and post market updates.
  • Analyze user feedback, field data, and defect trends to improve product performance and reliability.
  • Create and maintain software requirements, architecture documentation, design specifications, traceability, and risk assessments.
  • Ensure adherence to Quality Management System and Design Control processes throughout software development.
  • Partner with operations and marketing teams to support manufacturability and customer focused product enhancements.
  • Mentor software engineers on development best practices, testing methodologies, and software quality.

Position requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field.
  • Five or more years of software development experience within the medical device industry.
  • Strong Java software development experience building commercial or medical device applications.
  • Experience developing application or system level software rather than exclusively embedded firmware.
  • Experience working within FDA regulated environments including Design Controls, IEC 62304, software traceability, and software lifecycle documentation.
  • Experience supporting FDA 510(k), PMA, or EU MDR regulatory submissions.
  • Experience developing automated tests, unit tests, integration tests, and supporting Verification and Validation.
  • Experience collaborating across engineering, quality, regulatory, manufacturing, and clinical teams.
  • Strong analytical, problem solving, communication, and cross functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Experience with C or C++ for device communication or supporting embedded software.
  • Experience with embedded systems, RTOS, or microcontrollers.
  • Experience using Azure DevOps, static code analysis tools, and modern software development practices.
  • Advanced degree in a related technical field.
  • Experience with cybersecurity standards and post market surveillance practices.
  • Previous experience in a startup or high growth environment.
  • Experience mentoring or providing technical leadership to software engineering teams.

Reasons to Apply:

  • Competitive salary plus a comprehensive benefits package.
  • Health coverage, retirement plans, and other company-sponsored perks.
  • Generous paid time off, including holidays, to support work-life balance.
  • Flexible schedules and work life balance.
  • Strong focus on employee development with on-the-job training and career growth.
  • A positive company culture that values diversity and collaboration.


About the Company

Our client is a pioneering medical technology organization focused on advancing minimally invasive cardiac procedures through innovative MRI compatible solutions that eliminate radiation exposure and improve patient outcomes.

Evernorth Health Services India, established in Hyderabad in 2024, is an innovation hub for Evernorth Health Services, the pharmacy, care and benefits division of The Cigna Group. The innovation hub will support innovation-focused areas, such as generative AI, product development, process improvement, analytics, and software engineering across The Cigna Group and its businesses. Evernorth Health Services India builds on The Cigna Group’s existing presence in India.

About Evernorth Health Services:

Evernorth Health Services (Evernorth) is the pharmacy, care and benefits solution division of The Cigna Group - a Fortune 16 global health company with 75,000 employees, 186 million customers in more than 30 countries and jurisdictions around the world. Evernorth exists to make the prediction, prevention, and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. We do this by creating and connecting premier health services offerings, such as benefits management, pharmacy, care solutions, insights and intelligence.

About Cigna:

The Cigna Group is a global health company committed to improving the health and vitality of individuals and communities around the world and includes products and services marketed under its Cigna Healthcare and Evernorth Health Services subsidiaries. Cigna Healthcare is the health benefits provider of The Cigna Group, serving customers and clients through its U.S. Employer, U.S. Government, and International Health business. Evernorth Health Services is the pharmacy, care and benefits solution division of The Cigna Group.

Position Overview

We're seeking a talented AI/ML Engineer to design, develop, and deploy cutting-edge AI and machine learning solutions. You'll work with state-of-the-art models and technologies, contributing to projects that have the potential to revolutionize industries.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Design and implement AI/ML models using various frameworks and libraries.

  • Work with large language models (LLMs) from providers like OpenAI and AnthropicDevelop and optimize RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI capabilities into our applications.

  • Conduct experiments and analyze results to improve model performance.

  • Stay updated with the latest advancements in AI/ML and propose innovative solutions

Qualifications

Required Experience & Skills:

  • 7 to 8 years of development experience.

  • Strong proficiency in Python and AI/ML libraries (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow).

  • 5+ years of experience working with large language models (e.g., GPT-4, Claude).

  • Familiarity with RAG systems and related technologies.

  • Strong understanding of machine learning concepts and algorithms.

  • Experience with cloud-based ML platforms (e.g., AWS SageMaker, Databricks)Proficiency in data preprocessing and feature engineering

Preferred Experience & Skills:

  • Advanced degree in Computer Science, AI, or a related field.

  • Experience with graph databases (e.g., Neo4j) and knowledge graphs.

  • Familiarity with MLOps practices and tools.

  • Experience with GPU acceleration and distributed computing

  • Contributions to AI/ML open-source projects or research publications

Location & Hours of Work:

Hyderabad and Hybrid (2:30 PM IST to 11:30 PM IST)

Equal Opportunity Statement

Evernorth is an Equal Opportunity Employer actively encouraging and supporting organization-wide involvement of staff in diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts to educate, inform and advance both internal practices and external work with diverse client populations.

About Evernorth Health Services

Evernorth Health Services, a division of The Cigna Group, creates pharmacy, care and benefit solutions to improve health and increase vitality. description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? Where is the work:

Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires.

What's in it for you:

Trane in Grand Rapids, MI is hiring an Application Engineer II (Equipment). In this role, you will be responsible for the equipment portion of various projects including validating the equipment selection, pricing, discounts, and submittal processes of the equipment portion of projects as required, and will be accountable for the strategy and performance achievement of the specific budget objectives.


What you will do:

  • Responsible for the optimization/validation of the equipment to include selection of size, configuration, voltage, options, etc. of the HVAC equipment by reviewing the plans, specifications, original estimate and proposal.

  • Responsible for evaluating possible cost savings and/or cost problems that will occur on various projects.

  • Supports sales and develops preliminary submittals and/or final submittals as required, as well as hold job cost consensus meeting and submittal release and makes any necessary changes.

title: Project Manager
description:
POSITION TITLE: Project Manager

TEAM: Client Services

REPORTS TO: Director of Client Services

FLSA CLASSIFICATION: Salary, Exempt

LOCATION: Headquarters (On-Site)

ABOUT US

At the heart of Gable lies a passion that transcends the conventional. We’re more than just creators of visual communications; we’re experts at creating experiences. We believe that every brand, building, and place has a unique story to tell, and our mission is to elevate the way they are seen, experienced, and remembered.

We are committed to fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment where team members can thrive and contribute to our shared success.

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Project Manager is responsible for overseeing all aspects of a project from contract approval to completion. This includes developing and managing project budgets, schedules, and deliverables while ensuring client satisfaction and compliance with company standards. The Project Manager serves as the central point of contact for both internal teams and clients, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and manage project budgets, ensuring alignment with financial targets.
  • Create detailed project plans, including scope of work, milestones, and resource allocation.
  • Prepare requests, including but not limited to, drawing requests, fabrication and installation work orders, survey requests, permit requests, and purchase order requests.
  • Oversee all phases of project execution, including design, fabrication, and installation.
  • Regularly track project performance against the plan, adjusting schedules and resources as necessary to stay on target.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure project requirements are met.
  • Identify and manage risks, addressing potential issues proactively.
  • Engage with stakeholders to understand their needs and expectations, ensuring alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Conduct detailed cost analyses and ensure profitability for assigned projects.
  • Manage project closeout activities, ensuring documentation is complete and accurate.
  • After project completion, assess project performance, document lessons learned, and identify areas for improvement to inform future projects.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 2-3 years of experience as an Associate Project Manager or 3-5 years of experience in project management, preferably in the sign, visual, or construction industry.
  • Proficiency in project management tools and methodologies.
  • Strong financial acumen and budgeting skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
  • Exceptional communication and leadership skills.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Manual dexterity to operate a computer to perform basic clerical functions. Visual acuity (with correction) and the ability to speak and hear. The work is sedentary, with occasional walking, standing, bending, and carrying of light items such as papers and books.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment includes both office settings and manufacturing facilities. This role may involve occasional exposure to factory conditions such as noise, fumes, dust, and mist.

TRAVEL

This position may require up to 20% travel, including overnight stays.

title: Verzorgende IG in de Geriatrische Revalidatiezorg - Hof van Sloten
description:
Word jij onze nieuwe held in de zorg?
Stap in een rol waarin je niet alleen zorg verleent, maar ook een positieve impact maakt op het leven van revaliderende ouderen! Ben jij iemand die enthousiast wordt van verantwoordelijkheid, vrijheid en de kans om echt het verschil te maken? Wij zijn op zoek naar een initiatiefrijke en creatieve verzorgende IG die wil bijdragen aan de hoogwaardige zorg voor onze cliënten in Hof van Sloten!

Wat bieden wij jou?

We bieden je een uitdagende positie binnen een organisatie die de ambitie heeft de beste zorgverlener en zorgwerkgever van Amsterdam en omgeving te zijn. Daarnaast bieden wij je:

  • Contract: jaarcontract voor 16 – 36 per week, na een jaar met uitzicht op vast bij goed functioneren;

  • Salaris: FWG 40: min. €2.811,- en max. €3.864,- o.b.v. 36 uur per week;

  • Extra’s: Eindejaarsuitkering (8,33%) en vakantiegeld (8%)

  • Reiskosten: een vergoeding á € 0,21 per km en een fietsplan;

  • Pensioenopbouw via Pensioenfonds Zorg & Welzijn;

  • Ontwikkelmogelijkheden: Volop mogelijkheden om je persoonlijk en professioneel te ontwikkelen via o.a. Goodhabitz;

  • Collega aandragen? Ontvang in totaal een aanbrengbonus van € 500,- netto.

Wat ga je doen?
Je functie is dynamisch en we zoeken een verzorgende IG die niet alleen zorg verleent, maar ook actief bijdraagt aan het revalidatieproces van de patiënt. Je werkt met cliënten die complexe zorgbehoeften hebben en helpt hen bij het bereiken van hun revalidatiedoelen. Je hebt een belangrijke rol in het multidisciplinaire team, waar nauw wordt samengewerkt met (para)medische specialisten. Tegelijkertijd wordt van je verwacht dat je zelfstandig kunt werken en initiatief neemt in de zorg en ondersteuning van de patiënt.

Waar ga je werken?

Cordaan biedt op vijf locaties in Amsterdam Geriatrische Revalidatiezorg. Hof van Sloten, met 85 plaatsen, is de grootste locatie en biedt een uniek revalidatieklimaat. Hier stimuleren we cliënten om actief aan hun herstel te werken. Dit doen we door hen zoveel mogelijk zelf te laten doen, wat een andere aanpak is dan in een ziekenhuis.

Hof van Sloten is opgedeeld in de volgende afdelingen:

  • Afdeling neurologie en cognitie

  • Afdeling conditie

  • Afdeling trauma, ortho en amputatie

Wie ben je?

  • Je bent in bezit van een diploma verzorgende IG (niveau 3);

  • Je hebt ervaring in de revalidatiezorg;

  • Je toont inlevingsvermogen en respect naar de patiënten. Je draagt bij aan een goede sfeer waarbij de patiënten zich prettig voelen;

  • Bij al je taken werk je vanuit de gedachte dat de zorgvrager zelf de regie weer kan gaan voeren, afhankelijk van de situatie geef je daarbij de juiste, noodzakelijke ondersteuning;

  • Je kunt zelfstandig werken, bent positief ingesteld en hebt doorzettingsvermogen.

Enthousiast?
Herken jij jezelf hierin? Solliciteer dan direct en draag bij aan onze revalidatiezorg! Graag ontvangen wij je CV en motivatie. Controleer altijd na het indienen van je sollicitatie of je een bevestiging in je (spam)mailbox ontvangen hebt. Voor vragen of verdere informatie kan je contact opnemen met:

  • Rosanne Holmström (Recruiter): rholmstrom@cordaan.nl of 06-28182388.


Kleurrijk en betekenisvol met elkaar
Cordaan vindt een inclusief werving- en selectiebeleid belangrijk. We omarmen de eigenheid van collega’s en stimuleren ontwikkeling van talenten. We willen dat cliënten en collega's zichzelf herkennen in onze organisatie. Dit vraagt om een goede representatie van medewerkers en leidinggevenden met verschillende achtergronden. Cordaan streeft ernaar om meer mensen uit groepen die nog ondervertegenwoordigd zijn, aan te nemen en te behouden.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Why join us?
Handoff is the AI agent that runs a construction company. We help remodelers automate estimating, streamline operations, and win more work - backed by real-time cost data, intuitive design, and workflows that “speak contractor.” With over 10,000 monthly active users and $6B in annualized project volume already flowing through our platform, we’re becoming the trusted partner for the people who build our homes.
We are backed by $25M+ raised from Y Combinator, Initialized, and Greycroft. Our team is distributed across hubs in Austin, São Paulo, and Buenos Aires, and we are deeply focused on building intuitive, high-impact solutions that make a real difference for our users.

Product Manager at Handoff

We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the roadmap, strategy, execution and outcomes for a core product area at Handoff. ou’ll lead a cross-functional squad with engineering and design, turning complex contractor problems into simple, high-impact products that drive measurable customer and business outcomes.

This role is for someone who combines a strong judgment, deep customer obsession, and a high bar for evidence-based execution. You should be energized by complexity, detail-oriented, and excited to work in a fast-paced, AI-driven startup solving real-world problems for builders and remodelers.

What you’ll do

  • Own the squad roadmap, strategic direction, execution, traction and outcomes for a core product area.
  • Identify and prioritize the highest-leverage customer and business problems, making clear tradeoffs about what we build and what we don’t.
  • Conduct continuous customer discovery - interviews, prototypes, field visits, user behavior - and turn insights into clear specs, user stories, and priorities.
  • Partner closely engineering and design from ambiguous problems to simple, polished solutions, iterating quickly from discovery through launch and beyond.
  • Define success metrics, set up tracking, analyze performance, and drive measurable improvements in adoption, activation, retention, and business outcomes.
  • Produce and update our roadmap and communicate product direction across leadership and GTM teams.
  • Translate features into benefits, positioning and customer outcomes, supporting sales, marketing, and onboarding with clear collateral.
  • Sweat the details - QA, polish, and validate every flow and edge case before launch.
  • Apply Handoff’s product principles - simplemaxxing, mobile-first, AI-first, and customer-obsession - to every design, feature, and product decision

About you

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Management, ideally in vertical SaaS and high-growth tech startups or scaleups
  • Experience building B2B SaaS products; with AI experience strongly preferred.
  • Track record of owning meaningful product areas from strategy and discovery through launch, adoption, and measurable impact; Experience building 0→1 or early-stage products and rapidly iterating toward adoption.
  • Strong skills in customer discovery, research, experimentation, and ruthless prioritization.
  • Proven ability to work hand-in-hand with engineers and designers in agile environments.
  • Excellent writing and communication - able to produce crisp specs, epics, prototypes, and roadmap docs.
  • AI-native mindset — comfortable using AI in your own work and excited about building products where AI fundamentally changes customer workflows.
  • Excitement about construction, remodeling, and home services - genuine curiosity about contractors’ world and transforming the construction industry
  • Startup DNA - comfort in ambiguity, bias for action, stamina for fast-moving environments.
  • Bonus: Experience building CRM, project management, payments / fintech / banking, AI-driven products, or self-serve PLG (product-led growth)

What we offer

  • Competitive Salary + Equity
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • 401(k)
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Life & Disability Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Dependent Care FSA (DC FSA)
  • Relocation Allowance
  • Top-Notch Equipment
  • Team Offsites

If you’re excited to build products that transform how contractors run their businesses - and you thrive in a fast-paced, high-impact environment - we’d love to meet you

title: Intelligence Analyst
description:

Job Description Summary

Location: London

#hybrid

What if your analysis could help protect the future of healthcare? As an Intelligence Analyst at Novartis, you will play a critical role in identifying, assessing, and communicating security threats that could impact our people, operations, and ability to deliver life-changing medicines to patients worldwide. Working at the intersection of intelligence, technology, and global security, you'll leverage advanced analytical techniques, artificial intelligence, and data-driven insights to support strategic decision-making in a complex and rapidly evolving global environment. This is an opportunity to join a world-class intelligence function where your expertise will directly contribute to safeguarding an organization dedicated to reimagining medicine.


Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Operate within the intelligence cycle to identify, assess and communicate emerging security risks, geopolitical developments, crime trends, reputational risk patterns and disruptive events which may impact business operations.

  • Produce high-quality threat assessments, executive briefings, presentations, and intelligence reports aligned to Global Security strategy, while ensuring accuracy, appropriate sourcing, and confidentiality.

  • Translate complex intelligence findings into clear, actionable insights that support strategic decision-making, executive protection, business continuity, and enterprise risk management.

  • Strengthen the threat intelligence operating rhythm with AI-enabled capabilities under established frameworks, to enhance strategic decision-making, risk-anticipation, executive protection, business continuity, and enterprise risk management, while retaining accountability for accuracy, interpretation, judgment and ethical use

  • Conduct all-source intelligence collection and analysis to generate timely insights and deliver root-cause investigations, predictive analysis, horizon scanning output and maintain a high-quality, searchable corporate memory of intelligence activity.

  • Support continuous learning and improvement of AI governance, prompt discipline, validation standards, source evaluation, and analytical tradecraft within the Intelligence COE

  • Build strong partnerships with internal stakeholders and external intelligence and security networks.

Essential Requirements

  • Proven extensive experience using artificial intelligence and augmented reasoning tools within intelligence or analytical environments.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant discipline.

  • Extensive professional experience in Intelligence and Security (both required) - combined settings include global security, counter-terrorism, law enforcement, military, commercial intelligence or related fields

  • Experience of structured analytical techniques and intelligence analysis tools such as i2 Analyst's Notebook or equivalent platforms.

  • Full proficiency in English, is essential with a high standard of writing competence required, other region-specific languages, in particular German, Russian and Arabic are desirable.

  • Exceptional written, verbal, stakeholder engagement, and executive influencing skills.

  • Advanced analytical and investigative skills, including open-source intelligence and social media intelligence research, with demonstrated ability to assess complex threats and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

Desirable Requirements

  • Experience in an international / global environment and previous experience of the EMEA region is desirable.

  • Additional language capabilities form the region

Benefits & Rewards

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: £63,040-£94,560

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.

Note: Benefits and compensation may vary by country and are subject to local legal requirements, including provisions of collective bargaining agreements where applicable. A full overview of your compensation package, including any relevant collective bargaining agreement details applicable to your role based on your employment location and Novartis employer entity, will be communicated separately to you during the application process.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion / EEO paragraph

Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams’ representative of the patients and communities we serve.

Adaptability, Business Acumen, Counterfeit Investigations, Crisis Support, Critical Thinking, Curious Mindset, Decision Making, Employee Background Screening, Enhanced Due Diligence, Negotiation, Persuasion, Physical Security, Proactive Planning, Problem Solving, Relationship Building, Report Writing, Stakeholder Management, Strategic Thinking, Threat and Vulnerability Assessment, Travel Security

title: Direct Current Datacenter System Architect
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Program Manager Solid State Transformer

__

Your role and responsibilities
We are looking for a Power Systems Architect to join our Direct Current Data Center Incubator, playing a critical role in driving the transformational shift toward next-generation Direct current data center architectures. Working closely with strategic customers - especially hyperscalers - you will help shape the future of data center architectures by translating complex customer challenges into innovative, optimized electrical solutions.

In this highly visible role, you will act as a trusted technical advisor across the full project lifecycle, combining deep technical expertise with strong consultative skills. You will influence market opportunities, support customer adoption, reduce churn, and enable flawless execution of pioneering Direct Current data center projects.

The work model for the role is: hybrid (#LI hybrid)

This position reports solid line to the Solid State Transformer Program Manager and dotted line to the Direct Current Datacenter Incubator Manager.

Key Responsibilities

  • In collaboration with ABB data center segment and account managers partners closely with key customers - particularly hyperscalers - to support their transition from conventional AC data centers to advanced Direct Current data center architectures.

  • Design and architect end-to-end electrical power system solutions for data centers, delivering competitive, scalable, and future-ready system architectures.

  • Design protection and control— Designing Direct Current ‑specific protection schemes and overall control schemes for the future architecture including sequence of operation, managing the load and active monitoring.

  • Manage customer and market requirements and align the priorities for the product development teams.

  • Collaborate with internal engineering and product teams to identify technology gaps and influence product roadmap evolution.

  • Lead and support pilot projects, ensuring successful early-stage execution and delivery of novel Direct Current data center solutions.

  • Act as a technical authority and customer advocate throughout the sales, design, and delivery phases.

  • Contribute to technical thought leadership in emerging Direct Current power architectures and industry trends.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in power system design, consulting, or solution architecture.

  • Strong background in data center power systems, or exposure to Direct Current power solu-tions (experience in adjacent industries such as marine or industrial Direct Current systems is highly valued).

  • Demonstrated track record of delivering complex, high-impact technical solutions.

  • Knowledge in electrical power systems, including switchgear, transformers, protection, control systems.

  • Ability to operate effectively in evolving technical environments.

  • Willingness to travel internationally, particularly to the United States.

  • Strong Cross-cultural awareness.

More about us

ABB's Distribution Solutions Division facilitates the efficient and reliable distribution, protection and control of power by improving electric power quality while strengthening the resilience of the grid. The Division offers segment-specific products and solutions that largely serve utilities, industry and infrastructure segments, often providing the requisite medium-voltage link between high-voltage transmission systems and low-voltage users. With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions at its core, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 66 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, reclosers, fuses, contactors, relays, instrument transformers, sensors, motor control centers, as well as low-voltage switchgear for the ANSI standard markets.

This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Cloud Engineer based in United Arab Emirates.

Join a technical team focused on supporting and scaling modern cloud-based data environments.
In this role, you will help application teams onboard to Databricks and build reliable Data Landing Zones (DLZ).
You will work with Azure resources, Infrastructure as Code, automation, and deployment pipelines to deliver efficient solutions.
As a first-line technical point of contact, you will troubleshoot requests and help resolve issues through structured support processes.
You will also identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities and continuously improve operational workflows.
The role combines hands-on cloud engineering with application support in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.
It is an excellent opportunity to deepen your expertise in Databricks, Azure, IaC, and cloud automation while making a direct impact on data platform operations.

Accountabilities

  • Provide first-level technical support to application teams through the ServiceNow ticketing system, investigating and resolving common Databricks and cloud-related requests.
  • Gather, clarify, and analyze technical requirements for onboarding new Data Landing Zones (DLZs).
  • Execute pipelines, scripts, and automated processes to provision, configure, or modify Azure and Databricks resources.
  • Support the deployment of commonly requested Azure resources using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.
  • Identify repetitive manual activities and develop automation to improve efficiency, consistency, and support response times.
  • Collaborate with application, cloud, data, and other cross-functional teams to resolve technical issues and ensure smooth onboarding.
  • Create, maintain, and continuously improve documentation covering support procedures, workflows, configurations, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of cloud support operations and the overall Databricks environment.

    • Requirements:

    • 1–3 years of hands-on experience working with Databricks in a technical or operational environment.
    • 1–3 years of experience with Azure Data Factory.
    • Previous experience in application support, technical operations, cloud support, or a similar role.
    • Familiarity with major cloud platforms, particularly Azure, with exposure to AWS or GCP considered an advantage.
    • Experience using source-control systems such as Git, GitHub, or GitLab.
    • Understanding of Databricks capabilities such as Unity Catalog, role-based access control (RBAC), authentication mechanisms, and Delta Sharing is highly desirable.
    • Experience working within the Azure ecosystem and understanding of cloud resource management.
    • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, or AWS CDK.
    • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation platforms such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions is a plus.
    • Scripting or development experience with Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar technologies.
    • Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities, combined with attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

title: Director of Supply Chain
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Supply Chain based in the United States.

This is a high-impact leadership opportunity to build and scale an end-to-end supply chain for a rapidly growing omnichannel consumer brand.
The role spans demand and supply planning, procurement, manufacturing, inventory, supplier management, and cost optimization.
You will create the infrastructure, processes, and partnerships needed to support continued domestic and international expansion.
Working closely with executive and cross-functional leaders, you will connect commercial demand with operational capacity and financial objectives.
You will also drive supplier performance, working-capital efficiency, retail readiness, and supply continuity across a complex network.
The position offers significant ownership and visibility, with the opportunity to build a high-performing supply chain organization from the ground up.
It is well suited to a hands-on strategic leader who thrives in fast-growth environments and enjoys turning operational complexity into scalable systems.

Accountabilities:

  • Own and continuously evolve the end-to-end supply chain strategy across sourcing, procurement, manufacturing, inventory, and distribution, ensuring the infrastructure can support rapid domestic and international growth.
  • Develop manufacturing and supplier network strategies, including sourcing decisions, dual-sourcing opportunities, manufacturing footprint, and make-versus-buy analysis.
  • Identify and mitigate supply risks and single points of failure across manufacturers, suppliers, raw materials, components, and packaging.
  • Lead consensus demand planning and supply planning across DTC, Amazon FBA/FBM, retail, wholesale, and international channels, translating commercial forecasts into SKU-level production, procurement, inventory, and capacity requirements.
  • Lead the S&OP process and create strong alignment across Sales, E-Commerce, Marketing, Product, Finance, and Operations.
  • Establish procurement governance and oversee purchase orders, supplier commitments, production schedules, costs, delivery dates, payment status, and variance management.
  • Lead contract manufacturer and supplier selection, onboarding, negotiations, relationship management, performance reviews, scorecards, and QBRs.
  • Negotiate pricing, lead times, MOQs, payment terms, capacity reservations, and other commercial conditions while maintaining quality and service standards.
  • Own inventory strategy across SKUs, channels, and locations, including safety stock, inventory turns, days/weeks of cover, aged inventory, excess inventory, and obsolescence prevention.
  • Partner with Finance to improve inventory accuracy, working-capital management, product-cost visibility, and overall supply-chain financial performance.
  • Drive continuous COGS optimization across manufacturing, materials, packaging, freight, and other upstream costs without compromising quality or customer experience.
  • Ensure supply-chain readiness for major retail partners, including forecasts, replenishment, inventory availability, OTIF, fill rates, routing, case-pack, labeling, and compliance requirements.
  • Lead supply-chain readiness for new product launches by securing materials, packaging, production capacity, finished goods, and replenishment plans against critical launch milestones.
  • Develop supply-chain strategies for international expansion, including regional inventory, replenishment, lead-time, freight, capacity, packaging, labeling, and compliance considerations.
  • Own supply-chain master-data integrity across SKU, vendor, BOM, MOQ, lead-time, cost, supplier, and inventory information, while supporting ERP implementation and optimization.
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing supply-chain organization, establishing clear responsibilities, decision rights, KPIs, accountability, succession planning, and cross-training.
  • Lead monthly supply-chain business reviews and recurring vendor QBRs, providing executive-level visibility into inventory, production, capacity, working capital, risks, and mitigation plans.
  • Act as a strategic partner to executive leadership, escalating material risks early and presenting clear business impacts, options, recommendations, and required decisions.

    • Requirements:

    • 8–12+ years of progressive supply-chain experience, including meaningful leadership responsibility within a fast-growth CPG or consumer-products organization.
    • Demonstrated experience building and scaling supply-chain infrastructure in rapidly growing businesses.
    • Deep hands-on expertise across demand planning, supply planning, procurement, contract manufacturing, inventory management, and supplier management.
    • Proven experience supporting omnichannel businesses spanning DTC, retail, wholesale, and Amazon FBA/FBM.
    • Strong understanding of major retail supply-chain requirements, replenishment, OTIF performance, and inventory planning.
    • Significant contract-manufacturing, supplier-management, and commercial negotiation experience.
    • Experience managing both domestic and international supply chains and preparing organizations for market expansion.
    • Strong financial acumen, including understanding of COGS, inventory investment, margins, cash requirements, and working-capital implications.
    • Experience working with ERP and planning systems, with a strong focus on data integrity, planning discipline, and scalable processes.
    • Strong strategic and analytical capabilities combined with a hands-on, execution-oriented approach.
    • Excellent cross-functional communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and external partners.
    • Demonstrated ability to build teams, establish operating rhythms, and create accountability in high-growth environments.
    • Experience in beauty, haircare, personal care, or other consumer-product categories is preferred.
    • Experience scaling a digitally native consumer brand into major brick-and-mortar retail is a plus.
    • Experience supporting nine-figure or rapidly scaling consumer businesses is advantageous.
    • Familiarity with NetSuite or comparable ERP platforms and experience improving demand- and supply-planning systems are preferred.

      • Benefits:

      • $150,000–$190,000 annual compensation range.
      • Fully remote position based in the United States.
      • Full-time leadership opportunity with significant ownership of the supply-chain function.
      • Direct executive exposure and meaningful influence over revenue, profitability, working capital, retail expansion, and customer experience.
      • Opportunity to design and implement scalable supply-chain systems, processes, supplier relationships, and organizational structures.
      • Opportunity to support major omnichannel and international growth initiatives.
      • Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with substantial decision-making authority.
      • Opportunity to help scale a rapidly growing consumer brand and build a high-performing supply-chain organization.

description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Salesforce Engineer based in Brazil.

This role offers the opportunity to take technical ownership of a complex, enterprise-scale Salesforce environment supporting a global travel technology platform.
You will design, develop, secure, and optimize scalable Salesforce applications with a strong emphasis on advanced Apex engineering.
The position covers the full software development lifecycle, from architecture and implementation through CI/CD releases and production support.
You will work closely with engineers, administrators, product stakeholders, and cross-functional Agile teams to deliver reliable solutions.
A key focus will be improving platform performance, managing governor limits, mitigating record-locking issues, and maintaining strong security standards.

This is a high-autonomy opportunity for an experienced Salesforce specialist who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges and working with modern technologies.

  • Monitor system logs, investigate execution anomalies, and resolve performance bottlenecks, record-locking issues, query inefficiencies, and other platform challenges.

  • Collaborate with developers, administrators, product teams, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into clean, reliable, and high-performing technical solutions.
  • Contribute to Agile development practices, technical decision-making, code quality, unit testing, and production reliability.

    • Strong experience with Salesforce platform development technologies such as Visualforce and Lightning Web Components (LWC).

    • Strong analytical, diagnostic, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.

title: Head of Legal
description:
Job Title: Chief Compliance Officer
Location: Luxembourg
Experience: 8 years +
What about us?
Launched in 2023, INFINIT is a fast-growing fintech scale-up operating in multiple countries across Europe and Americas.
At INFINIT we are on a mission to reshape the future of SMEs with AI at the forefront. Our all-in-one operating system has banking at its core, and empowers small business owners and their teams to seamlessly manage and optimize every aspect of their business with AI agents.
By focussing on specific industries, INFINIT delivers tailored, high-value solutions, while building innovative AI products to further unlock significant growth opportunities for our customers. INFINIT operates globally, with ambitions to further expand its footprint to redefine the fintech landscape for SMEs worldwide.
Join us on the INFINIT journey as we revolutionise the SME economy and drive meaningful impact through innovation 🚀
The Role

As the Head of Legal at INFINIT, you are more than a legal expert; you are a strategic architect and a critical pillar in our mission to redefine the SME economy. You will spearhead our legal function, crafting a comprehensive strategy that balances aggressive growth with ironclad compliance as we scale our AI-driven fintech solutions globally.

A central focus of this role will be the establishment and ongoing development of our Payment Institution (PI) in Luxembourg. You will play a pivotal role in ensuring our operations meet the rigorous standards of the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF) and other relevant regulatory bodies. You will be the primary legal point of contact, navigating complex international banking and financial regulations, managing sophisticated contract negotiations, and mitigating operational risks. By fostering a culture of excellence and providing robust legal governance from high-level corporate matters to cross-functional support for product launches you will provide the essential legal backbone that allows INFINIT to innovate at speed and scale.



What do we want to achieve together?

  • Legal Strategy: Develop and implement a comprehensive legal strategy that supports Infinit’s business objectives and ensures compliance with relevant laws and regulations.

  • Regulatory Compliance (AML/KYC, CFT, & Sanctions): Oversee a robust compliance framework, with a primary focus on AML/KYC, CFT, and Sanctions compliance, ensuring our operations adhere to the highest regulatory standards across all operating jurisdictions.

  • Contract Management: Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of contracts and agreements, ensuring the company's interests are protected.

  • Risk Management: Identify and mitigate legal risks associated with the company’s operations and strategic initiatives.

  • Corporate Governance: Ensure robust corporate governance practices are in place and adhered to, including board governance and shareholder matters.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with senior leadership and other departments to provide legal support for business initiatives, product launches, and other strategic projects.

  • Dispute Resolution: Manage and resolve legal disputes, working with external counsel as necessary.

  • Policy Development: Develop and implement internal policies and procedures to ensure legal compliance and best practices across the organization.

  • Team Leadership: Build and lead a high-performing legal team, fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.

  • Payment Institution (PI) Establishment & Authorized Management: Spearhead the establishment, operational development, and act as the Authorized Manager of our Payment Institution (PI) in Luxembourg, ensuring full compliance with CSSF requirements.

  • Regulatory Liaison: Manage ongoing relationships and reporting with the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF) and other relevant regulatory bodies.

  • Corporate Secretarial & Governance: Oversee day-to-day corporate maintenance, including maintaining statutory records, preparing board minutes, and managing subsidiary governance to ensure strict legal compliance.

  • Employment & HR Legal: Partner with the People team to draft and review employment contracts, advise on complex employee relations, disciplinary procedures, and internal policy development.

  • Data Protection & GDPR: Act as a primary legal contact for data privacy, overseeing GDPR compliance, managing Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), and updating privacy policies to align with evolving regulations.

What do you need to be successful in this role?

  • Experience: Minimum of 10 to 12 years of legal experience, with significant time spent at a top-tier law firm. Experience in the fintech industry is highly desirable.

  • Education: Juris Doctor (JD) or equivalent law degree from a reputable institution. Admission to the bar in Luxembourg or another European jurisdiction is required.

  • Track Record: Demonstrated success in providing strategic legal advice and managing complex legal matters in a dynamic business environment.

  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical skills and the ability to make sound legal judgments.

  • Communication Skills: Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and build relationships at all levels of the organization.

  • Organizational Skills: Highly organized with strong project management skills and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

  • Proactive Mindset: Self-starter with a proactive approach to problem-solving and a high degree of initiative.

  • Leadership: Demonstrated leadership abilities and experience in building and leading legal teams.

What will you find working at INFINIT?

  • Competitive Salary and Equity: We offer highly competitive salaries and a stake in our success with share options because we're building this together.

  • Diverse and Inclusive Team: Join a dynamic and international team in excess of 8 nationalities. You'll have the chance to work with experienced professionals from around the world, fostering a rich learning environment.

  • Inspiring Mission: We are dedicated to revolutionizing business financing and making a positive impact on the European economy. Your work at INFINIT will have a lasting effect on businesses and communities.

  • Health and Well-being: Your health matters to us. You will have access to top-quality Medical & Mental Health Insurance as well as corporate gym discount.

  • Quality Time Together: We foster a sense of community with annual gatherings and bi-weekly office team gatherings. You're more than welcome to join us for quality time.

  • Personal Time Off: Enjoy flexibility with your personal time off.

  • Flexibility and Ownership: We trust our team and we are goal-oriented. Enjoy the flexibility of hybrid working 3 days a week in our Luxembourg office and 2 days at home.

Diversity & Inclusion
INFINIT promotes an inclusive culture that seeks equity and values different perspectives. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic.

About DESC:

Recognized nationally as an innovator and leader in developing solutions to homelessness, DESC is a social services organization, supportive housing operator, and licensed behavioral health treatment provider focused on meeting the needs of people experiencing long-term homelessness and living with complex behavioral health and other medical conditions. Approximately 3,000 people are actively receiving services from DESC at any given point in time. Our vision is a community where all people are shown compassion, treated with dignity, and everyone has a safe, stable, and affordable place to call home.


DESC operates five shelter/emergency housing programs, 19 permanent supportive housing facilities with over 1,750 units, several hundred additional scattered site apartments, and a range of behavioral health services including outpatient mental health and substance use disorder treatment, residential crisis stabilization, street outreach, mobile crisis response, and treatment for opioid use disorder.


JOB DEFINITION:

Crisis Solutions Center is a residential treatment facility that provides stabilization services to clients experiencing acute or ongoing behavioral health crises. Peer Specialists will work within a multi-disciplinary team and to create and implement detailed, client-centered care and safety plans; facilitate group and individual peer counseling; and ensure services are fully integrated with mental health, substance use, and primary care teams. They are an essential part of building rapport and developing positive relationships by relating to clients through their own lived experience. Peer Specialists will help develop and maintain a comprehensive list of community partners; participate in staff meetings and training; and maintain a safe and therapeutic environment.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assist participants with voicing their interests and goals through a variety of approaches including Goal Plans, Crisis Plans, WRAP and other methods that express the individual’s preferences for their recovery goals.
  • Participate in planning, organizing and co-facilitating of recovery skills and educational group treatment services
  • Advocate for client access to community resources and services; consult and collaborate with community providers to ensure continuity of care.
  • Use lived/personal experience with mental health and/or substance use to build connections with program participants; utilize a trauma informed approach to assist participants in their recovery.
  • Serve food, do laundry and change linens, help clean common areas, and occasionally clean up bodily fluids and biohazardous waste using appropriate PPE.
  • Provide phone consultation for referents to the CSC, monitor office security cameras, answer phone calls, and other administrative duties.
  • Maintain current and complete clinical and administrative records, including but not limited to goal planners, progress notes, safety and risk assessments, shift summary notes, and care-coordination between internal and/or external partners.
  • Demonstrate DESC core values and professionalism in all client and staff interactions; follow agency clinical policies and procedures; participate in quality assurance reviews when assigned
  • Participate in verbal de-escalation in emergent situations and be willing and able to assist other staff as needed to maintain a safe and secure environment.
  • Provide transportation for clients (such as appointments outside of CSC) when needed.
  • Attend a 2-week onboarding process upon hire, as well as other full-day trainings on an ongoing basis.
  • Other duties as assigned.

title: Technical Support Engineer / Linux Systems Administrator (L2/L3)
description:
At TechBiz Global, we are providing recruitment service to our TOP clients from our portfolio.

We are currently looking for a dedicated Technical Support Engineer / Linux Systems Administrator to join one of our clients' teams. If you're looking for an exciting opportunity to grow in an innovative environment, this could be the perfect fit for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure Collaboration: Work within the technical team to administer and maintain GNU/Linux operating systems and virtualized/containerized environments (OpenVZ, KVM, Docker, etc).

  • Web Hosting Operations: Participate in the deployment, management, and troubleshooting of industry-standard control panels (like cPanel/WHM, Plesk) within shared hosting environments.

  • Application & Web Stack Support: Troubleshoot and optimize web applications built on common web technologies, frameworks and CMS platforms (WordPress, Laravel, etc.). Assist clients and resolve complex issues related to PHP, with knowledge of Node.js and Python stacks considered a strong plus.

  • Network & Security Operations: Help configure and maintain network protocols, firewalls, and WAFs (ModSecurity, Imunify360). Work with the team to identify, respond to, and mitigate security incidents (malware, phishing, DoS, etc.).

  • Mail Server Administration: Troubleshoot mail flow and deliverability issues, you are already familiar with Exim, Dovecot, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and the use of external mail relays.

  • Performance & DevOps: Contribute to routine service monitoring and execute performance tuning across Apache, Nginx, LiteSpeed, and database engines (mainly MySQL/MariaDB, and rarely PostgreSQL and Redis).

  • Reliability & Migrations: Support infrastructure projects, including migration of hosting accounts, VMs, and mail systems. Assist in testing and implementing disaster recovery, backups, failovers, and caching/CDN strategies.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: Several years of hands-on experience in the web hosting industry in both technical support and system administration.

  • OS Mastery: Advanced proficiency in Linux system administration and troubleshooting. Familiarity with Windows Server environments (including IIS, MSSQL) for cross-platform support cases.

  • Hosting Stacks: Deep understanding of the cPanel/WHM ecosystem, CloudLinux (LVE, CageFS, Selectors), PHP configuration, and typical shared hosting constraints and workarounds. In addition to proven expertise configuring, managing, and troubleshooting HTTP web servers (Apache, Nginx, LiteSpeed, etc.).

  • Web Technologies: Strong grasp of web server mechanics, relational/NoSQL databases, and the ability to debug complex web apps at the server level.

  • Networking Fundamentals: Solid understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, and network protocols.

  • Communication: Strong ability to manage escalated support tickets and collaborate with peers to provide custom technical solutions for clients.

Nice-to-Have

  • Automation & Scripting: Proficiency in writing Bash scripts, Python utilities, and utilizing Ansible playbooks to help the team automate routine deployments and maintenance tasks.

  • Billing & Integration: Experience with WHMCS backend architecture and custom module integrations.

  • Hardware & Architecture: Familiarity with high-density enterprise server architectures and large-scale account consolidation workflows.

  • Multilingual Support: Professional fluency in English is highly advantageous for internal documentation and diverse client communication.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Cloud Engineer based in Spain.

Join a technical team focused on supporting and scaling modern cloud-based data environments.
In this role, you will help application teams onboard to Databricks and build reliable Data Landing Zones (DLZ).
You will work with Azure resources, Infrastructure as Code, automation, and deployment pipelines to deliver efficient solutions.
As a first-line technical point of contact, you will troubleshoot requests and help resolve issues through structured support processes.
You will also identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities and continuously improve operational workflows.
The role combines hands-on cloud engineering with application support in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.
It is an excellent opportunity to deepen your expertise in Databricks, Azure, IaC, and cloud automation while making a direct impact on data platform operations.

Accountabilities

  • Provide first-level technical support to application teams through the ServiceNow ticketing system, investigating and resolving common Databricks and cloud-related requests.
  • Gather, clarify, and analyze technical requirements for onboarding new Data Landing Zones (DLZs).
  • Execute pipelines, scripts, and automated processes to provision, configure, or modify Azure and Databricks resources.
  • Support the deployment of commonly requested Azure resources using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.
  • Identify repetitive manual activities and develop automation to improve efficiency, consistency, and support response times.
  • Collaborate with application, cloud, data, and other cross-functional teams to resolve technical issues and ensure smooth onboarding.
  • Create, maintain, and continuously improve documentation covering support procedures, workflows, configurations, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of cloud support operations and the overall Databricks environment.

    • Requirements:

    • 1–3 years of hands-on experience working with Databricks in a technical or operational environment.
    • 1–3 years of experience with Azure Data Factory.
    • Previous experience in application support, technical operations, cloud support, or a similar role.
    • Familiarity with major cloud platforms, particularly Azure, with exposure to AWS or GCP considered an advantage.
    • Experience using source-control systems such as Git, GitHub, or GitLab.
    • Understanding of Databricks capabilities such as Unity Catalog, role-based access control (RBAC), authentication mechanisms, and Delta Sharing is highly desirable.
    • Experience working within the Azure ecosystem and understanding of cloud resource management.
    • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, or AWS CDK.
    • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation platforms such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions is a plus.
    • Scripting or development experience with Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar technologies.
    • Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities, combined with attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
    • Ability to communicate clearly with application teams and collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

      • Benefits:

      • Opportunity to work hands-on with Databricks, Azure, cloud infrastructure, and modern data technologies.
      • Exposure to Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, automation, and cloud platform operations.
      • Collaborative environment with opportunities to work closely with application and cross-functional technical teams.
      • Opportunity to develop expertise in a growing data and cloud technology ecosystem.
      • Role combining technical support, cloud engineering, automation, and continuous improvement.
      • Potential for professional growth through exposure to a broad range of cloud and data platform challenges.
